description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that creates a thunderclap that may deafen anyone directly underneath.

name: Keen Sense of Smell
description: A Minor General Virtue giving a +3 bonus to all rolls involving the sense of smell, including tracking with the Hunt Ability.

name: Knight
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a member of the noble warrior class who may have high-quality weapons, armor, and a horse, and take Martial Abilities.

name: Landed Noble
description: A Major Social Status Virtue granting a character an agency prior to play; listed with a Resistance of 3 on the Resistance of Agents Table.

name: Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit
description: A Perdo Mentem (General) spell that reduces a ghost or spirit's Might by the spell's level if it penetrates, causing the spirit to vanish if its Might reaches zero.

name: Leper Magus
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue exclusive to House Tytalus describing the mystic legacy of leprosy passed from Tytalus through Hariste's line; grants Life Boost and lets the magus mortify his flesh to produce vis.

name: Lesser Purifying Touch
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character heal a specific minor or self-recovering illness with a touch and a Fatigue level.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: A Virtue granting superior reflexes, cited in connection with the adder's reflexive attacks and listed as suitable for beasts.

name: Limit of the Divine
description: One of the two fundamental limits of Hermetic magic: magic cannot affect the Divine, with most lesser limits believed to derive from it.

name: Long-Winded
description: A Minor Virtue acquirable by a Bjornaer inner heartbeast and suitable for beasts such as the wild goat, horse, and wolf.

name: Loreley
description: A beautiful, malevolent water faerie (Faerie Might 30, Aquam) who lures sailors to their deaths from the cliffs of the Rhine Gorge with her song; daughter of the Rhine Spirit.

name: Loss of But a Moment's Memory
description: A spell that removes up to five continuous minutes from a target's memory, leaving a blank focused on a specific event or time.

name: Magical Warder
description: A Major General Virtue giving the character a magical being, such as a ghost, that watches over him and comes to no harm; designed as a magic character.

name: Masking the Odor of Magic
description: A spell of magical concealment that hides the traces of magic, which Tabanus's Reveal the Magical Deception is designed to overcome.

name: Mendicant Friar
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a follower of St. Francis or St. Dominic who wanders among rich and poor spreading the word of God.

name: Michael
description: A minor demon (Might 10, Corpus) who tempts people to wrath through elaborate, painful practical jokes disguised as the victim's friends, taking the name of the famous angel.

name: Michael Scot
description: Named court wizard of Frederick II, the Holy Roman Emperor, cited as a Greater example of profiting from wizardry.

name: Mirror of Opposition
description: A Muto Vim spell cast on another spell being cast, causing it to have the exact opposite of its normal effects; ten Form-specific versions exist.

name: Muse
description: A title for any supernatural entity from the four realms that attaches itself to a prominent artist, granting Virtues, powers, and Warping in exchange for promoting its interests, eventually carrying the artist to its home realm.

name: Mystical Choreography
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus perform Ceremonial Magic faster (five minutes per magnitude, or one minute in a prepared space) through skilled body movement.

name: Mythic Pound
description: The standardized currency unit used for prices in Ars Magica, equivalent to a pound of silver, a typical peasant's annual income, or a year's upkeep of an average Hermetic laboratory.

name: Oakdell
description: A former covenant founded 934 AD by magi of House Diedne in the Westerwald; razed to the ground with all its Diedne magi slain during the Schism War in 1016 AD.

name: Optimistic
description: A Personality Flaw making a character habitually optimistic; held by the Scribe template, swappable for Carefree or Pessimistic.

name: Palm of Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 5) in which a flame leaps up in the caster's upturned palm, casting torch-like light and igniting flammable items without burning or damaging the caster.

name: Parens
description: A magus's master/teacher within the Order; the parens trains the apprentice, sets the gauntlet, and conventionally is regarded as a superior throughout life.

name: Perfect Balance
description: A Minor General Virtue granting +6 to rolls to avoid falling or tripping, especially on narrow ledges or tightropes.

name: Petrus of Verdun
description: A tenth-century Primus of House Jerbiton who advocated magi living within mundane communities as wealthy citizens, abandoning multi-House covenants.

name: Philippus Niger
description: An Archmage of Durenmar who uses the Holy Vehm to execute hedge magicians and at least one Marched magus, and promotes spread of the Vehmgerichte as a tool against hedge wizards.

name: Pit of the Gaping Earth
description: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 15) spell that opens a pit beneath a target's feet; no one can resist it, so it bypasses Magic Resistance, and it can also create defensive trenches.

name: Poor Hearing
description: A Minor General Flaw subtracting 3 from rolls involving hearing and making hard-to-understand speech nearly impossible to follow.

name: Posing the Silent Question
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster ask one silent mental question of a target and detect the answer, limited by the target's knowledge.

name: Profession: Scribe
description: A profession Ability; in one season a character can copy Profession: Scribe x 60 levels of Laboratory Texts that are already written understandably.

name: Prying Eyes
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell that lets the caster see inside a room as long as they touch one of its walls, changing viewpoint within during the duration.

name: Radegast
description: An archetypal Slavic god of chieftainship, war, fertility, and harvest worshipped at Rethra and Mount Radhost; in saga material revealed as a powerful demon controlling the Slavic lands and a willing source of vis through human sacrifice.

name: Reckless
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character fails to notice threatening situations and charges right in.

name: Relic
description: Physical objects housing part of the power of the Divine, often parts of saints' bodies; they grant Faith Points, Divine Might, Magic Resistance, and an aura hostile to Infernal creatures.

name: Rethra
description: A former great Slavic pagan fortress-temple housing the Oracle of the god Radegast; once a covenant of Slavic magi-priests, it was abolished by the Tribunal in 1207 and retains a Faerie aura of 4 (secretly Infernal).

name: Rising Ire
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 15) that makes the target furious at someone or something of the caster's choice; an appropriate Personality Trait roll can hold the anger in check.

name: Rügen
description: An island in the Eastern Marches that is home to the covenant of Crintera and a focus of the Crintera Schism; the spread of the Church there makes recruiting difficult.

name: Sahir
description: A type of non-Hermetic wizard of the Mythic Middle East; an Infernally-aligned sahir bound the Buran of Yenghissar within his ancestral sword using the Goetic Art of Binding.

name: Schwall
description: An eccentric elderly Bjornaer magus and Wilderist of the Hawthorn Gild, formerly of Rheinstein, living at the Rhinefalls; he plots to release the Rhine elemental and merge with its spirit.

name: Short Attention Span
description: A Minor Flaw that affected covenfolk may acquire after a year under the Instant Loyalty of the Rebellious Turb ritual.

name: Simple-Minded
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character can only think about one thing at a time and becomes easily confused without clear instructions.

name: Slow Caster
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw given to Confraternity of Irene Initiates, whose spellcasting mimics the long time it takes to paint or sculpt.

name: Small Frame
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is of lighter-than-average build with Size reduced to -1; incompatible with Giant Blood, Large, or Dwarf.

name: Stealth
description: The Ability governing hiding and moving unseen; gains large bonuses from invisibility for hiding, contested in opposed rolls to locate invisible characters.

name: Stentorius
description: A powerful older House Tremere Archmagus, leader of Fengheld in the Rhine Tribunal, who holds three-fifths of the Tremere sigils there and commands the House in that Tribunal.

name: Sufi
description: Muslim mystics organized into tariqas led by shaykhs, seeking union with God; some wield supernatural powers and one Egyptian school uses unreadable texts for meditation.

name: Supernatural Beauty
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue of mystical beauty that calls royal power, folk magic, and heroism to its defense, letting the player request a fortunate coincidence once per story.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: A Major Story Flaw in which supernatural entities interfere in the character's life in minor ways, without long-term plans, whenever he is around them.

name: Survival
description: A General Ability covering finding food, water, shelter, routes, and safety in the wilderness, including building fires and cooking without implements.

name: Taste of the Spices and Herbs
description: A Muto Imaginem spell (Level 5) that makes a setting's worth of food or drink taste and smell exactly as the caster designates.

name: Temporal Influence
description: A minor general Virtue granting influence in mundane government or institutions; raises an agent's Resistance Strength, as with the merchant Godfroi.

name: The Bountiful Feast
description: A Creo Herbam ritual (Level 35) cast at noon the day after the winter solstice to ensure crops within its target grow healthy and fruitful.

name: The Crystal Dart
description: A Muto Terram spell (with Rego requisite) that transforms a stone into a 10-inch crystal dart that flies at a target for +5 damage.

name: The Donatores Requietis Aeternae
description: A young, secretive necromantic tradition of House Ex Miscellanea with religious backgrounds who ensure the spirits of the dead reach their final rest using the Banishing Ability.

name: The Mysteries Revised Edition
description: An Ars Magica supplement detailing Mysteries such as Hermetic Theurgy, Names of Power, Invocation Magic, Hermetic Synthemata, Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes, and the Inscription on the Soul Virtue.

name: The Pharmacopoeians
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus collect magical ingredients to reduce the vis cost of healing Rituals; defining Virtue of the Pharmacopoeians.

name: The Rhine Gorge
description: The narrow, castle-lined stretch of the Rhine between Bingen and Koblenz where nobles enforce tolls; the focus of the saga and supposedly cursed, with all its covenants failing within seven decades.

name: The Walking Corpse
description: A spell that animates a corpse into an automaton; such corpses use a revenant's physical statistics but are not supernatural and have no Might score or Magic Resistance.

name: Theurgy
description: A Hermetic Mystery of summoning and dealing with spirits, including Aspects of Daimons, requiring synthemata and long invocations; ordinary Hermetic magic cannot summon a Daimon's Aspect without it.

name: Tracks of the Faerie Glow
description: A spell used in a Performance Magic example; its Hunter's variant is cast by Harold using Performance Magic (Hunt) to gain magically enhanced vision while hunting.

name: Treverorum
description: A former covenant in the city of Trier dedicated to recovering lost Roman secrets, approved in 1095 AD; abolished in 1172 AD after its magi repeatedly meddled in the affairs of mundanes and the Church.

name: Unseen Arm
description: A Rego Terram spell (ReTe 5) used to hold an object in the air without concentration; moving the object still requires concentration.

name: Verditius Elder Runes
description: A Verditius Inner Mystery and set of philosophically-grounded runes, derived from Wayland's rune magic and refined by Boethius's philosophy, carved to add power to enchantments.

name: Victor of Mercere
description: A famous magus of House Mercere from Semita Errabunda; a faerie dell named Victor Valley after him might be inhabited by a faerie sharing his reputed qualities.

name: Vinaria
description: An archmage and former Prima of House Merinita who stepped down after being outmaneuvered by Handri; she returned after seven years of claimed Faerie Twilight with a new inner strength that frightens Handri, and is strong in the raw elemental arts.

name: Voluntas
description: A vigorous covenant near the village of Wilton, founded by Norman magi, that has led the anti-Blackthorn opposition for over a century and is famed for its library.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Water
aliases: Ward Against Faeries of the Waters
description: A Rego Aquam General ward spell preventing water faeries whose Faerie Might is at or below the spell level from affecting those targeted.

name: Weight of a Thousand Hells
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 25) that makes the victim feel the despair and pain of a thousand sinners in Hell, sapping motivation and imposing penalties on thought and Personality Trait rolls.

name: Whispers Through the Black Gate
description: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 15) with a Mentem requisite that lets you speak through the barrier between living and dead to one undecayed corpse.

name: William Marshal
description: The greatest knight in Europe (1147-1219), earl of Pembroke and regent of England after King John's death, who rose from a minor lord's younger son.

name: Winter's Icy Touch
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 10) that causes the target to feel a chill and lose body heat, costing them a Fatigue level.

name: Wise One
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of a broad class of mystics, seers, and healers, well regarded in the community.

name: Wizard's Boost
description: A Vim spell example that is not eligible for the Rebuttal Mastery special ability because it does not affect a spell used by another being.

name: Aachen
description: A city founded by Charlemagne over Roman thermal springs; its cathedral houses his tomb, holy relics, and the throne where the German king is crowned. Its Divine aura sapped a local forest spirit.

name: Abdkypris
description: A recent Criamon Primus who traveled through Muslim Iberia, North Africa, and the Levant, introducing Sufi wisdom and the Path of Walking Backwards into the House.

name: Academic Concentration
description: A General, Minor Virtue: the character concentrates in one of the seven Artes Liberales subjects for +3 to that subject but -1 to the others; incompatible with Puissant Artes Liberales.

name: Adranus, the Spirit of Mount Etna
description: A powerful Magic spirit (Might 50, Ignem) coterminous with Mount Etna, able to duplicate Creo/Rego/Muto/Perdo Ignem and Terram spells and grant Flaws such as Visions, Simple-Minded, and Wrathful.

name: Alluring to (Beings)
description: A Minor General Virtue making animals, faeries, or magical beings strangely drawn to the character, granting +3 to Communication and Presence rolls to affect them.

name: Aristotelian Training
description: A General, Minor Virtue: the character was trained in the New Aristotle, gaining +1 to Artes Liberales rolls for grammar, logic, rhetoric, +1 to Disputatio Totals, and (for magi) +1 to relevant Lab Totals.

name: Arliandus
description: A magus of House Tremere whose intact sanctum beneath Trier, specialized in Mentem study, was protected by his enchanted Door of Deimos and held Hermetic treasures.

name: Automata
description: A Major House Mystery for constructing mechanized beasts and men of wood, stone, or metal, imbued with Magic Might and enchanted to perform tasks like servants.

name: Avarret
description: Magus elevated to Primus of House Bonisagus in 1191, returning the House to conservative refinement of Hermetic theory; selected Murion as successor before Final Twilight.

name: Awaken the Slumbering Corpse
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 25) that causes a corpse to function at simple verbal commands; the corpse cannot have been buried by Church ceremony.

name: Bane of the Decrepit Body
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 25) that ages the target 5 years; does not work on children younger than 16.

name: Banishing
description: A Major Supernatural Accelerated Ability of the Donatores that banishes any creature with a Might score from a designated area for a time; aligned with the Divine for the Donatores but possible with any realm.

name: Beast Masters
description: An Ex Miscellanea tradition whose apprentices are abandoned in the wilderness and develop the Summon Animals Virtue, Animal Ken, and a Minor Magical Focus with a specific group of animals.

name: Benedictine Order
description: The oldest and most important monastic order, founded on the rule of Benedict of Nursia, whose monks are known as black monks and number around 3,800 in England.

name: Blackmail
description: A Flaw used to represent coercion of an agent by a principal, such as a priest controlling a knight through blackmail or other leverage.

name: Blade of the Virulent Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 15) that forms fire along a metal blade, doubling the weapon's damage (or adding +5) and starting fires; repeated castings can melt the blade.

name: Blind
description: A Major General Flaw: the character has little or no sight, making missile weapons futile and reading impossible; blind magi cannot aim spells without magical aid.

name: Bockman
description: A horrible goat-headed faerie that lurks on Black Forest paths to ambush travelers using its Unease of the Still Forest and Fear powers; physically weak and cowardly, with Animal and Mentem vis in its horns.

name: Breath of the Open Sky
description: A Creo Auram Ritual spell (Level 40) that calls up a wind capable of devastating the countryside, toppling structures and trees.

name: Brutal Artist
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw available only to magi of House Jerbiton: the magus makes ugly art, suffering -3 on social rolls with Jerbiton magi and unable to gain a positive Reputation in the House.

name: Buliste
description: The ninth Prima of House Tytalus who entered a protracted Twilight, was declared dead, and on recovery in 1198 contested leadership with Harpax; her loyalists wear royal purple.

name: Burnham
description: An aloof covenant in the far northeast of the tribunal, a motte-and-bailey castle holding a grant of immunity from the crown; rarely sends representatives to tribunal.

name: Calm the Motion of the Heart
description: A spell that removes one emotion from the target until it appears again naturally, such as making an angry person stop being angry.

name: Canterbury
description: Capital of Kent and metropolitan see of the English church; site of Becket's martyrdom and his shrine, the fourth main pilgrimage site in Europe.

name: Cathars
description: A heresy spreading in southern France (Languedoc) against which Brother Julian preaches and which the Church combats through the faculties of theology.

name: Cercistum
description: A Primus of House Tremere during the Schism War, quoted observing that the Tytali fought a different battle on the Plain of Wolves than the Tremere pretended to.

name: Chamber of Spring Breezes
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 5) that creates a breeze of fresh air keeping a room's air breathable even if airtight.

name: Chaos of the Angry Waves
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that causes water to churn wildly in a circular area, overturning small craft and penalizing Swim rolls.

name: Chaotic Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw: the magus's spontaneous magic is wild, and if it falls short of or exceeds the desired level by more than one, the storyguide decides the uncontrolled results.

name: Charge of the Angry Winds
description: An Auram spell whose effect is duplicated by an air elemental power of the same name, adding the elemental's Strength to Ease Factors for acting within the wind.

name: Charged Item
description: An enchanted item costing no vis that can be used a limited number of times, gaining one charge per five points the Lab Total exceeds the effect level.

name: Chimera
description: A noble hybrid inner heartbeast combining features of two mundane creatures (such as a griffin, hippogriff, or unicorn), produced by the Mystery of the Chimera.

name: Circle of Beast Warding
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 5) in which the caster inscribes a circle that no normal beast will cross.

name: Circling Winds of Protection
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 20) with a Rego requisite that surrounds the caster with fast-circling winds that obscure and penalize attacks against them.

name: Cistercian Order
description: A monastic order founded by Robert of Molesme at Cîteaux and spread by Bernard of Clairvaux, the white monks who farm sheep in isolated areas and drive out inhabitants of acquired lands.

name: Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 40) that, with a clenching motion of the hand, causes the victim to double over and die at once.

name: Clerk
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a literate professional such as a scribe, accountant, lawyer, or functionary, possibly in minor or holy orders.

name: Clouds of Rain and Thunder
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 25) that creates a small but severe rainstorm with lightning and winds while the caster concentrates.

name: Clovis
description: A Gifted descendant of Merovech who rose to become the first Christian Frankish king and founder of the Merovingian dynasty, whose magical lineage endured after his death.

name: Clutch
description: A study group of the Criamon magi within a single Tribunal, originally living as a covenant following a single path; the Cave of Twisting Shadows holds the Central Clutch.

name: Coat of Flame
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 25) with a Rego requisite that swathes the target in fire dealing +5 damage every round while the spell is in effect; the requisite keeps the fire from spreading.

name: Common Sense
description: A Virtue whose effects are granted by Familiarity with the Fae, but only in situations pertaining to faeries.

name: Conciatta
description: A brilliant tenth-century theorist of House Bonisagus who extended Hermetic magic to affect the Divine, Faerie, and Infernal realms and famously suffered from The Constant Expression Flaw.

name: Corpse Magic
description: A Supernatural Ability allowing the character to temporarily revive and command a relatively intact, unburied corpse.

name: Cripple the Howling Wolf
description: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 25) that cleanly breaks one of a target animal's legs, with damage healing as a Medium Wound.

name: Curse of the Desert
description: A Perdo Aquam spell that removes virtually all fluid from a target's body, dealing damage that armor does not protect against; the target must drink within minutes or die.

name: Curse of the Rhine Gorge
description: A purported long-term doom causing every covenant and noble dynasty of the Rhine Gorge to fail within roughly seven decades; attributed to one of four supernatural realm causes.

name: Decrepitude
description: A score that increases like an Ability as a character accumulates Aging Points; at 4 the character is frail and must roll on the Crisis Table, and at 5 is bedridden.

name: Deft Form
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue removing Casting Total penalties for non-standard voice/gestures with one Form.

name: Demetrius
description: An alchemist Criamon magus, teacher of the current Prima Muscaria, whose carnal urges are embodied in the captured adulteration called the Carnal Wolf.

name: Diedne Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue from the druidic House Diedne lineage granting superior Spontaneous magic, requiring the lineage to be hidden via a Major Story Flaw.

name: Difficult Spontaneous Magic
description: A Hermetic Flaw referenced as combinable with Weak Spontaneous Magic to create a magus who cannot cast spontaneous magic at all.

name: Disguise of the New Visage
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 15) that transforms the target's facial features to any approximately human configuration the caster chooses.

name: Disputatio
description: A formal academic debate resolved much like certamen, using paired totals (Attack, Defense, Weakening, Resistance) and symbolic Fatigue Levels to determine a winner across deliberative, epideictic, and forensic forms.

name: Doissetep
description: A powerful covenant in the Provençal Tribunal where the dark Jerbiton magus Imanitos Mendax was apprenticed.

name: Dwarf
description: A Major General Flaw making the character the size of a child, with Size -2 and penalties to Strength and Stamina.

name: Edge of the Razor
description: A spell that sharpens a weapon to improve attacks; disfavored by the School of Ramius because Magic Resistance can stop the enchanted weapon. Its damage bonus can combine with Hardness of Adamantine.

name: Edward of Milton
aliases: Edward of Milton, follower of Jerbiton
description: A Jerbiton archmagus and nominated head of the covenant Schola Pythagoranis in Cambridge, friend and former teacher of the scholar Robert Grosseteste.

name: Elemental
description: Magical creatures composed of pure elemental matter (earth, water, air, or fire) formed through rarefication under a magical impetus; not truly alive, they do not age, eat, or reproduce and recover Might only slowly in a Magic aura.

name: Elysium
description: A place where magi have encountered Valkyries, who are no longer worshiped in Mythic Europe.

name: Emir
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue equivalent to Knight but for Muslim emirs, who are skilled in hunting, religious teachings, and culture as well as martial pursuits.

name: Enchanting (Ability)
description: A Minor Supernatural Ability Virtue applying to a particular artistic expression (dance, drawing, storytelling, craftwork) that in Faerie auras can control events through art.

name: Enchantment of the Scrying Pool
description: An Intellego Aquam Ritual spell (Level 30) with an Imaginem requisite that turns a body of water into a scrying pool; an old Mercurian ritual known throughout the Order.

name: End of the Mighty Castle
description: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 25) spell that collapses a building; since non-magical stone falls due to gravity, Magic Resistance does not protect against it.

name: Envied Beauty
description: A Major Story Flaw whose character's beauty draws revulsion and jealousy, especially from vain persons of the character's gender.

name: Eule
description: An aged master of House Bjornaer at Fengheld with the heartbeast of an owl and the honorary rank of Quaesitor; she may have entered Final Twilight and her wisdom is faked by Gunther.

name: Exotic Casting
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to cast Hermetic spells using non-Hermetic methods, making it hard for others to recognize the spell being cast.

name: Experimentation
description: Risky laboratory practice of pushing beyond known limits, adding a simple die to the Lab Total but requiring a roll on the Extraordinary Results Chart each season.

name: Eyes of the Cat
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 5) with an Animal requisite that gives the target a cat's eyes, allowing sight in near darkness.

name: Eyes of the Eagle
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell (Level 25) that lets the caster see distant things clearly, making out details as if they were a foot away while still judging distance accurately.

name: Faerie-Raised Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue conditioning a character to invent spells very quickly, allowing self-teaching of spells outside the lab; common in the Line of Quendalon.

name: Feral Scent
description: A Minor General Flaw giving a character the strong natural smell of a wild animal, imposing a social penalty and an Unclean Reputation but doubling Scent Target spell areas if Sensory Magic is Initiated.

name: Feud
description: A major Flaw representing an ongoing feud likely to inconvenience a principal, lowering an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Fist of Shattering
description: A Perdo Terram spell that breaks apart an object of stone or weaker material, cited as an example affected by the Harmless Magic Flaw.

name: Flawed Powers
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw applying the effects of a Major Hermetic Flaw (such as Restriction or Necessary Condition) to a character's Supernatural Virtues rather than to Hermetic magic.

name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
description: A Major, Hermetic Virtue allowing slight variation of Formulaic spell parameters (Range, Duration, Target) while still casting known magic.

name: Forge-Companion
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for an unGifted craftsman attached to a Verditius magus and working in his lab, with extra experience for Crafts.

name: Free Study
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue adding +3 to Source Quality when studying from raw vis.

name: Gabriel, the Archangel of Prophecy
description: A Divine creature (Might 100, Mentem), the chief messenger of God known for teaching the prophet Daniel, announcing Christ's incarnation to Mary, and bringing the Qur'an to Muhammad.

name: Gathering of Twelve Years
description: A periodic gathering of House Bjornaer (the Swan Clan performs a special ritual role at it); held in 1227 and figures in the Crintera Schism as each rival faction holds its own.

name: Gender Nonconforming
description: A Personality Flaw (Major or Minor) representing a character who does not conform to societal gender expectations; common among Faerie Doctors.

name: Gentleman
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a minor member of a noble family treated as their own and addressed as Lord or Lady, though without inheritance.

name: Goliard
description: The vigorous apparent leader of Blackthorn, nearly ninety, who controls a bound elemental spirit and seeks to restore the covenant's lost influence.

name: Gossip
description: A minor general Virtue making a character a fount of rumor and information; listed as a resource increasing an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Grand Silesia
description: A covenant founded between the Oder and Warta rivers in Poland by magi from Rethra and Crintera (993-1009); it split to form the New Slavonic Tribunal and was destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Great Beast
description: Powerful ancestral beast-spirits of House Bjornaer who set quests and trials for magi seeking the Inner Heartbeast Mysteries and who act as Mystagogues during their Initiation.

name: Great Strength
description: A Virtue recommended for Line of Muj characters, representing their supernaturally great hereditary strength.

name: Great Weapon
description: A combat Ability used for large two-handed weapons such as the cudgel, pole arm, great sword, long spear, and warhammer.

name: Guardians of the Forests
description: A Rhine Tribunal ruling permitting protection of wildernesses, which the Hawthorn Gild and Crintera unsuccessfully sought to invoke against the Danish invasion of Rugen.

name: Hephaestus
description: The lame Greek god of smiths and divine artificer, founder of the Cult of Hephaestus, who built sacred forges and crafted famous magical items for the gods.

name: Hermetic Breakthrough
description: The research achievement of expanding the limits of Hermetic Theory; minor or major breakthroughs (e.g. Aristotelian or Platonic Magic Theory) are accumulated via Breakthrough Points and disseminated in a tractatus.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: The Hermetic Tribunal of Ireland, where the survivors of Tagelyn founded the covenant of Ashenrise.

name: High Crime
description: A serious category of offense under the Code of Hermes, of which a Pralician obtaining excess scrying information could be convicted.

name: Hippogriff
description: A faerie beast gifted by the queen Titania to the King of England, housed at the Tower of London, which is poisoned by the Divine aura of London's many churches.

name: Holy Vehm
description: An organization whose pious leader, the archbishop of Cologne, is murdered in 1225, which the demon Gymir is infiltrating and corrupting to use as a surrogate against Radegast's pagan followers.

name: Horse Clan
description: A Crintera clan that maintains the covenant's wild steeds, possesses the Animal Ken Virtue, provides provisioning, and acts as a messenger service.

name: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook referenced for fuller treatment of the use of magic to support the Redcap network.

name: Hubris
description: A Minor Personality Flaw inflicted on Verditius magi through Inner Mystery Ordeals; it grows like an Ability with success and is mystically coupled to a Verditius's Gift to boost enchantment Lab Totals.

name: Hunchback
description: A Minor General Flaw giving the character a deformed body with a grotesque appearance and penalties to agility, balance, and looks.

name: Hygwald Veritas
description: A devious magus of House Tremere and co-founder of Waddenzee, a specialist in Rego Mentem who is scrupulously honest with the Quaesitores and aspires to join them.

name: Hérisson
description: A tenth-century Bjornaer magus who founded the Harmonist philosophy of living in harmony with nature, ridiculed in his own time.

name: Igor Rastvan
description: An archmage of House Ex Miscellanea and high priest of Radegast who leads Roznov's covenfolk in pagan worship and human sacrifice; his cursing magic draws on Slavic traditions and pagan ceremony, and his zeal may be unhinging him via Twilight.

name: Imanitos Mendax
description: A vain, treacherous magus of Oculus Septentrionalis with a focus in Mentem (and Imaginem for disguises); he runs a tavern, brothel, and extortion business in Lubeck and is secretly conspiring with the pirate covenant Waddenzee.

name: Immanola
aliases: Immanola, prima of House Ex Miscellanea
description: The prima of House Ex Miscellanea and oldest maga in the tribunal, over 150 years old, gifted in prophecy; blocked from the praeco position by Blackthorn and now seen as Twilight-ridden.

name: Incantation of the Milky Eyes
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 30) that blinds a target, leaving the eyes milky with cataracts; heals as a Heavy Wound.

name: Inoffensive to (Beings)
description: A Minor General Virtue whereby the character's Gift does not bother a chosen class of beings (animals, faeries, or magical beings); known among Merinitae as the Bronze, Silver, and Golden Gifts.

name: Invisibility of the Standing Wizard
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 15) that makes the target invisible, but the spell breaks if the target moves and the target still casts a shadow.

name: Invisible Sling of Vilano
description: A popular indirect Rego Terram (ReTe 10) spell that hurls a stone as a projectile; bypasses Magic Resistance with a successful aiming roll, inflicting +5 damage.

name: Ioanna
description: A Redcap follower of Mercere murdered in the city of Trier in 1151 AD, prompting a Quaesitorial investigation; she had earlier recorded directions to Treverorum and Rheinstein.

name: Journeyman
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a trained guild craftsman who may practice his trade in town under guild supervision and work for a master for a wage.

name: Julia
description: The de facto leader of Voluntas and one of the tribunal's best politicians, a mature Jerbiton maga specializing in Corpus and Mentem who orchestrated the breaking of Blackthorn's dominance at the 1201 tribunal.

name: Legendary Artist
description: An artist whose Reputation reaches 11 and is taken by his muse into a supernatural realm, becoming an immortal being with a Might score and supernatural powers based on his Craft or Profession.

name: Leper Magi
description: A small lineage within House Tytalus descended from Hariste and Epimetheus who draw magical strength from leprosy; powerful healers and longevity experts who are inevitably specialized in Corpus magics.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character has been cursed by a supernatural power, with effects about as bad as other Minor General Flaws.

name: Libellus
description: The newest and one of the largest covenants in the tribunal, founded and led by Stephen Eruditus of Jerbiton; an unknown quantity in tribunal politics.

name: Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
description: A Major, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus produce stronger spontaneous magic at the cost of declaring an effect level and spending Fatigue or taking wounds.

name: Limit of the Lunar Sphere
description: A boundary of Hermetic magic at the orbit of the moon; magic cannot affect the moon or the ethereal region beyond it, and it stunts spells reaching toward the heavens.

name: Lost Love
description: A Flaw often developed by Path of Strife magi who lose the spouses they married in the ritual at the Station That Repels and Attracts Elements.

name: Lotharingian Tribunal
description: A proposed separate Tribunal sought by members of the Apple Gild to cover the Low Countries in the north and west of the Rhine Tribunal, to be proposed at the Grand Tribunal of 1228.

name: Maddenhofen Woods
description: A stretch of woods on the northwestern fringe of the Bohemian Forest protected by House Merinita; site of Tytalus's 807 AD disappearance and home of a powerful faerie who grants Heart's Desire at a price.

name: Magister in Artibus
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for one who has incepted Master of Arts at a European university and completed compulsory teaching, entitling them to teach anywhere in Europe.

name: Marcus Navicularius
description: A Follower of Verditius (age 58) and the foremost shipwright in Lübeck, a master of Terram who enchants extremely large items such as ships for sale to other covenants.

name: Mendalus
description: A hierophant of the Huntress who in 1129 proclaimed at the Grand Tribunal that the Order should follow Merinita's true path; crazed by Twilight and believing himself the messiah, he was slain by fellow hierophants via Wizard's War.

name: Mentor
description: A useful minor Flaw representing a guiding patron; also noted as a relationship through which a character may be considered part of another's agency.

name: Mercenary Captain
description: A Social Status Virtue that grants a character an agency prior to play and appears as a minor social status example on the Resistance of Agents Table.

name: Merchant
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a character who lives by buying and selling goods, whether peddler, shopkeeper, or traveling merchant.

name: Merovech
description: A powerful 5th-century Frankish chieftain and wizard, namesake of the Merovingian dynasty, said to have two fathers and a magical bloodline; helped repel Attila at Chalons.

name: Moratamis of House Guernicus
description: A maga of House Guernicus who, suspicious of Carolus of Tytalus, challenges him to certamen but ultimately concedes; an Intellego and Mentem specialist in the certamen example.

name: Natural Leader
description: A Minor General Virtue giving a +3 bonus to social situations where the dominant character takes the lead, partly overcoming the social penalty of The Gift.

name: Neptune's Wrath
description: A Rego Aquam Ritual spell (Level 40) that creates a gigantic wave up to a mile wide capable of capsizing ships and devastating coastlines.

name: Nicola de Hay
description: The elderly hereditary constable of Lincoln castle and sheriff of the shire who held the castle through a siege and is locked in a conflict with the earl of Salisbury over her position.

name: Nigrasaxa
description: A relatively new, large covenant of two shining black towers, founded by Maximianus of Bonisagus to break the cycle of invalid tribunals.

name: Obliteration of the Metallic Barrier
description: A Perdo Terram spell (with Rego requisite) that shatters a metal or stone barrier up to one foot thick, harming those on the far side.

name: Opening the Intangible Tunnel
description: A Rego Vim spell that opens a magical channel from the caster to a target, allowing spells of greater than Personal range to be cast through it, subject to Penetration of Magic Resistance.

name: Outcast
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which normal society rejects the character and he is not attached to a covenant; he may not take the Wealthy Virtue.

name: Outlaw
description: A Major Social Status Flaw in which the character has been outlawed and must live by his wits outside society, with a Reputation at level 2 for whatever got him outlawed.

name: Overconfident
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character has unshakable faith in his own abilities and cannot imagine failure.

name: Oversensitive
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character finds intolerable something others find merely unpleasant.

name: Oxford
description: A master-run English university closely modeled on Paris, with four faculties and two student nations, governed via a chancellor appointed by the Bishop of Lincoln.

name: Pagan
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character does not follow the Church and has never been baptized; may begin with Magic Lore or Faerie Lore.

name: Paid Rights
description: A Virtue that is a game-mechanical way to acknowledge that an exceptional woman who holds public power in Mythic Europe is genuinely exceptional.

name: Painful Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which casting spells causes the equivalent of one Fatigue level in pain per spell, applying a cumulative penalty to actions.

name: Pains of the Perpetual Worry
description: A Creo Mentem spell (Level 20) that gives someone a nagging, painful recurrent emotion of anxiety and fear; described as truly a curse.

name: Palsied Hands
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character's hands shake uncontrollably, giving -2 to rolls involving holding or wielding objects and an extra botch die when casting.

name: Peering into the Mortal Mind
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 30) that lets the caster thoroughly probe and understand the contents of the target's mind, including motives, strengths, and weaknesses.

name: Pendule
description: A legendary Provençal hedge wizard who evaded the Founder Flambeau, took four Hermetic followers (two from House Merinita), taught illusion Mysteries, and died in 854 AD.

name: Peregrinator
description: The wandering magi of the Rhine Tribunal, typically journeymen, who travel from covenant to covenant relying on the Laws of Hospitality; about a sixth of Rhine magi are peregrinatores.

name: Performance Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus conceal spellcasting by substituting the actions or words of a specified Ability for normal Hermetic gestures and words.

name: Perpetuity
description: A Major Illusion Mystery of House Merinita granting three potentially-permanent spell durations (Might, Aura, Hidden); Merinitae usually gain the Unnatural Magic Flaw.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting exclusive access to a supply of raw vis yielding about one tenth of the player covenant's expected annual gathering.

name: Physician of Salerno
description: A Minor General Virtue indicating attendance at the famed School of Salerno, granting a Reputation, unique medical procedures like anesthetics, and 50 experience points.

name: Physician's Eye
description: An Intellego Corpus spell (Level 5) that determines the general health of a person, showing afflictions as yellow coloration on the body.

name: Pious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is a fervent follower of his religion, avoiding what it prohibits and doing what it commands.

name: Polandrus
description: A demon (Might 20, Animal) appearing as an extremely large jet-black wolf with red eyes who dominates wolves and targets livestock farmers, gradually coercing them into sin.

name: Poor Eyesight
description: A Minor General Flaw in which bleary vision gives -3 to rolls involving sight, including attack and defense; can combine with Missing Eye.

name: Poor Memory
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character has a very hard time recalling one type of thing such as names, faces, or places.

name: Pope Honorius III
description: The pope who banned civil law teaching at Paris, counseled Bologna's scholars to resist non-violently, and is petitioned over university licenses.

name: Potent Magic
description: A Minor or Major Hermetic Virtue attuning magic to a narrow field, granting a Lab Total and Casting bonus and allowing design of Potent spells using Casting Items.

name: Priest
description: A Social Status Virtue for a medical character in holy orders, usually attached to a monastic house; compatible with Magister in Medicina.

name: Pripet Maior
description: A New Slavonic Tribunal covenant settled in 1052 by Bjornaer magi formerly of Grand Silesia; allied with Crintera.

name: Profession
description: A Craft-like Ability for an artist's trade; performance maestros use Communication + Profession Ability + Form when instilling effects.

name: Prudentum
description: A Jerbiton magus and former leader of Oculus Septentrionalis who was slain in Wizard's War by Urgen of Bjornaer in 1179.

name: Puissant Craft
description: A Virtue granting a bonus to a Craft Ability such as Painting or Baking, used by several covenfolk templates.

name: Puissant Finesse
description: A recommended Virtue for the School of Vilano that boosts the magus's effective Finesse Ability for aiming indirect attacks.

name: Rapid Convalescence
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character's body heal quickly, granting +3 on all rolls to recover from wounds.

name: Reclusive
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character dislikes being disturbed or interrupted and is reluctant to enter public places or group activities.

name: Recollection of Memories Never Quite Lived
description: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 4) that changes the target's memory of a detail into a similar but different memory the target cannot distinguish from the authentic one.

name: Regin
description: An evil-hearted dwarf who coveted the magic ring of the Nibelungs and under whom Wayland apprenticed; played a part in the life of Siegfried.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character once per day add +3 to effective Strength for an action, requiring two Fatigue rolls afterward.

name: Ricardus Caespuus
description: A reclusive Follower of Bonisagus at Durenmar with a glass-walled laboratory specialized in Herbam, who cultivates many types of vis from exotic plants.

name: Richard the Lionheart
description: King of England who spent most of his reign on Crusade and at war in France, repeatedly demanding money from England; died of an infected arrow wound in 1199.

name: Ritual of Twelve Years
description: A House Bjornaer rite of passage after which a magus gains the Heartbeast Ability; experiencing it early in apprenticeship can grant Self-Confident or the Uswaurpa reputation.

name: Rowan Gild
description: A secretive Rhine political gild formed by Diedne magi who split from the Hawthorn Gild, later joined by Waldherz Bonisagus; its members were exiled and largely destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Rusted Decay of Ten-Score Years
description: A Perdo Terram spell that thoroughly rusts the metal of the target so it breaks under any demanding use and loses its sharpness.

name: Scent of Peaceful Slumber
description: A spell that makes everyone in a room fall asleep over a few seconds, with the smell of lilacs in their nostrils.

name: Schools of Sebastian
description: A catch-all family of minor Flambeau combat schools that conjure harmful objects or substances using Forms other than Ignem; named for the hedge-wizard magus Sebastian.

name: Schwarzburg
description: A Rhine covenant in the Swabian Jura (857-885) that warred with neighboring Arae Flaviae, causing the Tribunal to abolish both covenants.

name: Seirenes
description: A tradition of female magae in House Ex Miscellanea who practice lyrical Siren Song magic taught to their founder by the sirens of legend.

name: Selena Tibicena
description: A necromancer maga of Treverorum whose Trier sanctum, hidden beneath a graveyard, contained skeletons; her grave conceals a stairway to her former sanctum.

name: Semitae
description: A covenant of traveling magi led by a Criamon, recorded at the 1151 tribunal; possibly the same wandering group recorded in Cad Gadu's records since the tribunal's founding.

name: Sense Passions
description: A Supernatural Ability to sense the personality and desires of an intelligent being by reading the tarnish on its soul, often a false power or Infernally associated.

name: Sensory Magic
description: A Hermetic Mystery, described in Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults, whose Initiation lets a magus with Feral Scent double the area of effect of spells with a Scent Target.

name: Seven-League Stride
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 30) that transports the caster to any place within seven leagues that they can see or have an Arcane Connection with.

name: Sight of the Transparent Motive
description: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 10) that detects the general motive most powerfully influencing the target at the moment, such as fear, anger, or greed.

name: Skilled Parens
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue reflecting a more powerful or better-teaching parens, granting 60 extra experience points and 30 spell levels during apprenticeship.

name: Social Handicap
description: A Minor General Flaw in which some trait keeps the character from interacting easily with people, causing -3 on appropriate rolls.

name: Societates
description: One of the three groupings of Hermetic Houses; the fourth Societas, House Ex Miscellanea, is a special case in how its members gain House Virtues.

name: Special Circumstances
description: A Minor Virtue boosting magic under certain conditions; the Malocchi take it for eye contact and the Donatores' Minor Magical Focus relates similarly.

name: St. Cuthbert
description: A saint whose shrine is at Durham cathedral; in a vision he told Godric to settle at Finchale near Durham, and pilgrims visit Godric's shrine as part of visiting Cuthbert's.

name: St. Thomas Becket
description: The martyred Archbishop of Canterbury whose shrine is the great pilgrimage site at Canterbury and whose death won benefit of clergy; killed in a dispute over jurisdictions.

name: Stag of Virtue
description: A noble Magical stag (Might 17, Animal) and great enemy of serpents that can heal its own wounds, neutralize poison, and live forever; its right antler has sought-after healing powers.

name: Steed of Vengeance
description: A Muto Animal spell (Level 35) that turns a horse into a ferocious magical mount with a black coat, fiery eyes, fangs, and razor-sharp hooves.

name: Stellatus, the Dragon
description: An ancient dragon (Might 50, Ignem) able to assume human form, instill loyalty, breathe fire, and control fire; he regards himself as superior to all Hermetic magi and once killed a Tytalus maga.

name: Strong Angelic Heritage
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue requiring Blood of the Nephilim; it grants a Divine Might (Corpus) score, Magic Resistance, immunity to Warping, and levels of holy powers invoked by spending Might points.

name: Strong-Willed
description: A Minor General Virtue giving +3 on any roll requiring strength of will; the character cannot easily be coerced into activities, beliefs, or feelings.

name: Surgical Empiricus
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a chirurgeon trained in only a single aspect of Chirurgy, granting the usual +1 to that surgery but halving Chirurgy for any other application.

name: Swim
description: A General Ability for propelling oneself through water quickly and efficiently, with specialties in long distances, diving, and underwater maneuvering.

name: Sympathetic Connection
description: A magical relationship drawn from symbolic correspondences, used in charms and Synthemata Magic; severed and invalidated against a magus by the Secret Name Mystery.

name: Tasgillia
description: The fourth Prima of House Tytalus, despised for her selfish nature and puissant in spirit magic; she was executed for diabolism in 961 AD after summoning demons using Guorna's lore.

name: The Call to Slumber
description: A Hermetic spell, cited in Touch/Eye Range versions as a subtle urban spell and as a template for spells that manipulate mental states.

name: The Cult of Orpheus
description: A Mystery-Cult-like tradition of magi (magoi) descended from worshippers of Orpheus and Hermes, who practice emotionally-connected magic and revere the legend of Orpheus.

name: The Earth Split Asunder
description: A Rego Terram (ReTe 30) spell opening a chasm; Magic Resistance does not protect against falling in, but does against being crushed when it closes.

name: The Great Rot
description: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 25) that rots and destroys a large amount of dead wood, up to that found in a wooden house or small inn.

name: The Huntress in the Wood
aliases: Esoteric Mystery Cult of the Huntress in the Wood
description: A secret society in the Order comprised mainly of followers of Bjornaer dedicated to preserving primal nature-oriented magic; unknowingly a pawn of Fenistal, guided toward seizing the Elder Gild and Irencillia.

name: The Lyceum
description: A Hermetic societas of about eight rationalist magi led by Venatus Trianomae, named after Aristotle's school; they promote the New Aristotle and the seven liberal arts and reject the empiricist Collegium.

name: The Milites
description: A Minor Story Flaw for a House Flambeau character who is a member of the milites, granting brotherhood and 5 House Acclaim points but binding the character to obey the Primus.

name: The Path of the Body
description: A Criamon path focusing on the human form as a microcosm of the universe, with stations including the Perfect Tool, Spiritual Nourishment, Perfect Movement, the Microcosm, and Corporeal Repose.

name: Theology: Islam
description: An Ability a Mamluk character may take even without the Educated Virtue, reflecting his religious education in a military school.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: The missile-combat Ability used for thrown weapons such as the throwing axe, javelin, knife, and sling.

name: Tintagel
description: A near-island stronghold off the coast of Cornwall, the seat of Gorlois and later King Mark, and the site of Arthur's conception; it may be detached from the mundane world, with a chapel of St. Juliot helping keep it from reappearing.

name: Tip of the Tongue
description: A Perdo Mentem spell (Level 5) that causes the target to forget one word of the caster's choosing for the spell's duration.

name: Titanoi
description: A Mystery Cult lineage within House Tytalus, heirs to the goetic and spirit-summoning magical tradition of Guorna and Tytalus; nearly destroyed during the Betrayal and revived after the Schism War.

name: Toledo
description: A Spanish town whose charter requires a man's wife to live permanently in the town for him to gain citizenship, preventing itinerant merchants from claiming multiple citizenships.

name: Tormenting Master
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character's master does not believe he passed the apprentice's gauntlet and periodically troubles him with political moves; applicable to magi.

name: Touch of Midas
description: A ritual Creo Terram spell that creates a roughly spherical lump of gold about six inches across, enough wealth for a peasant family for centuries.

name: Tower of London
description: A London fortress whose grounds contain the Royal Menagerie housing exotic animals gifted to the King of England, including the ailing faerie hippogriff.

name: Trackless Step
description: A Rego Terram spell that leaves no tracks in the earth until the caster stops; draws on pre-Hermetic traditions.

name: Trap of the Entwining Vines
description: A Creo Herbam (CrHe 15) indirect spell whose vines surround and prevent a maga from moving without completely immobilizing her.

name: Troubadours
description: A type of minstrel from southern France whose courtly love poetry, inspired by Arabic neighbors, is being destroyed by the Albigensian Crusade.

name: True Lineages
description: One of the three groups of Hermetic Houses (Bonisagus, Guernicus, Mercere, Tremere) made up entirely of those descended in training from a single Founder; cannot be joined later.

name: Ulf
description: An example Bjornaer magus with a wolf heartbeast who communicates with his Great Beast ancestor and is initiated into the Mystery of the Anima, gaining a shadow-wolf inner heartbeast.

name: Unaffected by The Gift
description: A Minor General Virtue: the character is not affected by the negative effects of The Gift or Magical Air in others, even a Blatant Gift.

name: Underworld
description: The realm where the gods of the dead imprisoned the titans, the resentful spirits Tytalus sought out and forged pacts with to oppose Guorna.

name: Ungulus
description: A declining 'Winter' covenant in a carved tower in the Lake District, founded by House Flambeau and later home to a productive Verditius line; filled with magical treasures.

name: Unnatural Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which none of the character's Creo rituals have permanent effect due to the illusory nature of his magic, and he cannot extract vis with Creo.

name: Unpredictable Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character always rolls a stress die when using magic and must always roll at least one botch die, even with Mastered spells.

name: Uther Pendragon
description: Brother of King Aurelius who led fifteen thousand knights to Ireland with Merlin to fetch the stones of the Giant's Ring; he later fathered Arthur at Tintagel while magically disguised as Gorlois.

name: Val Negra
description: A lost covenant of the Provençal Tribunal, one of the first covenants of the Order founded by Flambeau himself, which suffered in the Schism War and whose location is now lost.

name: Val-Negra
description: The original domus magna of House Flambeau in the Pyrenees, founded by Flambeau against the sahirs; it has since sunk deep into Winter and lost Elaine's library.

name: Vendetta
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the magus is engaged in one of House Verditius' vendettas, often inherited from his parens, against another Verditius magus; restricted to Verditius magi.

name: Venditor
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a selling-agent who barters the goods of a Verditius maga to mundane parties, gaining bonus experience in social abilities.

name: Verditius Cult Lore
description: Cult Lore texts of House Verditius; Infernal agents may arrange deliveries of these to propel young magi along their hubristic path.

name: Vision of the Haunting Spirits
description: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 40) with an Imaginem requisite that makes all spirits within a target area visible, including the spirits of living people.

name: Vulnerable Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw whereby the character's magic is automatically dispelled in certain uncommon circumstances (e.g. touching iron, crossing running water); often taken as an Ordeal in Glamour Initiation.

name: Vulnerable to Folk Tradition
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw that makes a magus's magic susceptible to folk-remedies, granting aware targets Magic Resistance based on Magic Lore and allowing enchantments to be broken.

name: Waiting Spell
description: A version of Watching Ward with target Room, well known in the Order, which can contain spells up to the level of the Waiting Spell minus 10 and is also a Ritual.

name: Waldherz
description: A Black Forest covenant founded as a chapter house of Durenmar by the lineage of Hercynius, dedicated to overcoming Hermetic limits with primal magic; destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Wales
description: A poorer, more pastoral land west of England, split in 1220 between Anglo-Norman marcher lords in the south and native Welsh princes in the north.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Air
description: A Rego Auram ward spell (General) protecting a magic circle against faeries of the air, who cannot break the circle or affect those within it.

name: Watching Ward
description: A Rego Vim ritual that holds another spell on a target in suspension until triggered by a specified condition; Flambeau and Tytalus magi commonly use it for vengeance spells.

name: Wayland
description: An invisible smith dwelling at Wayland's Smithy who will shoe a horse left with a penny overnight; legend credits him with forging magical weapons and armor for great heroes.

name: Weak Spontaneous Magic
description: The Major Hermetic Flaw of the Rusticani; they cannot fatigue themselves to boost spontaneous magic, making them dependent on formulaic spells.

name: Weakness
description: A Personality Flaw giving a character an irresistible attraction to something (e.g. books or good food); held by the Spying Maid and Lord of the Manor.

name: Westerwald
description: A broad hilly forest stretching east from the Rhine north of Koblenz, home to the hamlet of Waldheim, the former covenant of Oakdell, and the faerie Court of Bright Winter.

name: Whispering Winds
description: An Intellego Auram unique spell (Level 15) letting the caster hear words spoken by any group within line of sight; an adaptation of an effect known to Bjornaer the Founder.

name: Wings of the Soaring Wind
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 30) with a Rego requisite that generates a gust supporting and propelling the caster through the air at up to 40 mph.

name: Wizard's Sidestep
description: A Rego Imaginem spell in which the caster's image appears up to a pace from their actual position so attacks miss; once the image is struck the caster gains a +9 bonus to Defense.

name: Wizard's Vigil
description: A Ritual spell known free by Mercurian Magic magi at a level equal to their highest Ritual spell, enabling collaborative casting that raises effective spell level.

name: Woden
description: The Norse god who oversaw trade and commerce under the title Farmagud (god of cargoes); a fickle god of magic whose symbols are the spear, raven, and wolf.

name: Worms
description: A famed Rhine city linked to the Nibelungenlied as the Royal Fortress of the Nibelung, ruled by its prince-bishop, with a great cathedral and the largest Jewish settlement in Germany.

name: (Gild) Trained
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue representing training at Durenmar and induction into a Rhine political gild, granting extra experience points appropriate to the gild.

name: Adulteration
description: Impurities from magi's minds made solid by mystical forces, often created during Final Twilight, embodying unresolved psychological issues as creatures or places; the greatest are called malignancies.

name: Aesthetic Quality
description: A score determining how aesthetically pleasing a piece of artwork is, calculated from Dexterity + Craft or Communication + Profession plus bonuses, analogous to a book's Quality.

name: Affinity with Auram
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Tempestaria tradition, granting an affinity with the Auram Art.

name: Affinity with Heartbeast
description: A Virtue granting an affinity with the Heartbeast Ability, gained through Clan Midusulf's Trial of the Sacred Marriage at the cost of a Study Requirement.

name: Affinity with Medicine
description: A Virtue improving learning in the Medicine Ability, possessed by the sample physician Gilles de Corbeil.

name: Age Quickly
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw: due to a curse or magical disaster, the character ages twice as fast as normal and makes two aging rolls each year.

name: Agnes of Irencillia
description: A maga of Irencillia who in 1158 announced a sighting of the Founder Merinita in Bohemia, though little credence was paid to her claim.

name: Air Elemental
description: An elemental being associated with Auram that can be reduced in Might by Perdo Auram or completely controlled by Rego Auram.

name: Alberich
description: A faerie that, according to a Tytalan rumor, Bonisagus really was; the same one as in the Nibelungenlied.

name: Albertus Magnus
description: Born 1206 in Bavaria, the most talented natural magician and philosopher of his time and a Dominican; potentially recruitable into the Order of Hermes and a future saint.

name: Alexander II
description: The king of Scotland who fought on Louis's side and presses for reconsideration of Anglo-Scottish treaties; Louis promised him three northern English counties.

name: Alsia
description: One of Merinita's first apprentices who later joined Quendalon and developed a spell allowing those with Faerie Magic to temporarily bind a familiar.

name: Ambrosius of Merinita
description: Son of the seer Emrys, adopted as Quendalon's apprentice; of strong faerie heritage, he became a master of symbolic prediction and founder of the Heirs to Merlin lineage.

name: Analects of Tytalus
description: A book collating Tytalus's wisdom, speeches, and sayings, compiled by Hariste; every member of House Tytalus owns a copy and apprentices copy it during apprenticeship.

name: Aneirin the Bard
description: A Daimon (Magic Might 15, Imaginem) of one of the five great Welsh poets, famous for the poem Y Gododdin, whose spirit wanders the Cambrian Mountains and can teach Names of Power.

name: Angel
description: Creatures of the Divine Might who act on behalf of God; genderless beings who can manifest in mortal flesh via their Angelic Mantle and are never bothered by The Gift.

name: Aphrodite
description: A goddess of love, a variant of Aphrodite, said by Empedocles to be worshipped by the immortals; some Criamon claim to have met her.

name: Apt Student
description: A Minor General Virtue adding five to Source Quality when being taught or trained.

name: Aquila of Bjornaer
description: An ancient Bjornaer maga of Ungulus who spends most of her time in eagle Heartbeast form over the Lake District and is near Final Twilight.

name: Arcane Lore
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character take Arcane Abilities and gain 50 experience points spent on them; required to learn lores like Infernal or Dominion Lore unless otherwise allowed.

name: Archimagus
description: An elite rank of Hermetic magus; a Tremere Archimagus invented the Lightning-Bringer as his greatest achievement.

name: Ardea
description: A master maga of House Bjornaer holding the Seat of the Swan at Crintera, with a heron heartbeast; a quiet, contemplative seer famous for her foresight and divinatory powers.

name: Arkona
description: A ruined Slavic fortress-temple on the northernmost headland of Rugen, one of the holiest pagan Baltic sites where Svantovit was worshipped; destroyed by Bishop Absolon in 1169.

name: Ars Flambonis
description: A Summa on Ignem (Level 14, Quality 12) written by Elaine as a tribute to her pater Flambeau, sprinkled with anecdotes about his teachings.

name: Artist Reputation
description: A flexible Reputation named after an artist's Craft or Profession Ability that grows with the quality of his work and sponsors, conferring social and supernatural benefits as it rises toward 11.

name: Artistic Renown
description: A Minor General Virtue granting an Artist Reputation of 2 (takeable twice); also a Major Supernatural Virtue version letting a non-Gifted artist study one Hermetic Form.

name: Ashenrise
description: A covenant founded in the Hibernian Tribunal in 1062 by the survivors of Tagelyn after Blackthorn drove them from their caves.

name: Atlas Games
description: The publisher (Trident, Inc. d/b/a Atlas Games) of Ars Magica and this Covenants sourcebook.

name: Aura of Childlike Innocence
description: A MuIm 10 spell, a variant of Aura of Ennobled Presence, that makes the target appear more guileless and naive, granting bonuses to deflect suspicion and to Guile-based debate defenses.

name: Autocrat
description: A single covenant official combining two specialist roles (commonly steward and chamberlain), contributing the loyalty points of both.

name: Avaricious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character hoards money or physical things rather than spending or using them.

name: Averse to Risk
description: A Minor Ordeal Flaw making a Verditius magus reluctant to undertake risky laboratory activities, forbidding experimentation; incompatible with Prone to Chance.

name: Avicenna
description: Author of The Canon of Medicine, quoted as the defining text on medicine as a science of the human body's dispositions.

name: Awakening
description: A Minor Nature Mystery letting nature magi awaken a natural intelligence and Magic Might within subjects of their region, basis for Merinita's familiar-binding ritual.

name: Axis Magica
description: The great pole around which the world's tides of magical energy circle; it is the Founder Criamon himself transformed into a living bridge keeping open the Twilight Road.

name: Baal-Peor, Lord of Filth
description: A demon of wealth and filth (Might 30, Corpus) who creates discord by moving mortal riches disruptively, sprays noxious vomit, and was worshipped as an embodiment of the desire to consume and defile.

name: Baccalaureus
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who completed a three-year university program earning a Bachelor of Arts, with 90 experience points in Latin and Artes Liberales.

name: Baghl, an Earth Jinni
description: An earth jinni (Magic Might 15, Terram) who haunts a dark cave in the Elbruz mountains, able to turn humans to stone and duplicate Perdo/Rego Terram spells; appears as an obese man with a mule's head.

name: Bamberg
description: A bishopric city elevated by Henry II and built on seven hills to rival Rome; its main export is beer, with over a dozen breweries including the ancient Bierhaus.

name: Baneful Circumstances
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character's supernatural nature weakens him in common circumstances, preventing recovery of Fatigue, healing, or Might at those times.

name: Baron Jurgen Schonburg
description: Baron of Sooneck/Oberwesel holding the Schonburg castle; father of the diabolist Robert and of Karlotte, descended from the fae of the Court of Dark Summer.

name: Bartholomew
description: A demon (Might 50, Mentem) appearing as a successful merchant who gives good business advice backed by blessings and curses, subtly leading merchants into sin while winning souls for Hell.

name: Basic
description: A laboratory Flaw present after only the first season of a standard lab's setup, giving a –3 penalty to all Lab Totals until the second setup season removes it.

name: Bavaria
description: A large duchy through which the Danube flows, ruled by Louis of Wittelsbach; only its smaller part north of the Danube belongs to the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Beadle
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed as an assistant to a university dean who carries the university's insignia, collects dues, and announces disputationes.

name: Beast of Minuscule Proportions
description: A Muto Animal spell that shrinks a creature; the appendix notes its description is slightly amended so Initiative is increased along with the listed effects.

name: Beast of Outlandish Size
description: A Muto Animal spell that enlarges a creature; the appendix notes its description is slightly amended so Initiative is reduced along with the listed effects.

name: Beechleaf
description: A green-skinned journeyman of House Merinita at Fengheld, apprenticed at Irencillia by Primus Handri, who was raised by a dryad and is strongly influenced by the fae.

name: Bigamist
description: A major Story Flaw where a merchant lives two entirely separate lives with two spouses and households in two cities, raising annual business costs.

name: Bind Curse
description: A Major Inner House Mystery of Verditius developed by Himinis the Mad for instilling powerful curses into items, requiring the Sever the Ties That Bind Ordeal.

name: Bind Magical Creatures
description: A Major House Mystery developed in the Thebes Tribunal that binds a magical creature's life force to an enchanted device or binds one of its powers to the magus's Gift.

name: Bingen
description: A walled town at the southern edge of the Rhine Gorge where the Nahe meets the Rhine, guarded by Burg Klopp; near the Mouse Tower and home of Hildegard's Rupertsberg monastery.

name: Bingen Hole
description: A hazardous stretch of the Rhine immediately downstream of Bingen, where rocks, accelerating flow, and treacherous eddies make navigation perilous.

name: Bishop Hatto
description: The demonic shade (Infernal Might 30, Mentem) of the greedy archbishop Hatto II of Mainz, who haunts the Mausturm island and attacks with a chilling touch and powers of fear.

name: Black Death
description: A demon appearing as a shrouded reaper, invisible to mundane senses, summoned by an Infernal ritual; it does not exist in 1220 Mythic Europe but arises in 1347 in Constantinople if the saga follows history.

name: Black Sheep
description: A minor Flaw representing estrangement from one's family or social group, likely to inconvenience a principal and lower an agent's Resistance Strength.

name: Black Whisper
description: A spell in which the caster whispers a magic sentence into the target's ear; if completed, the target must resist a Stamina roll or go completely insane.

name: Blood of the Nephilim
aliases: Major Virtue Blood of the Nephilim
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting angelic descent, increased Size, very slow aging, and Dominion Lore, but heavy food requirements and many restrictions.

name: Blunt the Viper's Fangs
description: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 20) that blunts the natural weapons (claws, teeth, talons) of a beast, halving their damage.

name: Bohemia
description: A subject kingdom of the Rhine Tribunal's southeastern lands, ruled by the Premyslid dynasty; a land of forested plains crossed by the River Elbe with few great cities.

name: Bomburkhan
description: A minor imp demon (Might 5, Vim) appearing as a jet-black bat with a human face who punctures the egos of the prideful by granting talents that contradict boasts; released after the fall of Jerusalem.

name: Bordelon, a Personal Tormentor
description: A demon (Might 15, Corpus) appearing as a stern governess who chooses a child as her personal tormentor, crushing ambition and meekness through punishment whenever the child distinguishes himself.

name: Boris of Novgorod
aliases: Boris of Novgorod, Follower of Mercere
description: A well-traveled Russian Redcap of Oculus Septentrionalis who poses as an itinerant merchant, runs the Novgorod Inn in Lubeck, and trades books, items, and vis with magi.

name: Botch
description: A mistake on a spell roll cast under stress that produces unintended, usually detrimental effects and a Casting Total of zero; the number of zeros on the botch dice determines severity.

name: Bound Casting Tools
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus's casting tools, as used by House Verditius, become lasting Arcane Connections to him.

name: Bow
description: The missile-combat Ability used for ranged weapons such as the long bow and short bow.

name: Branches of the Arts
description: The finest summae yet produced for eight of the Arts, given as gifts among covenants because their value cannot be met in kind; the Branch of Terram in 1220 is De Lapii.

name: Break the Oncoming Wave
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 10) that breaks all waves and torrents of water, including magical ones, just before they touch the caster.

name: Breath of Winter
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 15) that turns a circle of water up to five paces across into snow that will not melt until the spell expires.

name: Bridge of Wood
description: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 15) that creates a bridge of living leaves, vines, and wood up to 20 paces long supporting creatures up to Size +4.

name: Brittany
description: A region off whose coast lies the Isle of Ushant; Tytalus made his home there and was likely responsible for its annexation by the Frankish Empire.

name: Brother Julian
description: A deformed Benedictine-raised mendicant friar and companion-level character, member of the Order of Preachers, who preaches against the Cathar heresy in Languedoc and craves academic learning.

name: Brünhild
description: The legendarily strong queen of Iceland in the Nibelungenlied, won for Gunther through Siegfried's deception, whose humiliation leads her to conspire in Siegfried's murder.

name: Bury St. Edmund's
description: A wealthy abbey town in West Suffolk wholly under the abbey's control, founded in 633 by King Sigebert and home to the tomb of St. Edmund, a major pilgrimage site.

name: Byrek
description: A clumsy but tireless grog from the Horse Clan of Crintera who wears a magical horse-bone amulet said to make him as swift and tireless as a horse.

name: Byrek's magical amulet
description: A magical amulet carved of horse bone given to Byrek by his witch mother of the Horse Clan, said to make him as swift and tireless as a horse, though its true power is unknown.

name: Caladrius
description: A magnificent all-white mystical bird of the Magic Realm, sought by royal households, which can draw a non-fatal disease out of a sick person into itself and burn it away by flying toward the sun.

name: Caprea
description: A visiting Bjornaer maga who is a current guest at Crintera, working on a bestiary to present at the next Tribunal. She accidentally blinded the familiar of a visiting Jerbiton magus, Carolus.

name: Carmine
description: A maga of House Flambeau, wife of the Primus of Jerbiton, who prefers Creo Ignem effects and uses a ruby necklace and coral brooch as a ceremonial casting kit.

name: Carolinus
description: Charlemagne's mage-smith, several of whose apprentices were adopted by the Founder Jerbiton.

name: Cascade of Rocks
description: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 40) spell that can do great damage only if an opponent is on a steep hillside or cliff base, used by the School of Vilano; bypasses Magic Resistance.

name: Casting Tools
description: Tools that Verditius magi must use to cast Formulaic and Ritual spells; they can be enchanted via an Inner House Mystery and become permanent Arcane Connections.

name: Castra Solis
description: The domus magna of House Flambeau in the Provençal Tribunal, a modest manor-house covenant founded by Kaeso atop a cave once sacred to Mithras, south of Bordeaux.

name: Castrum Antiquum
description: Covenant founded in 852 in the ruins of a Roman fort on Hadrian's Wall; vanished without trace around 1030/1; home of Agricola of Tytalus.

name: Cathedral School Master
