description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a character who teaches at a cathedral school, requiring scores of 5 in Latin and Artes Liberales and granting 240 experience points.

name: Cathedral of Chartres
description: A cathedral nearing completion in 1220 where the Dreux and Capetian families compete to fund the most beautiful south-transept window.

name: Caudelix the Gaul
description: A ghostly gladiator (Magic Might 20) of the Trier amphitheater, a burly giant of a man wielding a long-handled great axe.

name: Cautious Sorcerer
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus roll three fewer botch dice when casting spells or working in the laboratory.

name: Ceremonial Spontaneous Magic
description: A Minor Flaw possessed by all known members of the Mercurian lineage as part of the Mercurian Magic Virtue.

name: Champagne
description: The pre-eminent fair cycle of Mythic Europe and a financial center, comprising fairs at Lagny, Bar-sur-Aube, Provins, and Troyes, guaranteed safe by the counts of Champagne.

name: Charm Magic
description: A Minor Folk Inner Mystery (Virtue) allowing a Merinita to incorporate charms into her spells, granting Casting Total and Penetration bonuses through sympathetic magic.

name: Charter of the Forest
description: A charter issued in 1217 alongside the Magna Carta reissue, restricting the king's forest rights and limiting forest officials from imposing penalties of life or limb.

name: Childbed Fever Demon
description: A demon with Might 10 (Corpus) that attempts to enter a woman's body during birth, causing fever and rotting of the reproductive organs; its magical attack can be resisted with Magic Resistance.

name: Chiron
description: The figure who warned Jason that the Argonauts would be lost unless Orpheus accompanied them, a prophecy fulfilled at the sirens' island.

name: Chirurgeon
description: A practitioner of chirurgy (surgery, bone-setting, phlebotomy, cautery, midwifery), considered a craft; includes barber-surgeons who assist medici in therapeutic procedures.

name: Chnoubis the Serpent
description: A lion-headed serpent Daimon (Magic Might 30, Mentem) summoned for his abilities to scry and ferret out secrets, claiming to be a native of the Nile.

name: Church of Saint Cyprian
description: A church within Valnastium valley whose presence creates a Divine aura up to 6 and has prevented the covenant's Magic aura from developing further.

name: City and Guild
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook covering craftsmen, guilds, and social statuses, referenced for rules on masons and on Social Status Virtues like Factor.

name: Clan Arelie
description: The 'Remember' clan of House Bjornaer, the most outward-looking and Harmonist (pacifist), preserving stories and teaching of the ancestors.

name: Clan Maruhs
description: The 'Strive' clan of House Bjornaer, romantic, passionate Wilderists known for wildness and as poets and heroes.

name: Clan Midusulf
description: The 'Lead' clan of House Bjornaer, arch-conservative Wilderists most opposed to the Harmonists, with the deepest understanding of the Mystery of the Heartbeast.

name: Clan Sirnas
description: The 'Protect' clan of House Bjornaer, the most active Harmonist clan and protectors of all Bjornaer magi, which absorbed most ninth-century Merinita defectors.

name: Clan Wilkis
description: The 'Nourish' clan of House Bjornaer, Harmonists who strengthen the House, enforce Council decisions, and hunt down those who endanger the House.

name: Cloak of Mist
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 40) with an Auram requisite that turns the caster into a human-sized cohesive mist able to float and seep through cracks.

name: Clouds of Summer Snow
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 25) that creates clouds dropping snow over an area about half a mile across without affecting temperature.

name: Clouds of Thunderous Might
description: A Rego Auram spell (Level 30) that gathers pre-existing clouds and winds into a small storm under the caster's control while they can see it.

name: Clumsy
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character is ungraceful, at -3 on related rolls and rolling an extra botch die on Dexterity actions.

name: Cluniac Order
description: A group within the Benedictines whose houses depend on the abbey of Cluny in France, placing great emphasis on the opus dei and building splendid churches.

name: Cluny
description: An abbey in France that heads the Cluniac Order, a group of monasteries spread across Europe, and which is rich and powerful.

name: Code of Garus
description: The written code of chivalric conduct for the milites, devised by Primus Garus and loosely based on Charlemagne's code for his knights.

name: Coils of the Entangling Plants
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 20) that animates grass and small plants in a field to grab and wrap around the people nearest them.

name: Cologne
description: The largest city of the Holy Roman Empire north of the Alps and the most important trading city in Germany, ruled by its powerful archbishop, home to the relics of the Three Magi.

name: Colomen
description: The leader of the Columbae tradition when it officially joined the Order, who with his wife Gwyndolen adapted their ward-powers to Hermetic magic and spread their spells.

name: Comfort of the Drenched Traveler
description: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 5) that dries a person and their clothes.

name: Comprehend Magic
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability (the defining power of the Lineage of Pralix) that lets a character see, analyze, and understand active magics without penalizing Magic Resistance.

name: Compulsion
description: A Personality Flaw driving a creature toward a behavior; wolves have Compulsion (killing) reflecting their bloodthirsty medieval perception.

name: Confusion of the Numbed Will
description: A spell that confuses a person, who must make an Intelligence roll to take direct action and always strikes last in combat.

name: Conjuration of the Indubitable Cold
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 25) that cools the air within ten paces below freezing, chilling nonliving things thoroughly and costing living things a Fatigue level while shrinking fires.

name: Consumed Casting Tools
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw, only for Verditius magi: the magus's casting tools are magically consumed after use, taking an hour to remake.

name: Corrupt Beast
description: A compulsory Minor Supernatural Flaw for corrupt beasts granting Infernal Might 5, a sinful Personality Trait at +6, a repellent appearance, and the Tainted with Evil Flaw.

name: Corvus of Bjornaer
description: A mature Bjornaer magus of Voluntas with a raven Heartbeast, specializing in Intellego magic and suspected of scrying on other magi.

name: Council of Elders
description: The six-magus governing body of House Bjornaer at Crintera, holding the Seats of the Bear, Wolf, Horse, Stag, Eagle, and Swan, with the Senior Elder holding the casting vote.

name: Court of Bright Winter
description: A Seelie faerie court associated with light, snow, cold, and the hunt, found in midwinter among the high hills of the Westerwald; rival to Dark Summer.

name: Court of Dark Summer
description: An Unseelie faerie court associated with dark, fire, warmth, and agriculture, found in midsummer in the swampy Hunsruck forest west of the Rhine Gorge; rival to Bright Winter.

name: Covenant Lore
description: An Ability concerning knowledge of a covenant; under the Stuck in Your Ways Flaw the character uses the lower of an Ability and his current Covenant Lore for certain Stress Rolls.

name: Cow and Calf Oath
description: An agreement, originating in a Hibernia Tribunal ruling, under which a book purchaser will not sell or freely give copies without the seller's permission.

name: Craft Magic
description: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue of the Rusticani that lets a character build spells and enchanted devices through craft work rather than words and gestures.

name: Cralian of Tremere
description: A magus of House Tremere whose version of Disguise of the New Visage always produces a visage as unassuming as possible.

name: Creative Block
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus has problems creating new things in the lab, taking -3 to Lab Totals unless using a Laboratory Text or being taught.

name: Creeping Chasm
description: A Rego Terram spell that creates a chasm running from the caster's feet toward a target, growing wider as it travels.

name: Crucifixo
description: The current Jerbiton Primus's familiar, a cat of the Black Lineage who is not yet the King of the Cats but may become so when the current king (his mentor) dies.

name: Culhwch Ex Miscellanea
description: A mature magus at Cad Gadu, Gwrhyr's former apprentice turned bully fond of tormenting mundanes; particularly skilled with Ignem.

name: Cult of Mithras
description: An ancient Roman mystery cult worshiping the savior-god Mithras; a remnant magical lineage founded by Kaeso forms the Mithraic tradition within House Flambeau.

name: Curse-Throwing
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability allowing a character to cure diseases and remove curses by transferring them to another person; called Sin-Eating in some cultures.

name: Cyrillus of Argentoratum
description: A ghostly gladiator (Magic Might 20) of the Trier amphitheater, a wiry retetarius armed with trident and net and wearing a mask of Poseidon.

name: Damaged
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is partially damaged, e.g. from an accident, taking one season to repair (-2 General Quality, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Damhadh-Duidsan
description: A tradition of House Ex Miscellanea descended from Damhadh-Duidas who carve Ogam runes to curse, wound, and heal; they try to escape their Infernal past, with Giant Blood common.

name: Daughters of Four Fathers
description: An all-female magical tradition found in north Africa, particularly associated with the Skinchanger (Dove) Virtue.

name: David ben David
description: A wealthy, devout Jewish merchant of Trier who manages a wine shop above the former covenant of Treverorum; suggested as a companion character.

name: David of Dinant
description: A heretic Paris master whose pantheistic, infernal teachings were discovered in 1215; author of the Quaternuli describing the Infernal Virtue Incantation, who fled the city.

name: Death Prophecy
description: A Major General Virtue placing a supernatural condition on a character's death so that, until met, they cannot die of wounds or old age.

name: Deficiency
description: A Hermetic Flaw imposed when a master opens an apprentice's Arts while having a score below five in an Art; inflicting it is normally a Low Crime.

name: Delusion
description: A Flaw representing false belief; Criamon magi do not have it because their cosmological errors cannot be demonstrated within the game setting.

name: Demonic Steed
description: A corrupt beast (Might 7, Animal) appearing as a fearsome black stallion with iron hooves, unimpeded by poor terrain; one of three created by an Infernalist magus using a tainted Steed of Vengeance spell.

name: Dependant
description: A minor Flaw representing someone who depends on the character; can be used as a hostage or leverage to dominate an agent.

name: Depiction of the Waking Dream
description: An InCrMeIm 35 enchanted effect in the Mirror of Dreams that makes a subject's thoughts visible as images around his head, aiding Mentem lab work.

name: Devil Child
description: A type of Mythic Companion created by powerful demons as weapons in the conflict between Heaven and Hell; tragic figures with Hellish powers but free will.

name: Diabolic Past
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character was once associated with diabolists and is still haunted and watched by former associates.

name: Difficult Underlings
description: A Story Flaw representing a fractured relationship with one's agents; acquired when a non-magus principal recruits an agent of higher social standing, applying to dealings with that agent.

name: Disceptator
description: The chairman and spokesman of a covenant's Council of Members, a rotating mandatory office held by full members serving seven-year terms.

name: Discern Own Illusions
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell that makes the caster's own illusions appear largely transparent but still discernible.

name: Disenchant
description: A Perdo Vim ritual that permanently strips a Hermetic magic item of all its powers, destroying its enchantment and invested vis.

name: Disguise of the Putrid Aroma
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 5) that makes a targeted animal take no interest in the caster as long as concentration is maintained.

name: Dorana
description: A master maga of House Bonisagus at Fengheld, foremost of the lineage of Irmele filia Trianoma in the Tribunal, who argues for rationality but cannot stand her prima Murion.

name: Doublet of Impenetrable Silk
description: A Muto Animal spell (Level 15) that changes an item of silk, wool, or leather so it cannot be cut or penetrated by weapons, granting a Soak bonus.

name: Drachenfels
description: Dragon's Rock, a famous legendary site (Magic aura 3) with catacombs where the hero Siegfried slew the dragon Fafnir; crowned by Schloss Drachenfels owned by the archbishop of Cologne.

name: Dripstone
description: A brownish wax-feeling enchanted stone (chalcedonius) harvested from Pfalz Island; worn around the neck it lets the wearer perceive illusions, discern truth, and resist the Loreley's song, and is worth 1 pawn of Imaginem vis.

name: Durenmar Lore
description: An Ability reflecting a magus' familiarity with the contents of the Great Library, addable to study rolls there with a cumulative penalty.

name: Durham
description: The site of the cathedral of St. Cuthbert on a high hill in a loop of the river Wear; a palatinate center of pilgrimage and resistance to the Normans.

name: Dust to Dust
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 15) that turns a dead body or mindless undead to dust in two rounds; does not affect undead possessed by spirits.

name: Eadric Wilde
description: A lord who captured and married a faerie woman, becoming famous and being summoned to London by King William Rufus; he lost her when he reproached her about her sisters.

name: Earth Elemental
description: An ancient elemental summoned by a now-fallen covenant to tend a cavern rock garden; mourning his lost water-elemental love, he yearly carries an engraved rock outside that yields Aquam and Terram vis.

name: Earth Shock
description: A Terram spell that mimics an earthquake, cited as an example where the material cause (earth) determines the Hermetic Form.

name: Earth That Breaks No More
description: A Muto Terram spell that turns a volume of packed dirt up to ten cubic paces into stone.

name: Ebroin
description: The relatively young current Primus of House Ex Miscellanea, elected after Immanola entered Final Twilight, with ambitions to revitalize the House from Cad Gadu.

name: Edward the White of Jerbiton
description: A magus skilled in the magic of the sea, famed for unsuccessful attempts to find Atlantis, who leads The Single Ocean league from his enchanted ship.

name: Elaine
description: Flambeau's second apprentice, a Frankish girl who became a Hoplite, Archmage, and scholar; she trained four apprentices and authored several enduring books.

name: Elemental Magic
description: A Major, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus manipulate the elemental Forms (Aquam, Auram, Ignem, Terram) as a connected whole, sharing experience among them.

name: Embrace of Boethius
description: A Perdo Mentem 35 ritual spell that damages a magus's mind, heart, and Gift, forcing reliance on casting tools, used to initiate other Hermetic magi into House Verditius.

name: Empedocles
description: An ancient philosopher whose teaching underlies Criamon thought; the Gorgiastics are named for a student who turned against him, and one Sufi school reveres him as a hierophant.

name: Empiricus
description: A character specializing in one surgical or medical procedure, often itinerant; a derogatory term used by the literate medical profession for the unlearned.

name: Employed by Company
description: A minor Story Flaw for salaried employees answerable to an employer but backed by the company's resources; suits characters working primarily for a salary.

name: Empty
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has a large amount of unused space, costlier to maintain; taken per two points by which Size exceeds occupied Size.

name: Enchant Casting Tools
aliases: Enchant Casting Tools — Minor House Mystery
description: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius allowing a magus to enchant his casting tools to mirror mastered spell effects and grant casting bonuses.

name: Envious
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character believes others undeservedly have it better and tries to ruin their lives.

name: Eric
description: A reckless magus of House Tytalus and co-founder of Waddenzee, a Danish generalist who favors Aquam and Auram and embraces the pirate lifestyle.

name: Eunuch
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a sexually incapable male educated to serve Byzantine nobility as courtier, steward, scribe, or accountant.

name: Experimental Philosophy
description: A system of 'natural' magic that produces wondrous effects through the intrinsic power of the subject rather than any arcane force, using contagion, affinity, similarity, hidden virtues, astrology, ligatures and formulae.

name: Eye of Hephaestus
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a craftsman innately tell the quality of a manufactured item by touch, including whether it is flawed or magical. Called the Eye of St Dunstan for Christian characters.

name: Eyes of the Bat
description: A Hermetic spell whose vision is mimicked by the Eyes of the Bat creature Quality, letting a beast see as magi do under that spell.

name: Eyes of the Treacherous Terrain
description: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster intuitively tell if any natural terrain they see is treacherous, such as a rock field prone to sliding.

name: Faerie Hounds
description: Huge faerie dogs (Might 5, Animal) that haunt the roads of Mythic Europe, terrifying and sometimes killing travelers, often with shining eyes and powers like Enthralling Sound and Fearful Flaming Eyes.

name: Faerie Knight
description: Faerie warriors (Might 10, Corpus or Terram) bound to the rules of chivalry, found on lonely roads and guarding bridges, who seek defeat by humans to gain additional combat Pretenses.

name: Failed Journeyman
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character expelled from his guild for illegal practices, unable to practice his trade legally, with a bad Reputation of 2 in town.

name: Failed Master
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character who ran his workshop into the ground and must work as a journeyman, with a bad Reputation of 4 in town.

name: Failed Student
description: A Minor Story Flaw for a character who studied for a university license but failed the final examination, gaining a Bad Academic Reputation of 2.

name: Falkes de Breaute
description: A powerful commoner-noble who professes loyalty to the king while disregarding central government; holds custody of the earl of Devon's lands and disputes manors with the earl of Pembroke.

name: False Power
description: A Major (or repeatable Minor) Supernatural Tainted Flaw in which one of the character's Supernatural Virtues is also associated with the Infernal realm, making it appear unholy.

name: Farrago Bonisagi
description: A maga of House Bonisagus in the late 1000s who joined House Merinita to research faerie powers and discovered the three faerie cords (leaden, iron, and tin) for binding faerie familiars.

name: Felicia
description: A freshly Gauntleted journeyman maga, filia of Dorana of Fengheld and a descendant of Trianoma in the lineage of Irmele, who works weather magic and travels the Tribunal.

name: Fenicil
description: The Primus of House Guernicus and the Order's most famous historian, who claimed the tradition of magic was eternal and reputedly rediscovered some lost Mercurian rituals.

name: Fenistour
description: A figure who invented casting tools allowing Verditius magi to cast Formulaic spells; her filii later developed methods of enchanting those tools.

name: Ferramentum of Verditius
description: A magus of House Verditius whose wizard's sigil makes his spells very orderly, seen in his versions of The Cloudless Sky Returned and Curse of the Rotted Wood.

name: Fickle Nature
description: A Minor Personality Flaw causing the character to swing between two directly opposite personality behaviors with no middle ground.

name: Fidaʾi
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for an assassin of the Nizari Isma'ilis trained in daggers and disguise, prepared to die on the sect's orders.

name: Fimus, Warrior Demon
description: A warrior demon (Might 10, Terram) made of solid rock with one eye, controlling earth and exploding on death; one of many identical brother-demons used as foot-soldiers by other demons.

name: Flash of the Scarlet Flames
description: A Creo Ignem spell that explodes a brilliant red flash in the air, able to temporarily or permanently blind a target who fails a Stamina roll; Rose of Jerbiton's version smells of roses.

name: Florence
description: A great Italian city founded by Julius Caesar in 59 BC, with a developed cloth and banking industry, dominated by noble tower societies and the feud between the Guelphs and Ghibellines.

name: Fluctuating Fortune
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character alternates yearly between the Wealthy Virtue and the Poor Flaw in opposition to his needs.

name: Focus Power
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting a supernatural power with a narrow range of effects, like a magical focus, with a 25-point pool for effect level and Penetration.

name: Folk Magic
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue allowing minor magic via a chosen (Realm) Lore in one of four areas: Abjuration, Divination, Healing, or Evil Eye.

name: Followers of Pendule
description: A House Merinita lineage and Mystery Cult descended from Pendule's followers who Initiate the illusion Mysteries of Spell Timing, Glamour, and Perpetuity.

name: Font of Knowledge
description: A Supernatural Ability allowing a creature to attempt a task with any untrained ability as if it had a score of 2 by succeeding in an Ability check.

name: Footsteps of Slippery Oil
description: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 5) creating nonflammable grease from the caster's footsteps, leaving a slick area that forces Dexterity rolls.

name: Foreign Upbringing
description: A Minor Personality Flaw marking the character as a foreigner from a remote corner of Mythic Europe with odd customs and a foreign Native Language.

name: Fountains Abbey
description: A great Cistercian abbey in Yorkshire, founded in 1132 by monks from York and a daughter house of Clairvaux, motherhouse of a wide filiation.

name: Freiburg
description: The largest settlement around the Black Forest, founded in 1120 by Conrad Zähringen, lying in the valley of the River Dreisam with a cathedral under construction.

name: Frightful Presence
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character instill dread or awe, forcing witnesses to make Brave Personality rolls.

name: Galen
description: The ancient authority on medicine since whom chirurgy has held a less prestigious position; quoted on the distinction between knowledge by experience and by reason.

name: Garus
description: The current Primus of House Flambeau in 1220, an aging former soldier-of-fortune and tournament champion who leads the milites and authored the Code of Garus.

name: Gather the Essence of the Beast
description: A Touch-range, Momentary Vim spell that concentrates the raw vis in a corpse into one removable part, letting a magus gather vis without carrying entire corpses.

name: Gender Shift
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character change genders each midnight, with consistent male and female forms.

name: Generous
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character willingly gives away property to anyone who desires it.

name: Genius Locus
description: A spirit embodying and protecting a particular forest, formed from the fragmentation of the great Hercynian Forest spirit; each has a Might score, Personality Traits, and Special Powers.

name: Genoa
description: A north Italian city-state whose merchants rival Venice's and who have seeded the East with trading colonies that act as resupply points and friendly wartime ports.

name: Gentle Touch of the Purified Body
description: A Corpus spell that, under these rules, heals a Minor disease instead of a Light Wound caused by disease.

name: Gilles de Corbeil
description: An 80-year-old master physician and archiater (chief physician) to King Philip Augustus of France, born in northern France in 1140, who trained at Salerno under Petrus Musandinus and wrote famous summae on urine and the pulse in hexameter verse.

name: Gorlois
description: Lord whose stronghold was Tintagel and whose wife Ygerna Uther Pendragon desired; Uther was magically disguised as him to father Arthur.

name: Great Communication
description: A Virtue held by Brogo giving him exceptional Communication, contributing to his songs' Aesthetic Quality.

name: Great Lezi
description: A powerful faerie (Might 40, Herbam) of Slavic lands appearing as a tall pale bearded man who commands woodland animals and can change into any plant or animal and vary its size enormously.

name: Great Presence
description: A Virtue boosting a character's Presence Characteristic; one of Falke's Virtues.

name: Greater Benediction
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting a major blessing from a supernatural power, with examples such as Flight, True Sight, and Universally Liked.

name: Greater Power
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting an at-will supernatural power equivalent to a Formulaic Hermetic spell of level 50 or lower.

name: Greek Fire
description: A sticky, flammable substance that cannot be extinguished by water, used by the Byzantine navy from siphons and catapult pots to incinerate enemy vessels; its manufacture is a closely guarded secret.

name: Gremlins
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is home to deliberately disruptive creatures, spirits, or demons (-3 Safety, +1 Warping, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Griffin
description: A famous legendary chimera; also a Mythic Blood lineage granting the Panic of the Elephant's Mouse feat and a Focus in Courage.

name: Grip of the Choking Hand
description: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 25) that makes the target feel an invisible strangling hand on the throat, losing a Fatigue level each round.

name: Grudge
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character holds a strong grudge against someone in his normal social circle and seeks to outdo them.

name: Guardian Angel
description: A Major, General Virtue giving a character a divine watcher who offers spiritual advice and can grant +5 Soak and Magic Resistance 15.

name: Guardian of Nature
description: A Mystery (Virtue) a Vestal may learn at her second level of Initiation, joining her spirit with a Faerie aura while she remains a virgin to become a civic deity.

name: Guardians of the Forest ruling
description: A landmark Rhine Tribunal ruling of 1053 permitting magi to actively defend wilderness areas; cited in disputes over Crintera's defense of Rugen.

name: Gubich
description: A morose dwarflike spirit of the Harz who dwells in moss-covered caves, can control the weather, and sometimes leads travelers astray; possibly the dwarf king.

name: Gudrun Tigurina
description: A Verditius maga at Durenmar known as the inventor of the Crystal Custodian.

name: Guest of House Criamon
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue making a magus a political member of House Criamon while being created with another House's rules.

name: Guild Apprentice
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a youth aged 10 to 20 learning a trade from a guild master or journeyman under contract.

name: Guild Dean
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for the ultimate authority of a guild who decides important guild matters and represents it politically.

name: Guild Master
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a guild master who may legally practice his trade, hire journeymen, and participate in guild activities.

name: Gullible
description: A Minor Personality Flaw giving a -3 penalty on Guile or Perception rolls to determine truth, from the character's isolation and inexperience.

name: Gunther
description: The Burgundian king of Worms in the Nibelungenlied, who marries Brünhild with Siegfried's help and is later beheaded by Kriemhild in Hungary.

name: Gunther Lupus
description: A magus of House Bjornaer, filius of Eule, with the heartbeast of a wolf; he perpetuates the fraud of Eule's wisdom and forms a team with the hoplite Indulius hunting oath-breakers.

name: Gwrhyr Ex Miscellanea
description: An old, blustering Columbine magus who owns the Cad Gadu island, holds a seat on the Council of Four, and whose death threatens the covenant's land tenure.

name: Gyongy
description: A sorceress and former fellow of Bjornaer's shapeshifting tradition who condemned Bjornaer for joining the new Order of Hermes.

name: Hands of the Grasping Earth
description: A Rego Terram spell where earthen hands rise from the ground to grasp the target's ankles, requiring a Strength roll to break free.

name: Heartbeast (Ability)
description: The Bjornaer Ability gained alongside the Heartbeast Virtue, scoring the strength of the transformation and added to Lab Totals for Sensory Magic.

name: Heat of the Searing Forge
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 10) that heats a piece of metal too hot to touch, doing decreasing damage over rounds to anyone in skin contact with it.

name: Hedyosmos
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal built in a labyrinth of caves of increasing Magic aura, rumored to hold a gateway to the Magic Realm or Underworld, whose magi are famed for magic of earth, the dead, and curses.

name: Heir
description: A Minor Story Flaw in which the character stands to inherit land and money, but others may try to remove him from the line of succession.

name: Helvius
description: A paranoid magus of House Tremere specializing in ice magics who resides in an underground cavern lab by an underground lake.

name: Henry II
description: A former king of England whose reign featured William Marshal's early career, the Henry of Essex duel, and afforestations later restricted by the Charter of the Forest.

name: Henry the Lion
description: The greatest Welf ruler in living memory, duke of both Saxony and Bavaria, stripped of most estates by Frederick Barbarossa; he beautified Brunswick.

name: Hephaestion
description: An example Verditius magus, five years out of apprenticeship, used to illustrate enchanting casting tools for the spell The Crystal Dart.

name: Herbalism
description: A unique General Ability granted by the Herbalism Virtue that substitutes for Medicine in diagnosis, prognosis, and disease recovery, allowing cure of diseases without formal medical training.

name: Herbwife
description: The poor man's answer to the apothecary; usually a woman who maintains a village's health with preserved garden products and often acts as local midwife.

name: Hercynian Forest
description: The vast primeval forest of Germany described by Caesar and Pliny; its single powerful spirit was fragmented by the Cult of Mercury and St. Boniface into many genii loci.

name: Hermetic Arts
description: The fifteen Techniques and Forms of Hermetic magic, which can be opened in a character with The Gift and advanced through study from vis, books, or teaching but not by simple practice.

name: Hermetic Haruspexes
description: An ancient Roman tradition of House Ex Miscellanea who reveal omens by inspecting entrails of sacrificed animals; produced Primi Basilicus and Immanola.

name: Hermetic Prestige
description: A Virtue granting a magus a Hermetic Reputation; the free benefit of House Guernicus and taken by Darius to reflect his standing in the Order.

name: Hidden Defect
description: A laboratory Flaw that may be gained on a botched Refinement roll or spotted and corrected on a sufficiently good roll while increasing Refinement.

name: Hidden Shape
description: An aspect of the heartbeast whereby, due to the Limit of Essential Nature, a transformed Bjornaer appears as a mundane animal to magic.

name: Highly Organized
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab's contents are optimally arranged (+1 General Quality); gained by improving Refinement and lost in major accidents.

name: Hildesheim
description: A splendid cathedral city of northern Germany famed for its civic buildings and churches, raised to greatness by St. Bernward, whose crypt lies in St. Michael's church.

name: Himinis the Mad
description: An 11th-century Verditius magus who developed the Inner Mystery of making cursed items and founded the Confraternity of Himinis the Mad.

name: Hippocrates
description: The ancient physician associated with naming epilepsy the 'sacred disease' (the Falling Evil).

name: Hipta the Nurse
description: A powerful shapechanger Daimon (Magic Might 15, Animal), the nurse of Dionysus, who favors the form of a dove and is invoked for forgiveness from curses and magical harm.

name: Holy Magic
description: The Major non-Hermetic Virtue of the Karaites tradition, drawing power directly from the Divine.

name: Holzfrau
description: German wood-wife faeries with Faerie Might 20, spirits of vegetation usually beneficial to mankind, able to control plants and heal; associated with particular plants like dryads.

name: Honos
description: A Roman Daimon (Magic Might 30, Corpus) of morality and military honor, appearing as a young warrior with a lance and cornucopia, able to instill Leadership and produce a magical feast.

name: Horsingas
description: A covenant in the Loch Leglean Tribunal founded by Saxon magi determined to oppose the Normans, using Mentem magic to cover their tracks.

name: Hospitallers
description: A crusading military order referenced alongside the Templars whose brother knights wear white surcoats.

name: House Acclaim
description: An informal Hermetic Reputation system by which Flambeau magi measure relative prestige, gained for deeds of valor and lost for ignoble acts or inactivity.

name: House Bjornaer Lore
description: The Organization Lore Ability giving knowledge of House Bjornaer's legends, history, structure, magics, and its Exoteric Mystery and Cult of Ancestors; primarily orally transmitted.

name: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults
description: The sourcebook covering the four magical Houses built around specific Mysteries (Bjornaer, Criamon, Merinita, Verditius).

name: Houses of Hermes: Societates
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook whose Tytalus chapter details House Tytalus' debate system.

name: Hubert de Burgh
description: The justiciar (since 1215) and third member of the regency, responsible for day-to-day administration; an astute politician and brave military leader who defended Dover and won the sea battle against Eustace.

name: Hunt for the Wild Herb
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 5) that lets you smell one sort of plant and follow its scent, requiring a sample of that plant.

name: Iacob
description: The most politically active magus of Irencillia, leader of the Elder Gild and apprentice of Handri; a master of Mentem magics running a secret project to establish a fae religion, identified as the Prophet of the God of Truth by his white crow caricature Nestor.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: A Tribunal of the Order of Hermes where the Keepers of the Thousand Tales maintain dedicated covenants.

name: Icilius the Traitor
description: A 12th-century Verditius magus of the Normandy Tribunal who released the Inner Mystery Automata to the Order of Hermes and was hunted down and slain by Wizard's War.

name: Illusion of Cool Flames
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 10) that makes a source of heat seem to lose its heat and drop to surrounding temperature, while it still has its normal beneficial and harmful effects.

name: Illusion of the Misplaced Castle
description: A Rego Imaginem ritual (Level 50) that moves the image of any bounded structure the size of a castle or less up to one mile from its actual position.

name: Illusion of the Shifted Image
description: A Rego Imaginem spell (Level 10) that makes any person or object appear a pace away from its actual position; the spell ends as soon as the original or image moves.

name: Image Phantom
description: A Muto Imaginem spell (Level 20) that makes any one thing, including a living thing, appear as something else of approximately the same shape and size.

name: Image of the Beast
description: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 5) that gives a hazy mental image of an animal to which the caster has an Arcane Connection, useful for identifying an attacker.

name: Incantation
description: An Infernal Supernatural Ability granting the Unholy Method: Incantation, described in David of Dinant's heretical book Quaternuli with a Quality of 13.

name: Incomprehensible
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is almost unable to convey knowledge, halving the Advancement or Lab Total of anyone learning from him or his books.

name: Inconstant Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making the character's magic easily distracted and unresponsive, interrupting constant magic-item effects at sunrise and sunset and imposing a Finesse penalty.

name: Independent Study
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character develop new skills extremely quickly on his own, adding bonuses to Practice and Adventure Source Quality.

name: Induction
description: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting the power to make people experience things that are not there, conferring the Induction Ability at 1.

name: Indulius
description: A magus of Fengheld and master of Richenda Spinosa, whose bungling scarred her Gift and left her unable to use fire magic.

name: Ingasia
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal of which Verditius Primus Stouritus is a member and which he would like to become the domus magna.

name: Ink of Hermes
description: An alchemical ink mentioned in many alchemical texts, made from myrrh, Karian figs, Nikolaus dates, pine cones, wormwood, wings of the Hermaic ibis, and spring water.

name: Inscribed Shadow
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw causing a character's stigmata to be reflected as glowing symbols in their shadow, alarming nonmagicians and easing stigma-reading.

name: Inspirato
description: The flux of harmony and strife from which spiritually nourished Criamon magi draw sustenance instead of food, and through which path-of-seeming magi swim to view distant places.

name: Intuition
description: A Minor, General Virtue giving a natural sensitivity to make the right luck-based decisions on a secret die roll of 6+.

name: Inventive Genius
description: A laboratory Virtue that, when held by an assistant or researcher, applies to the primary researcher's efforts; it also adds three to insight-investigation rolls.

name: Invested Device
description: An enchanted item prepared with Vim vis and then instilled with magical effects in the laboratory; variants include lesser enchanted devices and charged items, and an invested device lasts years as an Arcane Connection.

name: Ipswich
description: The chief town of Suffolk with about 300 burgesses, granted a charter in 1200 by King John giving it a court, toll exemption, and a merchant guild monopoly on milling.

name: Irmele
description: The third filia of Trianoma, a tempestaria who recruited in German lands and founded the wandering weathermage lineage that still persists in the Rhine.

name: Isaac
description: A Jewish shopkeeper, nephew of David ben David, who runs the wine shop in Trier above the former Treverorum covenant and knows nothing of magi.

name: Item Attunement
description: A Major House Mystery letting a magus attune a greater enchanted item like a talisman, then sever the connection, leaving a Covet Device personality trait in the device.

name: Jesus Christ
description: The Son of God who became human, whose death (the Crucifixion) paid the penalty for all human sins and who rose from the dead in the Resurrection; in the Mass the bread and wine become His Body and Blood.

name: John of Salisbury
description: A clergyman and author of the Policraticus, the standout text on politics distinguishing a prince from a tyrant.

name: Judged Unfairly
description: A Minor General Flaw in which people universally distrust and underestimate the character, preventing him from gaining a positive Reputation.

name: Juliasta filia Criamon
description: Criamon's successor as Primus and the first follower of the Winding Path; she shared the House's knowledge with outsiders and prepared the House for its journey.

name: Jumayl, A Jinni Guide
description: A faerie jinni of the jann (Might 15, Vim), a mercenary caravan guide wandering the Levant and beyond, able to change into a white Bactrian camel and susceptible to mundane alcohol.

name: Jurist
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who is a judge, advocate, or procurator, able to purchase Latin, Artes Liberales, and Civil and Canon Law.

name: Kalliste
description: Filia of Tasgillia who exposed her mater's diabolism and became the fifth Prima of House Tytalus; Tytali regard her exposure of Tasgillia as the "Betrayal" of the Founder's principles.

name: Karaites
description: A tradition of Karaite Jews with The Gift who practice Holy Magic and may join the Order so long as their magic comes directly from God.

name: Karlotte
description: Red-haired daughter and heir of Baron Schonburg with strong faerie blood; she lies in a coma after being attacked, and the fae of the Court of Dark Summer hold her cure.

name: Kloster Maria Laach
description: A Benedictine monastery beside Laach Lake founded in 1093, with a Divine aura of 4 and a paradise-like gardened courtyard re-creating the Garden of Eden.

name: Knights of the Sword
description: A military order founded in 1202 by Albert von Buxhövden, bishop of Riga, to crusade against pagan tribes; based at Fellin in Livonia and active in Pomerania, they control the slave trade and are notoriously brutal.

name: Koblenz
description: A fair-sized city where the Mosel joins the Rhine, owned by the archbishops of Trier; home to St. Kastor church and a Teutonic Knights chapter house.

name: Kolazonta, the Chastiser
description: A Divine angel (Might 30, Ignem) tasked to chastise the faithful for their failings, appearing as a dark cloud or man of white fire; he brought the plague upon the Israelites for rebelling against Moses.

name: Kolkrabus
description: The devious raven familiar of Murion that spied at Crintera and taunts Stentorius, believing he has usurped Murion's role as leader of the Oak Gild.

name: Kriemhild
description: Sister of King Gunther and wife of Siegfried in the Nibelungenlied, who avenges Siegfried's murder by orchestrating the deaths of Gunther and Hagen.

name: Laborer
description: A free Social Status Virtue for a trained worker who provides a valuable service without producing a finished good, using a Profession Ability rather than a Craft.

name: Larta
description: A category of unGifted person afforded protection and tutelage by a Hermetic House; Hildegard of Bingen is cited as a Larta maga of House Jerbiton.

name: Lasiq
description: A Major, Social Status Virtue for an experienced Nizari Isma'ili assassin who has completed seven murders and commands a small band of fida'is.

name: Latent Magic Ability
description: A Minor, General Virtue indicating an unmanifested magical quality, more limited than The Gift, that may appear spontaneously.

name: Latent Magical Ability
description: A Virtue granting uncontrolled magical talent; Torven's Latent Magical Ability causes wolf packs to come to his aid in the forest.

name: Latin Empire
description: The crusader-created state ruling Constantinople after the 1204 sack, the weakest of four powers feuding over the Balkans, whose Latin Emperor cares more for his home Flanders than the City.

name: League of Iconophiles
description: The most powerful of the eastern Empire's transient magical leagues, formed to oppose Emperor Leo III's destruction of religious icons; its members are the ancestors of House Jerbiton.

name: Leap of the Fire
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 10) that causes a bonfire to leap up to 10 paces in any direction, catching if there is fuel; a Targeting roll lets it deal +10 damage to a target.

name: Lecherous
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character seeks sexual contact with as many people as possible.

name: Legion of Mithras
description: A 13th-century mystery cult reconstruction of the ancient Cult of Mithras that teaches additional powers via Initiation; Castra Solis's shield grogs may serve it as Auxiliaries.

name: Leprosy, Hermetic
description: A Critical Melancholic Disease caused by Hermetic spells, a rapid hideous wasting disease with a pungent rotting smell.

name: Lesser Benediction
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting a minor blessing from a supernatural power, with examples like Gift of the Gab, Green Fingers, and Pricking Thumbs.

name: Lesser Enchanted Item
description: A category of enchanted device requiring the Lab Total to be at least double the effect's modified level and to which Effect Expiry cannot be applied.

name: Lesser Power
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting one or more at-will supernatural powers equivalent to Formulaic Hermetic spells of total level 25 or lower.

name: Lifting the Dangling Puppet
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that lifts a person of Size +1 or less vertically into the air.

name: Light Touch
description: A Virtue improving fine manual work; held by the Craftsman template and offered as an alternative for the Spying Maid.

name: Limit of Arcane Connections
description: A Hermetic limit concerning the use of Arcane Connections; a Touch-range spell on a room does not violate it even when affecting unseen people within.

name: Limits of Magic
description: The fundamental boundaries constraining Hermetic magic; Major Breakthroughs push them, Hermetic Breakthroughs break Lesser Limits such as the Limit of Magic Resistance.

name: Livonian Order of the Knights of the Sword
description: A crusading military order formed in 1202 in Pomerania and Livonia to fight Baltic pagans; reprimanded and subsumed into the Teutonic Order in 1237.

name: Lord Marsyne
description: A faerie lord (Might 50, Aquam) ruling an ice castle in the far north, who entombs people in ice, grants youth, and always takes a beautiful young human wife who must come of her own free will.

name: Lord Robert Schonburg
description: Bastard son of Baron Schonburg and a diabolist who collects unjust tolls from Pfalz Island; an infernalist villain who casts ritual-like spells using Infernal Lore.

name: Louis of France
description: The French prince who invaded England with an army in the civil war and controlled much of southern England before being driven out by William Marshal as regent.

name: Low Self-Esteem
description: A Flaw common among Bjornaer magi who were catuli (apprentices ordered around) for most of their apprenticeships.

name: Lower Lorraine
description: The lower half of the ancient kingdom of Lotharingia, fractured into counties and duchies including the rival duchies of Brabant and Limburg, with forested uplands of the Ardennes and Eifel.

name: Lucca
description: A city in northern Italy granted a charter by Henry IV in 1081, overthrown in a commune revolt in 1115, which has since conquered neighboring lands and rivals Pisa.

name: Lucian
description: An elder House Merinita magus of the covenant of Aegea in the Theban Tribunal, renowned for knowledge of Byzantine and ancient Greek literature and rumored initiated into story magic.

name: Luck
description: A Minor General Virtue granting +1 to +3 on rolls in situations governed by luck rather than skill, making the character do well at games of chance.

name: Ludold
description: The white-haired elder of Waldheim, a lesser hedge wizard and cunning man who creates minor potions and charms; father of Torven.

name: Lumen of Jerbiton
description: A young Jerbiton maga and obsessive bibliophile responsible for Schola Pythagoranis's library, who owns a ring that makes her appear as a man.

name: Lunar Sphere
description: The lowest of the celestial spheres carrying the heavenly bodies around the stationary Earth in Mythic Europe's medieval physics; it is also the limit of the power of Hermetic magic.

name: Lupersus
description: A Divine creature (Might 20, Animal) appearing as a noble silver-gray wolf sent by God to guard a holy hermit, provide food, and lead those in need to him; not an angel.

name: Lupus (the Wolf)
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed by a university to ensure students speak only Latin, holding keys to the students' housing.

name: Lutisse
description: A very slight (Size -1) maga of House Ex Miscellanea who resides in a faerie-glamour-shrouded treehouse at the edge of a faerie forest.

name: Magi of Hermes
description: An Ars Magica supplement containing 15 fully statted magi at various ages, usable as NPCs or player characters.

name: Magian Lineage
description: A Minor or Major General Virtue making the character a true blood descendant of the Median tribe of Magians, the original priestly caste of Persia, granting bonuses to aging and disease resistance.

name: Magna Carta
description: The great written charter of English liberties, settled at Runnymede; its 1217 reissue is enforceable in court even against the king and constrains royal power.

name: Magvillus
description: The domus magna of House Guernicus, in the Roman Tribunal, where Prima Bilera resides.

name: Maintain the Demanding Spell
description: A Vim spell cited as not eligible for the Rebuttal Mastery special ability.

name: Maintaining the Demanding Spell
description: A Rego Vim spell that automatically maintains a concentration-requiring spell already cast for the duration of this spell, without the caster needing to concentrate.

name: Male Guild Sponsor
description: A free General Virtue allowing a female character to participate in any guild by attaching to a male relative's name on the roster.

name: Malocchi
description: A tradition of Italian magi within House Ex Miscellanea who practice the magic of Entrancement and are believed to bring terrible luck with their gaze.

name: Mamluk
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a former military slave bought as a child, trained at a military school and educated in Islam, then freed on adulthood.

name: Manufactured Ignorance
description: A Minor Story Tainted Flaw in which a group of minor demons sustains the tainted character's delusion by arranging supporting fortunate occurrences.

name: Many Marriageable Daughters
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has many daughters and must participate in stories to marry them off suitably.

name: Marcus the Valiant
description: The ghostly gladiator leader (Magic Might 20) who haunts the Trier amphitheater, equipped as a hoplomachus and challenging visitors to duels to the death.

name: Marius of Tremere
description: A magus of House Tremere whose version of Ball of Abysmal Flame causes the ball to make a loud bang on impact; his magical sigil is a gaudiness in his spells.

name: Master Bard
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a character who has spent at least nine years at an Irish bardic school and is a master of the trade, called an Anruth.

name: Master of (Form) Creatures
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a character tame animals and unintelligent beings whose Magic Might is aligned with a particular Form.

name: Masterpiece
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a Verditius magus to keep the lesser enchanted item he made to pass his Gauntlet, with vis costs ignored.

name: Mateos, the Faerie Butler
description: A child-sized faerie (Might 10, Herbam) who lives for drunken parties, serving intoxicating drinks from an endless barrel and encouraging people to embarrass themselves.

name: Matilda
description: A noblewoman trained in warfare who championed the Pope during the Investiture Controversy and led armies that all but destroyed Imperial authority in Northern Italy; an example of political-success-based female power.

name: Mattieus of Cherson
description: A historically important twelfth-century Primus of House Jerbiton who believed Jerbiton magi should serve as ambassadors to the mundanes.

name: Maximianus of Bonisagus
description: An ancient, widely respected Bonisagus master of Corpus magic and prolific author who founded Nigrasaxa to break the cycle of invalid tribunals.

name: Mazdean Priest
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for an ordained Mazdean priest, initiated as a mobed, who performs Zoroastrian rituals and tends sacred fires.

name: Meddler
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character wastes time and energy trying to fix other people's lives, who usually resent it.

name: Medicus
description: A general term for a practitioner who may perform medicine or surgery but has no formal claim to the higher title of doctor; the majority of practicing physicians.

name: Mentored by Demons
description: A Minor General Tainted Virtue letting a character learn Abilities faster than possible with human teachers, though demons only teach what suits their plans.

name: Merchant Adventurer
description: A minor Social Status Virtue for a character in command of a ship and crew with sufficient capital for a cargo, though possibly with substantial debts.

name: Merinugalaudabila
description: A Novgorod maga leading a nomadic family of faerie Merinitae who delights in certamen as a sport and has fostered interest in magical competition and dueling styles within the House.

name: Merovingians
description: A dynasty of Christian wizard-kings descended from the Holy-Grail-bearing Merovech and the Gifted Clovis; their corruption within seven decades is one proposed Divine cause of the Curse.

name: Method Caster
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting a +3 bonus to the Casting Total of any Formulaic or Ritual spell, lost if the caster varies from his precise method.

name: Mighty Torrent of Water
description: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 20) that sprays a jet of water at a target, dealing damage and potentially sending them flying back.

name: Milo
description: Second apprentice of Verditius who combined Boethius's philosophy with Germanic runes to invent Verditius Runes and discovered Hephaestus's torture chair at Ravenna.

name: Mind of the Beast
description: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 30) with an Animal requisite that turns the target's mind into that of an animal of the caster's choice, with the victim acting like that animal.

name: Missing Eye
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character cannot judge close distances easily, penalizing missile, targeting, and melee attack rolls.

name: Mistaken Identity
description: A Major Story Flaw in which someone who looks exactly like the character commits violent or embarrassing acts, forcing him to deal with the consequences.

name: Montverte
description: A covenant in the Normandy Tribunal occupying a castle with curtain walls and mural towers, which it shares with its mundane lord and uses as a base for raiding permitted by that tribunal's Peripheral Code.

name: Moonbeam
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 3) that causes a gentle reading-bright light to shine down and illuminate the area encircled by the caster's arms.

name: Mount Etna
description: A volcano on the island of Sicily beneath which the fire spirit Adranus slumbers; believed by the ancients to hold a gateway to the Underworld, it last erupted in 1194.

name: Mount Radhost
description: A 3700-foot summit in Moravia, site of a crude stone temple to Radegast with a Magic aura of 6 (secretly Infernal), where a great festival fuelled by human sacrifice yields vis for Roznov's magi.

name: Muqta
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for an important emir entrusted with an iqta', a feudal-like fief, following the Landed Noble rules.

name: Mustard Plaster
description: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Moderate, a linen cloth with ground mustard seeds that grants +3 to Wound Recovery rolls for Medium and Light Wounds by drawing out choler.

name: Mute
description: A Major General Flaw in which the character cannot speak; magi with this Flaw take a -10 penalty to all spellcasting unless offset by the Quiet Magic Virtue.

name: Mythic Herbalism
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability that lets a character create healing unguents, poultices, virulent poisons, and physical-bonus potions.

name: Nasir
description: A minor angel of the Divine realm (Divine Might 25, Corpus) charged with the safety of pious travellers, who aids those in need before vanishing. He has powers such as Calming Touch, Spirit Form, Steadying Hand, and Subtle Form.

name: Nibelungenlied
description: The great epic poem of the tragic fate of the Burgundian people, immortalizing Siegfried, Kriemhild, Gunther, and Hagen, treated as true history in Mythic Germany.

name: Nizari Isma'ilis
description: An order of assassins, far from whose home fida'is and lasiqs are sent on missions; fida'i and lasiq Social Statuses are drawn from this sect.

name: Notes of a Delightful Sound
description: A Muto Imaginem spell (Level 10) that causes all sounds in a room, particularly music, to be especially clear and sonorous.

name: Nuntius
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a messenger charged with delivering messages, mail, and donations between students and families, employed by a university nation.

name: Obese
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is large due to fat, giving -1 to rolls involving quick or graceful movement and -3 to Fatigue rolls.

name: Object of Increased Size
description: An enchanted item whose effect makes an object larger; a faculty's possession of one sparks a violent university debate over whether size is substance or quantity.

name: Obsession
description: A demonic power tied to a particular sin which the demon may impose upon a mortal indulging in a venial sin, granting the victim a sinful Personality Trait.

name: Odorpes
description: A maga of House Bjornaer and filia of Urgen, sole inhabitant of Fengheld's Lusatia chapter, who spends most of her time as a bear and hibernates all winter.

name: Offensive to (Beings)
description: A Minor General Flaw causing a chosen class of beings (humans, demons, or divine beings) to react badly to the character; known among Merinitae as the Tin, Iron, and Leaden Gifts.

name: Order of Suleiman
description: A legendary organization of Islamic magi, rivals in power to the Order of Hermes, said to be the association of the non-Hermetic sahirs with close ties to Levantine rulers.

name: Order of the Hospitalers of St. Anthony
description: An order established in 1095 and named after a fourth-century Egyptian hermit; it knows a ritual to exorcise the St. Anthony's Fire demon and maintains houses across Europe with a chapter house in London.

name: Orphic Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting Orphic magoi access to the additional Range Adelphixis, using emotional connections as Arcane Connections.

name: Oswald
aliases: Saint Oswald, King of the Northumbrians
description: A most Christian king of the Northumbrians (633-642) who raised a cross before battle and won; many miracles and healings occurred at the cross and at the sites of his death and burial.

name: Outlaw Leader
description: A minor Social Status Flaw that grants a character an agency of criminal underlings prior to play; listed with a Resistance of -1 on the Resistance of Agents Table.

name: Pack Mentality / Follower
description: A Minor Personality Flaw making the character a follower rather than a leader who tends to stick with a decisive person.

name: Pallas
description: A maga whose death left her lover, a nymph of unmatched beauty, in inconsolable mourning, leaving a covenant tower unused for sixty years.

name: Pandulf
description: The Papal Legate in England, elected bishop of Norwich in 1215 but not yet consecrated, who serves as regent for the young king and in theory outranks both king and archbishop.

name: Panic of the Elephant's Mouse
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 15) that makes an animal afraid of the target, causing it to flee by the quickest means.

name: Parching Wind
description: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 20) that removes most water from an object, and with a Corpus or Animal requisite can damage humans or animals while making them thirsty.

name: Parting the Waves
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that parts a body of water, revealing a dry path five paces wide along the bottom.

name: Partner
description: A major Social Status Virtue for a character with a large financial stake in a wealthy company, providing minor-noble-level income and the ability to act in any company role except capo.

name: Passion's Lost Feeling
description: A spell that renders the target unable to feel any emotion, leaving them listless and without motivation.

name: Past of Another
description: A Muto Mentem ritual (Level 35) that completely rewrites the target's memories so they cannot remember their actual life until the effect is dispelled or expires.

name: Perceive the Change
description: An InAn 14 constant enchantment effect detecting whether an item touches an animal, used to trigger linked size/shape effects when a Bjornaer transforms.

name: Perdo Vim
description: A Hermetic Technique-Form combination of destruction and magical power; Perdo Vim spells that reduce Might can kill a legendary artist.

name: Perfect Eye for (Commodity)
description: A minor general Virtue letting a character always accurately assess the value of one commodity and products made from it, granting extra Labor Points when trading exclusively in it.

name: Perfectus
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for one of the leaders of the Cathar heretics in southern France, sworn to preaching and ascetic abstinence.

name: Personality Trait
description: Short descriptors of a character's personality with scores from -3 to +3 (e.g., Brave, Loyal), used as roleplaying guides and for some rolls.

name: Peter Abelard
description: A famous scholastic logician who taught at the cathedral school of St Geneviève in Paris; held two heretical theories condemned by Bernard of Clairvaux and exemplifies both good and bad Academic Reputation.

name: Peter des Roches
aliases: Peter des Roches, Bishop of Winchester
description: The bishop of Winchester (since 1205) and member of the regency triumvirate, a wealthy French-born warrior-bishop and former tutor of the king, contemptuous of Magna Carta.

name: Pfalz Island
description: An island in the center of the Rhine that formerly housed the covenant of Rheinstein (Magic aura 2), with a ruined castle, a dripstone-bearing rocky spine, and currently occupied by Lord Robert Schonburg.

name: Phantasm of the Human Form
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 25) that makes an image of a clothed, equipped person that can move, speak, and behave as a human under the caster's unspoken command.

name: Phantasm of the Talking Head
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 10) that creates an illusory face on a wall or flat object that can speak during the spell's duration.

name: Phantasmal Animal
description: A Creo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that creates an image of any animal up to pony size that moves under mental command and makes appropriate noises and smells, but has no effect on touch.

name: Philip of France
description: The king of France who expelled John from Normandy in 1204 and besieged Ghent; forced to abandon plans to invade England after William de Longespee's naval action at Damme.

name: Phoenix
description: A legendary bird whose ashes provide a powerful Shape and Material bonus (+11) to rejuvenation and regeneration enchantments.

name: Piercing Shaft of Wood
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 10) with a Rego requisite that turns a piece of wood into a barbed shaft that flies at a target and cannot miss but is resisted.

name: Piercing the Faerie Veil
description: An Intellego Vim spell that lets the caster see through the boundaries of Faerie regiones and find the path to the next level.

name: Plagued by Angel
description: A Story Flaw in which a character is troubled by the attention of an angel; held by the Priest companion and possible for Devil Children.

name: Plato
description: The philosopher whose advocacy of training women for all duties of the state, including warfare, underlies the Order of Hermes's position of equity for women.

name: Plentarch
description: An ancient Mercurian high priest who gathered 38 Mercurians at Pompeii and taught them a ritual allowing them to commune with their gods in concert.

name: Pomerania
description: A sparsely-populated realm of Slavic peoples between the Baltic Sea and Poland, bordering the Novgorod Tribunal; part of the Holy Roman Empire since 1181 and a region of contention with werewolves and the Knights of the Sword.

name: Pompeii
description: The Roman city where the high priest Plentarch gathered 38 Mercurians to teach them the ritual of concerted communion with their gods.

name: Poor Strength
description: A Flaw possessed by Brother Julian reflecting weak physical strength.

name: Portunes, Spirit of Safe Harbor
description: A Daimon spirit (Magic Might 25, Auram) charged with ports and harbors, keys and locks, worshipped as a god in Rome; summoned by throwing keys into a fire.

name: Possession
description: A demonic power by which a demon places Might into a human host (an energumen), taking direct control of the victim and able to use powers through them.

name: Powerful Relic
description: A Major General Virtue granting ownership of an unusually powerful relic with a True Faith score of 3 and one agreed power.

name: Południca
description: A faerie (Might 10, Auram) appearing as a maiden, crone, or girl with a scythe who appears at noon on hot days, asking farmhands difficult questions and inflicting heatstroke if they fail to answer.

name: Preservative
description: A Level 10 alchemical Reagent, a tarry substance that when painted onto wood proofs it against rot, mold, and pests, making about two gallons.

name: Prestigious Student
description: A Minor General Virtue for the son of a nobleman or prosperous merchant matriculated at a university with retainers, trained in Artes Liberales and Latin by a private tutor.

name: Prevailing Loyalty
description: A game measure of how loyal a covenant's covenfolk are overall, derived from a Base Loyalty (driven by the magi's Gifts) modified by living conditions, treatment, and events.

name: Primogeniture Lineage
description: A Minor Story and Hermetic Flaw in which the character is in line for Primus of House Verditius, receiving undue attention and political enmity; only available to Verditius magi.

name: Profession (Merchant)
description: A Profession Ability in which traders and factors are skilled, eligible for Affinity, Cautious, Puissant, and other modifiers.

name: Profession: Boating
description: A Profession Ability for navigating rivers; needed (Ease Factor 9) to safely pass the treacherous Loreley stretch of the Rhine.

name: Profession: Steward
description: A Profession Ability for managing a household or manor; held by the Spying Maid, Lord of the Manor, and Lady of the Manor, and used to calculate a Steward specialist's loyalty bonus.

name: Protection
description: A Minor General Virtue placing the character under the aegis of a powerful noble or Church official, granting a Reputation of level 3.

name: Puissant Intrigue
description: A Virtue granting a bonus to the Intrigue Ability, taken by the Political Agent template.

name: Pukis, Dragon of the Hearth
description: A lesser Daimon (Magic Might 10, Ignem) first summoned by Baltic wizards, taking the form of a small fire dragon that dwells in a hearth, leaving gifts but causing mischief if mistreated.

name: Pull of the Skybound Winds
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 30) that makes winds rise upward, pulling an object, creature, or person up to 50 feet into the sky before dropping it.

name: Purification of the Festering Wounds
description: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 20) granting a +9 bonus to Recovery rolls if maintained throughout the recovery interval.

name: Queen of Faerie
description: A faerie ruler in the Maddenhofen Woods of Bohemia whom the Founder Tytalus entered to challenge, never to be seen again.

name: Queen of the Faeries
description: A faerie ruler from whom Tytalus claimed he would win his "heart's desire" in the Maddenhofen Woods; rumors say Tytalus may one day win free from her and return.

name: Rabbi
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for an ordained Rabbi, teacher and wise man of the Jewish community, who must take the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

name: Rabbinic Law
description: An Academic Ability, the Jewish version of Civil & Canon Law, drawn from the Talmud, the Oral Torah, and the Responsa of the Geonim.

name: Rain of Stones
description: A Muto Auram spell (Level 20) that turns falling rain into small stones causing minor damage; the stones revert to water when the spell expires.

name: Realms of Power: Magic
description: An Ars Magica sourcebook containing rules for training magical animals and for creating magic-realm characters such as legendary artists.

name: Rebuttal
description: A Mastered Spell special ability applicable to Muto or Rego Vim spells affecting another being's magic, adding three times Mastery score to the spell's effective level.

name: Recognize Your Master
description: An InCo 5 enchanted effect in the Door of Deimos that checks whether a toucher matches an arcane connection and, if not, triggers the door's repelling effect.

name: Rector/Proctor
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is the representative leader of his faculty or nation at a university and is responsible for his colleagues' behavior.

name: Red-Hame
description: A faerie wolf with Faerie Might 12 and a ruddy neck and back; the messenger of the Winter Court who accompanies Torven and conveys the court's wishes to Waldheim.

name: Refrigerant Salt
description: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent whose salt-like crystals freeze water when scattered on its surface, creating a sheet of ice up to six paces in diameter.

name: Repel the Intruder
description: A CrMe 15 enchanted effect in the Door of Deimos that forces anyone who fails an Intelligence roll to flee in terror; has a high Penetration Total.

name: Repel the Wooden Shafts
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 10) that deflects a single blow of any wooden weapon up to the size of a two-handed club, making the attack automatically miss.

name: Repose
description: House Criamon's alternative to death, a paradisaical state of blessedness reached at the end of each path of Initiation, often delayed by magi out of compassion.

name: Requisite
description: An additional Art required to cast certain spells, demanding greater knowledge of the caster and limiting the Arts usable; includes casting requisites.

name: Restoration of the Defiled Body
description: A Corpus spell that can remove any Flaws resulting from a disease, with a higher guideline needed to negate Flaws caused by life-saving surgery.

name: Restricted Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw limiting the use of a normally at-will supernatural power, requiring a ceremony or restricting it to certain targets or circumstances.

name: Revenant
description: A restless dead being whose only form is an animate material corpse, animated by a spirit and connected to the living world through an overwhelming personal need; difficult to harm with weapons and immune to Incapacitation.

name: Rhine League
description: An alliance founded by Mainz and Worms (and joined by cities, archbishops, and nobles) to suppress unjust tolls by trade sanctions and destruction of robber-baron castles along the Rhine.

name: Rhine Lore
description: An Area Lore Ability covering the Rhine region; held by several characters including Lord Robert, Wolkan, and David ben David.

name: Richard de Marsh
description: The Bishop of Durham (elected 1217), chancellor and creature of King John, greedy and unscrupulous, embroiled in a quarrel with the monks of his cathedral priory.

name: Ride
description: An Ability used when employing an animal as a mount, which can substitute for Animal Handling and adds to Attack and Defense in mounted combat.

name: Rigid Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character cannot use vis when casting spells, thus cannot boost spell rolls or cast Ritual magic, though vis can be used in the laboratory.

name: Ring of Warding Against Spirits
description: A Rego Mentem spell creating a ring that only ghosts and spirits with Magic Might higher than the spell's level can enter.

name: Ring/Circle Magic
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Columbae, letting them draw circles faster and treat any well-defined boundary as a Circle by marking it.

name: Robert Grosseteste
description: A brilliant scholar and official of the bishop of Hereford, born 1170, who is an unGifted natural magician acquainted with the magi of Schola Pythagoranis though he declined to join.

name: Robert de Courtenay
description: Sheriff of Devon who refused to surrender the shrievalty to Falkes de Bréauté, claiming he should have had the wardship of the heir.

name: Robes of Dusty Dawn
description: Enchanted lavender-rose robes covered in chalk markings that protect against natural and supernatural threats; the symbol of the Primus Ex Miscellanea, given to Pralix by the Columbae.

name: Rock of Viscid Clay
description: A Muto Terram spell that softens rock so it can be dug out, molded, and manipulated like hard river clay.

name: Roots of the Arts
description: Basic summae texts for nine of the Arts, accepted as the preferred primers for a magus seeking competence to train an apprentice, widely and cheaply available.

name: Rose of Jerbiton
description: A magus of House Jerbiton credited with a version of Flash of the Scarlet Flames that leaves a faint odor of roses where the flash explodes.

name: Rosh Beth Din
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for the head who presides at the Beth Din rabbinic court, requiring high Hebrew, Rabbinic Law, and Theology: Judaism.

name: Rudesheim
description: A Rhine town on the right bank opposite Bingen, site of the ruined covenant of Rudiaria and the Bromserburg castle; named after the covenant or archbishop Rudbrecht.

name: Sanguine Humor's Blessing
description: A Major General Virtue granting bonuses to rolls based on a character's True Feeling Story Flaw, drawing on emotional bonds; the defining Virtue of Orphic magoi.

name: Satan
description: The tempter who led Adam and Eve to sin in the Garden of Eden, bringing about Original Sin; the devil to whom an evil lord might sell his soul for infernal powers.

name: School of Apromor
description: A versatile school of magical combat within House Flambeau built on the Technique of Perdo, emphasizing destruction, indirect attacks, and multiple Forms; one of the most study-intensive schools.

name: School of Boreas
description: A narrowly defined Flambeau combat school relying on the single Perdo Ignem combination, using cold and darkness; developed by the magus Boreas to bridge the Flambeau and Apromor lineages.

name: School of Ramius
description: A Flambeau combat school that ignores Magic Resistance by using mundane physical attacks supported by magical enhancements, emphasizing defense and Parma Magica; created by Ramius.

name: School of Vilano
description: The most commonly used Flambeau combat school in the Order, relying on indirect attacks that bypass Magic Resistance; created by the magus Vilano and requiring no specific Arts.

name: School of the Founder
description: A Flambeau combat school based on the magic of Flambeau himself, broader than Boreas and favoring the Form of Ignem, requiring penetration of Magic Resistance.

name: Schooled in Crime
description: A Minor General Virtue granting 50 extra experience to spend on Abilities related to thievery such as Stealth, Legerdemain, and Guile.

name: Scinnfolk
description: Gifted Companions in the Order, herb-wives and faerie doctors with eclectic natural magic and faerie charms passed down orally; not a true systematic tradition.

name: Scitalis
description: A large slow-moving Magical serpent (Might 5, Animal) with spectacularly colored scales that can stupefy onlookers with its Dazzling Appearance and whose fangs drip venom; its hot blood keeps it active in winter.

name: Scrying
description: Magical remote observation of others; the Haunt of the Living Ghost spell is noted as not constituting scrying by magic since others can see the caster.

name: Seal the Earth
description: A Creo Terram spell that creates enough dirt to fill in a pit up to 6 paces across and 3 paces deep.

name: Secret Name
description: A Bjornaer Minor House Mystery that severs and reforges a magus's sympathetic name, expiring all old Arcane Connections and invalidating all Sympathetic Connections against him.

name: Secretive
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character keeps secrets from his sodales, rarely explaining what he is doing or why.

name: See in Darkness
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a character see in complete darkness, though without more acute or longer-range eyesight than normal.

name: Seeker
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is a self-proclaimed member of the Seekers, a loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts.

name: Seekers
description: A loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts, detailed in Houses of Hermes: True Lineages.

name: Seelie Court
description: A faerie court of higher rank; a Seelie maid disdained the faerie Tulgank and her court caused him to meld with his cavern floor.

name: Seferiel
description: An angel of the Divine realm (Divine Might 50, Corpus) with special responsibility for Hermetic magi, sometimes drawing them closer to God and sometimes acting as the instrument of God's vengeance. He can duplicate any Hermetic effect and is the suggested antagonist for the Plagued by Angel Story Flaw.

name: Selkie King
description: A faerie figure whose drowned bride a sea mist may be the ghost of, and who comes ashore to find a bride.

name: Senior Bard
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who spent five or six years at an Irish bardic school, ranked Cano or Cli, with a Local Reputation of 2.

name: Senior Clergy
