description: A Major Social Status Virtue for an archbishop, bishop, abbot, abbess, or other senior Church member with access to Church resources and a Reputation of level 4.

name: Senior Master
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a prosperous, authoritative guild master who may own multiple workshops, serve as a guild official, and govern guild affairs.

name: Sense of the Lingering Magic
description: An Intellego Vim spell that detects many magical residues, even from weak spells, and the presence and power of active spells.

name: Serlo Le Mercer
description: The mayor of London in 1220, holding all judicial and fiscal authority within the city.

name: Shadchan
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a marriage arranger trusted by parents to find the best matrimonial match for their children.

name: Shamash
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for the servant of the synagogue responsible for its well-being, cleanliness, and announcements, requiring the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

name: Shape and Material Bonuses
description: Bonuses to magical and philosophical lab work derived from natural principles of affinity, similarity and sympathy; provided by ingredients and used by both magi and philosophers.

name: Shape of the Woodland Prowler
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 25) with an Animal requisite that transforms the target into a wolf via a wolf skin; the target may change back at will.

name: Short-Ranged Magic
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw halving Casting Totals when not touching the target and halving Lab Total for effects with range greater than Touch.

name: Shriek of the Impending Shafts
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 15) that warns of incoming wooden objects via a shriek, granting +9 Defense against wooden weapons.

name: Sicero
description: A recently Gauntletted 23-year-old Journeyman follower of House Tremere at Triamore, filius of Goliard, who secured membership on his mater's recommendations.

name: Sicily
description: The Mediterranean island beneath whose Mount Etna the fire spirit Adranus dwells, whose inhabitants once worshipped him as a god of fire.

name: Sight of the Active Magics
description: An Intellego Vim spell that lets the caster see spells as colored, shaped auras around things and people, indicating Form and Technique.

name: Sihr
description: The Major Non-Hermetic Virtue (an Accelerated Ability) of the sahirs used to summon jinn and empower bargains that bind them to service.

name: Silence of the Smothered Sound
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that makes one being or object incapable of producing sound; magi so affected suffer spellcasting penalties for being unable to speak their words.

name: Simple Student
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a university student who has not yet taken a degree, gaining 30 experience points per finished year toward Latin or Artes Liberales.

name: Sir Giles, a Ghostly Knight
description: A magical ghost (Magic Might 16, Mentem) of a prideful knight in black mail who haunts his former lands, able to materialize, turn invisible, and ride a phantom black destrier.

name: Sirmium
description: The last Hermetic covenant in Meissen, destroyed in the 10th century by invading Magyars; its known vis sources were destroyed along with it.

name: Slothful
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is lazy and indolent, constantly seeking excuses to avoid work.

name: Snap of Awakening
description: A spell that instantly awakens the target from sleep to alert consciousness when the caster snaps their fingers.

name: Sofer
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for the scribe who creates or repairs a Sefer Torah, requiring the ability to read and write Hebrew and the Educated (Hebrew) Virtue.

name: Soft-Hearted
description: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character cannot bear to witness suffering and avoids danger, valuing life and health above important goals.

name: Soothe the Raging Flames
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 20) that eradicates the heat of a bonfire so the flames do not spread or harm anything beyond what they already burned.

name: Spasms of the Uncontrolled Hand
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 5) that makes one of the target's hands spasm, causing them to drop whatever is held.

name: Species
description: The sensory emanations of objects manipulated by Imaginem magic; transforming species lets sounds be seen and changing species bouncing off a mirror changes mirror images.

name: Spell Foci
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a rustic magus incorporate a small casting tool into spells to add a shape/material bonus to the Casting Total.

name: Spell Timing
description: A Minor Illusion Mystery of the Followers of Pendule granting new spell Durations (Held, Midday/Midnight, Season, While/Not/If Condition) and recurring spell effects.

name: Spharios
description: The conscious sphere/mind of the universe at the moment of complete harmony, to which followers of the Path of Walking Backwards may ascend and rejoin in repose.

name: Spirit Votary
description: A Mythic Companion type: a devoted worshiper of a magical spirit who in pre-Christian days would have been a high priest forming a venerating cult, now typically a solitary pagan figure opposing the Dominion.

name: Spiritual Pact
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue for a character who has made a pact with a powerful Magical spirit, gaining access to a Might Pool from the spirit by spending Confidence.

name: Spontaneous Casting Tools
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character must use casting tools to cast spontaneous spells, with 15 tools one for each Art; only available to Verditius magi.

name: Spotless
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is impeccably clean, requiring a season's work and maintenance (+1 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Creo).

name: St Paul
description: A grog used in the complex combat example, on patrol with Gerard and Ignatio into a faerie forest where faeries create duplicates of them.

name: St. Albans
description: An abbey whose immunities Falkes de Bréauté violated by killing a fleeing monk and extorting money, before later doing penance there.

name: St. Dunstan
description: Patron saint of metalworkers, locksmiths, and embroiderers; a tenth-century English Benedictine monk, Abbot of Glastonbury and later Archbishop of Canterbury, and namesake of the Eye of St Dunstan.

name: St. Francis of Assisi
description: Founder of the Franciscan order of friars (the followers of St. Francis), founded in Italy in 1209; he visited Acre during the Crusades before departing for Venice in 1220.

name: Station
description: One of five grades of progress on a Criamon path - psychological states providing wisdom and supernatural Mystery Virtues, reached by following an avenue.

name: Stench of the Twenty Corpses
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that creates a horrible stench of rotting corpses, penalizing and potentially incapacitating those nearby.

name: Stigmata
description: Intricate skin markings of Criamon magi representing spiritual development and progress toward enlightenment; they appear and migrate as Enigmatic Wisdom grows and cannot be removed by magic.

name: Stigmatic Catalyst
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's presence causes symbolic marks to appear on nearby people lacking Magic Resistance; normally found among House Criamon magi.

name: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
description: A spell that allows a magus to converse with a rock, invoked in debates over whether inanimate objects possess minds.

name: Stone of Bacchus
description: A weathered finger of rock jutting from the Rhine near Baccharach on an island with a Magic aura of 2; locals believe touching it brings luck to the wine harvest, and its festival wine becomes hallucinogenic Muto vis.

name: Story Flaw
description: A category of Flaw that drives stories; factors may uncover a target's Story Flaws of varying obscurity through intrigue.

name: Story Magic
description: A Major Folk Mystery (Virtue) allowing a maga to influence the story of her own life through story charms that bring about myth-like circumstances.

name: Stouritus
description: The current Primus of House Verditius and member of the covenant of Ingasia in the Theban Tribunal, who does not live at the domus magna Verdi.

name: Strike of the Angered Branch
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 15) that causes a large tree branch to swing at a target repeatedly for +10 damage.

name: Strings of the Unwilling Marionette
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 25) that lets the caster control the physical movements of a conscious person.

name: Strong Faith
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting a +2 to social rolls with faeries and Common Sense in faerie-related situations.

name: Strong Willed
description: A Virtue gained through Clan Sirnas's Trial of Self Control, alongside Deleterious Circumstances when hungry.

name: Student of (Realm)
description: A Minor General Virtue giving training in the mystical aspects of one of the four realms of power, with a +2 bonus on uses of the appropriate Lore.

name: Suffusio
description: A Serious Melancholic Disease, a congregation of humor between lens and pupil obstructing sight; treated by 'couching'.

name: Summoning the Distant Image
description: An Intellego Imaginem spell that lets the caster see and hear what is happening in a distant place via an Arcane Connection to the location or a person there.

name: Sursum
description: Covenant founded in 875 on the north coast of Cornwall, destroyed during Athelstan's campaigns in 931 amid evidence of Tytalus diabolism.

name: Susceptibility to Faerie Power
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is especially susceptible to the fay, becoming disoriented in Faerie auras and having Magic Resistance halved against faerie effects.

name: Symbolic Magic
description: A Major Folk Mystery (Virtue) encompassing laboratory activities with charms and symbols, allowing charms in invested devices and talismans and new Symbol Range, Duration, and Target for ritual spells.

name: Synthemata Magic
description: A Mystery whose practitioners, knowing a magus's secret name, gain an advantage when casting spells against him.

name: Tabanus
description: A Quaesitor of House Guernicus, trained at Magvillus, sent to police the Rhine; a strict, meddlesome peregrinator who recently occupied a sanctum at Triamore.

name: Tagelyn
description: A covenant that, with Blackthorn, excavated caves in the Black Mountains over two centuries; its magi were driven out by Blackthorn and founded Ashenrise in Hibernia.

name: Tainted Treasure
description: A Minor General Tainted Virtue: the character has inherited or acquired vast cursed treasure that brings harm and only allows itself to be spent sinfully.

name: Talons of the Winds
description: A Muto Auram spell (Level 20) that transforms a wind into an abrasive medium that tears at everything in its path, inflicting +4 damage from cuts; requires an existing breeze.

name: Tangential Magi
description: Criamon magi who have faded peacefully into Final Twilight and dwell in the Hypostasis outside time, sending visions through the Axis to their mortal successors.

name: Tangle of Wood and Thorns
description: A Rego Herbam (ReHe 15) indirect spell that immobilizes a magus with wood without touching him, completely effective in bypassing Magic Resistance.

name: Tarlan the Wolf
description: A faerie wolf (Might 20, Animal) that exists to hunt people, marking them as quarry and harrying them to exhaustion; he cannot enter holy ground and never hunts children or the Gifted.

name: Templar Commander
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for a commander of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon with authority over a province or preceptory, also granting Temporal Influence.

name: The Ash of Nortorf
description: An infernal entity (Infernal Might 15, potential 60) manifesting as an ash seedling in the churchyard of Nortorf; prophesied to grow into a tree that will bring a king with fell powers if a black horseman defeats the white horseman.

name: The Brocken
description: The highest peak of the Harz and one of Germany's most potent supernatural sites, topped by the Witches' Altar and a focus of Walpurgis Night witchcraft, with a Faerie aura.

name: The Buran of Yenghissar
description: An Infernal desert storm spirit and corrupt jinni (Might 25, Auram) that manifests as a vortex of black sand, plaguing the village of Yenghissar and now bound within a sahir's ancestral sword.

name: The Captive Voice
description: An Imaginem spell that a magus can vary to collect a poet's spoken poem, the captured words acting as an Arcane Connection to the poet until the spell ends.

name: The Collegium
description: A Hermetic societas of about a dozen Platonist magi from different Houses, founded by Xenophon of Bonisagus, dedicated to investigating the nature of magic through experimentation and Philosophiae.

name: The Crystal of a Hundred Candles
description: An enchanted crystal embedded in the ceiling of Arliandus's sanctum that blooms into light to illuminate the whole chamber when the door opens.

name: The Donar Oak
description: A divine spirit (Divine Might 40) at Geismar, formerly the focal point of the pagan power of the Hercynian Forest; its acorns are worth Creo vis and can tame animals and forests.

name: The Door of Deimos
description: An enchanted iron door created by Arliandus and named after the son of Ares, embossed with faces and skulls and invested with effects that recognize and repel intruders.

name: The Drudenbaum of Harberg
description: A mythical tree spirit (Magic Might 30) atop the Harberg near Nuremberg where wizards meet; its golden drops are Creo vis and its milk is Vim vis, and it possesses trees to assume its form.

name: The Earth's Carbuncle
description: A Rego Terram spell (with Muto requisite) that turns a 1-pace circle of ground into jagged stone that bursts upward, throwing those standing on it.

name: The Enigma's Gift
description: A Creo Vim spell that inflicts four Warping Points on a target and forces a Hermetic magus to check for Twilight.

name: The Falling Evil
description: A Major General Flaw in which the character suffers random convulsions and blackouts, leaving him temporarily Incapacitated, often caused by demonic possession.

name: The Fane of the Founders
description: A powerful artifact in a hidden Black Forest glade, a twelve-sided stone slab into which the Cult of Mercury bound much of the forest's magical essence; site of the secret seven-yearly rite renewing the Founders' vows.

name: The Forest Brothers
description: Three pagan gods of Rugen, Rugevit, Porevit, and Porenitz, representing the Rowan, the Beech, and the Larch, still worshipped by male priests called volkhvy.

name: The Forgiving Earth
description: A Rego Terram spell that loosens earth in a 15-by-15-pace area to a depth of one foot, making packed dirt as loose as plowed ground.

name: The Forum of Hermes
description: An enclosed miniature amphitheater at Durenmar, built on a Roman temple and flanked by statues of the Twelve Founders, where Rhine and Grand Tribunals meet.

name: The Gastronomers
description: A large Jerbiton league whose members take turns hosting annual lavish feasts and who organize the great feasts including the Tribunicals and Seculars.

name: The Gift (Virtue)
description: Referenced as a Virtue covered later in the rules that allows characters to learn Supernatural Abilities and is the most important exception to Ability-use restrictions.

name: The Gift of Reason
description: A Creo Mentem ritual (Level 35) that permanently increases the target's Intelligence by 1 point, to no higher than 0.

name: The Gift of Vigor
description: A spell whose variants a magus attempts to use to transfer vital faculty (bodily energy such as fatigue) from a living being into a dead one.

name: The Glade of the Seven Waterfalls
description: A magical glade deep in the Black Forest with Magic Might 80, the remnant of the forest's original genius locus, whose peaceful spirit allows only those who complete Quests to ascend each of its seven waterfalls (regio levels).

name: The Harz Mountains
description: A desolate fifty-mile granite mountain range in northern Germany with gloomy forests, caves, and dwarflike folk; home to many supernatural sites.

name: The Heathen Witch Reborn
description: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger that reverses any shapechanging spell or supernatural Ability if the spell level +10 beats the shapechange.

name: The Holm Oak of Romowe
description: A malevolent magic spirit (Magic Might 45, currently 30 due to entrapment) bound within a massive evergreen oak in the sacred grove of Romowe; it can grant the Depression Flaw and possess those who take its branches.

name: The Holy Grail
description: The sacred relic brought to Gaul by Mary Magdalene and revealed by Clovis to the Frankish kingdom, later lost when the Merovingian dynasty fell from grace.

name: The Humble Brethren
description: A Jerbiton league based in Rome that tries to influence the College of Cardinals to prevent an anti-magical Pope; includes mistresses of four Cardinals.

name: The Lineage of Pralix
description: An Ex Miscellanea tradition descended from Pralix that inducts hedge wizards into the Order, jointly trains apprentices, and grants the Comprehend Magic virtue.

name: The Lotharingians
description: A faction of northwestern Rhine covenants seeking to secede from the Rhine Tribunal to deal more freely with mundanes, forming the proposed Lotharingian Tribunal.

name: The Margravate of Brandenburg
description: The only notable city of the Margravate east of the Elbe, occupying an old Wendish settlement across three islands in the River Havel, with a cathedral and the first bishopric east of the Elbe.

name: The Margravate of Meissen
description: The most civilized of the Eastern Marches, a rolling land ruled by the Wettin dynasty since 1089; the last Hermetic covenant here, Sirmium, was destroyed in the 10th century.

name: The Mice of the Mauseturm
description: Demonic mouse swarms (Infernal Might 10) with fiery teeth, immune to fire, that infest the Mouse Tower island and are spontaneously generated by its Infernal aura.

name: The Miner's Keen Eye
description: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster see a specified type of mineral through up to 3 paces of intervening material.

name: The Mirror of Dreams
description: An ornate gold-framed enchanted mirror in Arliandus's sanctum that visualizes a subject's thoughts to aid Mentem lab work, but causes Warping Points and disturbing dreams.

name: The Mouse Tower
description: The Mauseturm, a half-ruined slender tower on a small island at the mouth of the Bingen Hole built by Hatto II, now haunted by his demonic shade and infested with demonic mice (Infernal aura 3).

name: The Nemthengacha
description: A sect of Ex Miscellanea magi found among Celtic and Scandinavian sorcerers who use the Embitterment power to create animosity and turn people against allies.

name: The Path of Seeming
description: A Criamon path drawing on the insight that the Enigma's secrets are hidden in the distracting details of the world, searching for weak points in the circle of time.

name: The Rusticani
description: An obscure tradition of folk magicians in House Ex Miscellanea who build spells and enchanted devices from mundane objects and live among common people.

name: The Silent Ones
description: A Jerbiton league dedicated to integrating the Silent Magic and Subtle Magic Virtues into standard Hermetic practice, led by a Bonisagus magus.

name: The Teufelsloch
description: A giant eroded hole in the hills west of Laach Lake with steep treacherous edges and an Infernal aura of 1, named the Devil's Hole by locals.

name: The Teutoburger Forest
description: A forested hill region in Saxony with powerful tree guardians (Magic Might 50), site of a famous victory over Roman legions, who remain trapped in a regio at its heart.

name: The Titans
description: Primordial spirits who, per House Tytalus belief, created the world and man before being imprisoned by the gods of Olympus; Tytalus contacted their shades and employed them against Guorna.

name: The Travels of Fedoso
description: An epic poem written by the Primus Verderis used by apprentices to learn Latin, claimed by many Criamon to be a prophetic map of the House's future.

name: The Treacherous Spear
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that animates a wooden or wooden-hafted melee weapon in someone else's hand, making it attack its holder until the wielder dies or the weapon is destroyed.

name: The Trier Amphitheater
description: A large oval Roman amphitheater outside Trier's walls (Magic aura 1-2) on the Hermesstrasse, haunted by three ghostly gladiators who challenge visitors to duels and where Mentem vis can be harvested.

name: The Trumpet of Ghostly Summoning
description: A small enchanted silver trumpet from Arliandus's sanctum that, when blown, summons forth and reveals ghosts or spirits in the area.

name: The Unseen Porter
description: A Rego Terram spell like Unseen Arm that can carry large inanimate objects with the strength of a very strong person.

name: The Wizard's Mount
description: A Creo Animal spell (Level 35) that creates a horse normal in every way except that it is not disturbed by The Gift.

name: Theoderich of Augsburg
aliases: Theoderich of Augsburg, Follower of Jerbiton
description: A journeyman of House Jerbiton at Heorot, formerly of Oculus Septentrionalis, a necromancer and historian who raises ghosts to interrogate them about the past.

name: Theology: Judaism
description: An Academic Ability that is the Jewish equivalent of Theology: Christian, drawing on the Torah, Nevi'im, and Kutuvim.

name: Thessalonica
description: Site of a great fair (the Demetria) rivaling Champagne in size and goods; its proximity to Constantinople makes eastern luxuries readily available.

name: Tierent
description: A 12th-century Verditius magus who adapted the Bind Magical Creatures Mystery to affect creatures with Faerie Might.

name: Tolosa Paratge
description: An ancient covenant in Toulouse in the Provencal Tribunal, completely split between two factions, the White and the Black, a rivalry that may bring it down.

name: Torven
description: A reclusive young hedge wizard of Waldheim with Latent Magical Ability who befriends forest creatures and is accompanied by the faerie wolf Red-Hame.

name: Town Magistrate
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue granting a position of judicial responsibility in a town with a small staff of officials, requiring citizenship and a score of 3 in Civil and Canon Law (or Common Law).

name: Tracing the Trail of Death's Stench
description: A spell used by Donatores to locate the corporeal remains of a spirit from the location of its death or gravesite.

name: Tragic Life
description: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the character's life has been manipulated by demons so that she will act to her own detriment at a pivotal moment of destiny.

name: Trained Assassin
description: A Minor General Virtue available only to characters with a Nizari Social Status Virtue, granting 50 experience points in Martial Abilities, Athletics, Guile, or Stealth.

name: Transform to Water
description: A spell whose constant effect is mimicked by the Water sample elemental form of a Bjornaer chimera or anima heartbeast.

name: Transformation of the Ravenous Beast to the Torpid Toad
description: A Muto Animal (MuAn 25) spell known by the Bjornaer template magus that transforms an animal into a toad.

name: Transformation of the Thorny Staff
description: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 10) that causes a length of wood to grow thick sharp thorns; adds +4 damage if cast on a staff.

name: Tremulous Vault of the Torch's Flame
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 5) that causes a fire to quiver and then leap up to 10 feet in any direction; a Targeting roll is required to hit a specific target.

name: Tribunal Summons
description: A formal summons to a Hermetic tribunal that Redcaps must deliver at least six months before the tribunal takes place; rigorously enforced.

name: True Name
description: A secret name expressing a being's spiritual essence, serving as an indefinite-duration Arcane Connection; demons, angels, jinn, and Daimons all have one, learned at a cost of 5 experience points.

name: Twilight Scar
description: A lasting supernatural mark left on a magus by Twilight episodes; Philippus Niger bears many, including one that causes only male children to be born where he lives.

name: Twist of the Tongue
description: A Perdo Corpus spell that twists the target's tongue into a spiral, destroying the ability to speak; a grave offense to a magus.

name: Two-headed Hound
description: A corrupt beast (Might 10, Animal) appearing as a huge two-headed dog whose heads hate each other; able to spit fire, created by a diabolist as a sanctum guard.

name: Tzadik Nistar
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is one of the Tzadikim Nistarim, the 36 hidden righteous on whom the world's continuation relies, destined to face a moment of moral decision.

name: Unbearable to (Beings)
description: A Minor Hermetic or General Flaw in which one of three classes of beings is extremely disturbed by the character, adding -3 to social interactions; only for characters with The Gift or Magical Air.

name: Unbound Tongue
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: when transformed into a non-human form, the character may speak any human languages he knows without impediment, and a magus may still cast spells with his voice.

name: Unhappily Married
description: A major Story Flaw where a merchant has married for money rather than love and seeks solace outside the marital bed, hiding affairs from spouse and family.

name: Unicorn
description: A legendary horned beast whose horn provides Shape and Material bonuses to healing (+8), poison detection (+10), and fertility (+11).

name: University Dean
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is the head of a university overseeing internal and external affairs; requires the Doctor in (Faculty) Virtue and age 40+.

name: University Grammar Teacher
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed by a university to teach grammar to younger members, able to purchase Latin and Artes Liberales.

name: University of Naples
description: A planted university to be instituted by Frederick II of Naples in 1224, drawing masters from Salerno.

name: University of Salamanca
description: A royal Spanish university founded by Alfonso IX of León in 1218, notable for offering a music degree and admitting women scholars.

name: Unruly Air
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's presence subtly pushes others to extreme behavior in social situations; those with Magic Resistance are unaffected.

name: Valkyrie
description: Faerie minor goddesses of the Norse pantheon (Might 20) who ride wolves above battlefields to select the worthy dead for transformation into einherjar; they also serve as maids in Valhalla.

name: Vederis
description: A famous magus of House Criamon who wrote The Travels of Fedoso, a classic work of esoteric lore.

name: Venus' Blessing
description: A Minor General Virtue giving +3 on Communication and Presence rolls with sexually compatible characters in appropriate situations.

name: Vernus
description: A weak, Struggling Spring covenant of six magi consisting of tents around a standing stone in a clearing within a faerie-forest magical regio, contesting its sole vis source with faeries.

name: Viaticarus
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character survived after receiving Extreme Unction, leaving him immune to demonic temptation but increasingly corpse-like and unable to cross certain wards.

name: Viea
description: Trianoma's jealous twin sister who interpreted her visions, then stole valuable texts and fled; her fate remains unknown.

name: Viper's Gaze
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 15) that holds an animal rigid as long as the caster maintains eye contact and concentrates.

name: Voice of the Lake
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 25) that lets the caster hold a conversation with a body of water about things in contact with it.

name: Vortigern
description: The usurper king who invited the Saxons under Hengist and Horsa into Britain and consulted Merlin about his collapsing tower.

name: Vulnerable Casting
description: A Hermetic Flaw causing extra Fatigue loss when casting, gained from Ordeals or bad Twilight effects; cannot be started with alongside Withstand Casting.

name: Waldheim
description: A tiny reclusive hamlet in a glade (Magic aura 2) deep in the Westerwald near the former covenant of Oakdell, inhabited by hedge wizards loyal to the Court of Bright Winter.

name: Wall of Protecting Stone
description: A Creo Terram spell that makes a wall of granite up to 25 paces wide, 4 paces high, and 1 pace thick.

name: Walpurga
description: A powerful beneficent faerie lady (Faerie Might 50) of the Seelie Court representing summer and growth, who appears at the Witches' Altar on Walpurgis Night to summon summer.

name: Wand of Bestial Agony
description: A lesser enchanted wand belonging to Mari Amwithig that Hephaestion reforges in an example, with a Rego Vim power of effect level 20.

name: Wanderer
description: A free Social Status Virtue recommended for performance artists and held by Brogo, marking an itinerant performer.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Wood
description: A Rego Herbam ward spell (General) protecting a magic circle against faeries of the wood, modeled on the Aquam version.

name: Ward Against Rain
description: A Rego Auram spell (Level 10) ensuring no rain falls on the caster regardless of the weather.

name: Warding
description: An Accelerated Supernatural Ability of the Columbae for warding away natural things and supernatural beings with Might by inscribing arcane symbols into a circle; predates and was integrated into Hermetic magic.

name: Warped Magic
description: A Hermetic Flaw causing a magus' magic to display an unusual side effect; Balastor's causes his features to take on a savage, feral cast.

name: Waves of Drowning and Smashing
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that raises a wave five feet high and thirty paces wide capable of submerging swimmers and overturning rowboats.

name: Weak Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which a magus's magic is poor at penetrating Magic Resistance, halving the Penetration Total for all spells.

name: Weaver's Trap of Webs
description: A Creo Animal (CrAn 35) indirect spell that surrounds and immobilizes a magus with webs without touching him, partly effective without penetrating Magic Resistance.

name: Weird Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making a magus's control over magic loose, adding an extra strange botch die on stressed casting rolls.

name: Wilhelm Weiss
description: A Gentle-Gifted Jerbiton magus and master of Fengheld at the Rheingasse chapter in Cologne who poses as a wealthy merchant and co-leads the Apple Gild.

name: William de Longespee
description: Earl of Salisbury since 1198 and a bastard son of Henry II; a close counselor of King John and a ruthless opportunist disputing Lincoln with Nicola de Hay.

name: Willow Maiden
description: The manipulative, uncaring faerie ruler of the eastern Willow Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, whose power waxes in autumn and who entraps the Alder Prince.

name: Witches of Thessaly
description: A tradition descended from reclusive Thessalian worshipers of underworld gods who practiced sorcery and necromancy; Trianoma was a member, and some remain in contact with the Daughters of Erictho.

name: Withstand Casting
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus lose fewer Fatigue levels (minimum 1) when casting spells; can be taken multiple times for greater effect.

name: Wizard's Icy Grip
description: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 30) that chills a single target for +20 damage, freezing it solid if killed; armor does not add to Soak against it.

name: Wolfram von Eschenbach
description: A famous German minnesinger and poet at the court of Hermann I of Thuringia, author of Parzival; used as an example of a character with both Profession: Minnesinger and Craft: Poetry.

name: Wolkan
description: A branded criminal freed by Lord Robert to help collect tolls on Pfalz Island; a skilled thief and boatman with criminal contacts up and down the Rhine.

name: Words of the Flickering Flame
description: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 35) that allows the caster to converse with a fire, which is commonly chaotic and distractible.

name: Wrathful
description: A Personality Flaw making a character prone to anger; held by the Berserker grog and Flambeau template magus.

name: Wrecked
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is very heavily damaged from a major accident, taking two seasons to repair (-5 General Quality, -2 Safety, -2 Aesthetics).

name: Xavier of House Mercere
description: Archivist of the Rhine Tribunal, attributed as the source of an in-world quotation about the Bingen Hole.

name: Ygerna
description: Gorlois's wife, sought by Uther; she received the disguised Uther into her bed at Tintagel and conceived Arthur.

name: Zelos
description: The Daimon of rivalry, envy, and competition, appearing as a winged Greek youth with a laurel crown; he propagates contention but never helps resolve conflicts.

name: Zeus
description: The god who raised Orpheus's lyre into the stars, taken by the Orphic cult as a sign of Orpheus's apotheosis.

name: Zwergenstimme
description: A Magic spirit of an echo (Might 15, Imaginem) that lurks in caves and ravines, can mimic sounds, hurl rocks, and collapse cave roofs; its name means 'dwarf voice' in German.

name: 'Alim
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of the Islamic religious elite, such as a muezzin, imam, mufti, or qadi.

name: (Dead Language)
description: An Academic Ability for speaking a language no longer used natively, such as Latin, available only to educated characters.

name: (Form) Monstrosity
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw, mainly for animal characters, giving a monstrous feature corresponding to a magical Form, from which Muto vis may be extracted.

name: (Gild) Enmity
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw representing the active enmity of one of the Rhine's political gilds, which seeks to thwart the character politically; Tabanus has Hawthorn Gild Enmity.

name: (Land) Regio Network
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue giving access to an extensive network of regiones (e.g. in lakes, sky, or caves) between which the character can travel quickly.

name: (Living Language)
description: A General Ability representing fluency in a particular living language, measured on a fluency scale from point-and-grunt to elegant.

name: (Mystery Cult) Lore
description: An (Organization) Lore Ability for a particular Mystery Cult, covering its legends, history, structure, rites, secret passwords, and Initiation ceremonies.

name: (Realm) Stigmatic
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character manifests physical phenomena and loses Fatigue when in a strong aura aligned to a chosen Realm of Power.

name: A Deal with the Devil
description: A Major Story Flaw: the character has sold his soul to the devil and is destined for infernal damnation, with Hell's agents goading him; includes Plagued By Supernatural Entity.

name: A Father's Concern
description: An InCo 40 Orphic spell created by Anatol to periodically check on the physical condition of his daughters via the Adelphixis Range.

name: A Moment's Reflection
description: A Creo Mentem spell that sparks conscience to remove the Obsession Personality Trait imposed by a demon's obsession power.

name: A Plague of Frogs
description: An Animal spell that spontaneously generates frogs, used as an example that the material cause (the frogs) determines its Form.

name: A Simple Charm for the Recovery of Misfiled Books
description: A Rego Animal 10 spell that makes a misplaced book fly to its lectern, bookcase, or the caster's hand, using an arcane connection such as the library catalog or the book's voucher.

name: A Simple Test for the Completeness of Books
description: An Intellego Animal 15 spell with Herbam requisite that checks a book's physical condition and history and tests the quality of its plant-based inks.

name: A Spell to Kill Weeds
description: A PeHe 20 spell (Touch, Momentary, Group) that weeds out a touched plant and all similar plants within a 15-pace range.

name: A Spell to Milk Cattle
description: A ReAn 15 spell (Touch, Concentration, Group) that magically milks cows into nearby milkpails, substituting a Perception + Finesse roll for Animal Handling.

name: A Useful Inculcator of Comments
description: A Rego Herbam 4 spell that lets librarians add catalog descriptions by sliding letters on a page aside to make space for new entries.

name: A Visible Demand for Repair
description: A MuIm 5 synaesthetic spell that transforms the groans and squeaks of damaged equipment into iconic species, granting +3 to Craft or Profession rolls to find flaws.

name: Abandoned Apprentice
description: A Major Story Flaw: the character was abandoned by his master midway through Hermetic training and is not a member of the Order of Hermes, though he knows Hermetic magic.

name: Abbot Thurstan
description: A Norman abbot installed at Glastonbury by the Conqueror who tried to impose foreign customs and the chant of William of Fécamp, leading his soldiers to massacre monks in the church.

name: Abd Al Raman
description: The Moorish emir whose invading army crossed the Pyrenees in 732 and whose outriders burned the young Flambeau's family estate.

name: Abluere Magica
description: A Rego Herbam (Animal) 15 enchanted device of two hinged boards that cleans a soiled garment placed between them as a washerwoman would.

name: Abyss
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab contains a magical void such as a bottomless well, which can become a Void Feature (-2 Safety, +2 Perdo).

name: Accursius
description: A renowned legal commentator at Bologna and frontrunner to become rector of the Faculty of Law, racing his rival Odofredus to write a complete digest of civil law.

name: Acre
description: The major port in the Kingdom of Jerusalem and center of Christian activity in Outremer, a dangerous city contested by Muslim and Crusader forces and home to the military orders.

name: Adam
description: The first man of biblical lore referenced in the Divine setting material.

name: Adder
description: A small venomous snake of Mythic Europe, about a foot and a half long with diamond-shaped markings, possessing a Venomous Bite power that can poison victims based on attack advantage versus armor.

name: Addled
description: A non-standard laboratory routine in which a maga works two extra hours daily by eccentric anti-fatigue means, gaining +3 to Lab Total but risking Warping, addiction, and botches.

name: Adelheid Invigilix
description: The filia of Friderich Invigilor who now watches the Hohenstaufen dynasty for the Invigilor lineage of Tremere.

name: Adelphixis
description: A spell Range granted by Orphic Magic that targets anyone connected to the magos by an emotional Story Flaw, equivalent to Arcane Connection for spell level.

name: Adept Laboratory Student
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting +6 to Lab Totals when working from others' lab texts.

name: Adjuration
description: A Virtue from Realms of Power: The Divine effective against demons, useful to a Flambeau demon-hunter's companion.

name: Aedes Mercurii
description: A powerful covenant in the Provençal Tribunal with two sites, one centered on a majestic stone edifice known as the Temple (Templum) and another carved out of the Pic du Midi d'Ossau.

name: Aegaea
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal located in a Faerie regio on the floor of the Aegean Sea, claimed by its members to be the palace of Poseidon and staffed largely by faerie tritones.

name: Aegea
description: A covenant on the floor of the Aegean Sea in the Theban Tribunal, home of the elder Merinita magus Lucian the Scholar.

name: Aegir
description: A long-tailed skua seabird that serves as the familiar of Eric Ribecus of Waddenzee.

name: Aegis of Unbreakable Wood
description: A MuHe 15 spell that makes a wooden shield as strong as iron, increasing its Defense bonus by +1 while remaining susceptible to fire.

name: Aelfhere
description: A Friesian shipwright of Waddenzee whose shipbuilding ability is nothing short of magical; he secretly exchanges ideas with the Verditius shipwright Marcus.

name: Aelfric
description: An example agent of Carolus, an Outlaw Leader who runs a small team of bandits preying on local merchants and owes Carolus loyalty for protection from the law.

name: Aeolus
description: The vain magical horse that accompanies Victor of Mercere on his visits to the city, taking care not to soil his coat.

name: Aesculapius
description: The Greek god of healing, in whose temples (with snake nurseries and mineral springs) Crateuas may have hidden a copy of his herbal.

name: Aestas
description: A Summer covenant of medium power occupying a large castle and serving as Mundane Lord of the local village, keeping a low profile in Hermetic politics and offering generous hospitality to visiting magi and Redcaps.

name: Aethelbald
description: A deputy among Waddenzee's pirate covenfolk who claims to be the Saxon heir to the Crown of England.

name: Aether
description: The fifth element posited by Aristotle that exists only above the Lunar Sphere, neither hot nor cold nor moist nor dry, composing the planetary spheres and planets.

name: Aetites
description: Rare eagle-stones mentioned by Pliny; the smaller pebble inside holds one pawn of Terram vis and gives a +5 Material bonus to fertility when used in an enchanted item or talisman.

name: Affinity with Craft or Profession Ability
description: A Minor Virtue a maestro may select at no cost, enhancing learning of a Craft or Profession Ability that is the artist's primary medium.

name: Affinity with Enchanting Music
description: A Virtue held by Brogo that boosts his Enchanting Music supernatural ability.

name: Affinity with Finesse
description: A Virtue granting Imanitos Mendax accelerated learning in Finesse, gained from Twilight.

name: Affinity with Guile
description: A Virtue granting Imanitos Mendax accelerated learning in the Guile Ability.

name: Affinity with Ignem
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue granting affinity with the Form of fire, imparted to Initiates of the Confraternity of Balento.

name: Affinity with Intellego
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Hermetic Haruspexes tradition, granting an affinity with the Intellego Art.

name: Affinity with Mentem
description: A Virtue granting Imanitos Mendax accelerated learning in the Mentem Art.

name: Affinity with Penetration
description: A Virtue giving Philippus Niger accelerated learning in the Penetration Ability.

name: Affinity with Perdo
description: A Virtue giving Philippus Niger accelerated learning in the Perdo Art.

name: Affinity with Vim
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Witches of Thessaly tradition, granting an affinity with the Vim Art.

name: Afire
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is engulfed in never-dying flames requiring protection, possibly blocking some lab work (+1 Upkeep, -3 Safety, +2 Warping, +2 Aesthetics, +3 Ignem).

name: Agency
description: A network of mundane contacts (agents) that magi maintain to pursue goals without being implicated in meddling with mundane politics.

name: Agent
description: A person bound to offer assistance to a principal through ties such as contracts, debts, or blackmail.

name: Aging Modifier
description: A modifier reflecting living conditions' effect on aging; covenfolk living conditions translate into loyalty point modifiers via this aging modifier.

name: Aging Roll
description: A periodic roll determining a character's aging, modified by Healthy or Unhealthy environmental features at a covenant.

name: Agnes
description: A Merinita apprentice who in 1158 claimed to have learned nature magic from a lady in green in Bohemia and was hailed as a True Merinitae having learned Nature Lore from the Founder.

name: Agnosia
description: A PeMe 10 spell that destroys familiarity with a category of object represented by a single noun, so the victim cannot recognize or use such things.

name: Agricola of Tytalus
description: A Tytalus magus of peasant stock at Castrum Antiquum who used Herbam, Auram and Animál magic to wring great harvests from poor northern land.

name: Aindread Ex Miscellanea
description: A reclusive mature magus at Burnham who never answers letters and has left the covenant only once; parens of Caitlin.

name: Air's Ghostly Form
description: A Creo Auram spell (Level 5) that forms a thick fog around the magus extending outward several paces.

name: Airborne
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab flies upon the winds or clouds, requiring very powerful magic, often taken with Unstable.

name: Akrotiri
description: An ancient city buried in volcanic ash on the island of Thera that Andru discovered; rich in magical and technological secrets but now infested with vampires.

name: Alam
description: A Criamon term for a mystical state so divorced from the mundane world that its alignment to the four realms is debatable; key examples are the Hypostasis and the counter-cyclical alam.

name: Albert the Bear
description: A Saxon who founded the March of Brandenburg in 1150 and adopted the title of margrave after campaigns against the Wends; he rebuilt a cathedral in the city of Brandenburg.

name: Albert von Buxhövden
description: Bishop of Riga who founded the Knights of the Sword (Livonian Order) in 1202 and struggles in vain to control their excesses.

name: Albigensian Crusade
description: A crusade aimed at the heretical Cathars in Languedoc that is effectively destroying the tradition of southern troubadours.

name: Alchemical Reagent
description: An experimental-philosophy product learned via Philosophiae: a natural substance made in the lab from minerals, botanicals and animal components that imposes a natural alteration on matter.

name: Alchemical Steel
description: A Level 20 Alteration Reagent producing a purified, harder form of iron; blades made of it gain +2 damage and armor gains +2 Protection.

name: Alchemist's Revenge
description: A CrAq 25 spell that splashes a target with acid, inflicting +15 damage if it penetrates Magic Resistance and optionally damaging equipment.

name: Alcuin of York
description: The Englishman and most famous teacher of Charlemagne's Palatine School, whose ghost is said to haunt the Paris classrooms and whose lost works scholars seek at Aachen.

name: Alexander of Jerbiton
description: A magus of House Jerbiton who walked the Path of Aging, plucking out his own eye, drinking from the Fountain of Youth, and disappearing into the forest after his mater's death.

name: Alexandria
description: An Egyptian city whose lighthouse holds a source of fire from which an Initiate must steal a brand during the Automata Initiation.

name: Alfred the Great
description: King of Wessex from 871 who drove back the Danes, established defensive burhs, and was a learned translator; subject of the legend of the burnt cakes.

name: All According to Plan
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a player reroll a botch die once per session by describing a prepared contingency.

name: Allessandro
description: An example Donatore character with Banishing 18 who banishes the Infernal ghost of his former master from his covenant in a worked example.

name: Almogaten
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for the leader of a band of Almogavars in Iberia, commanding around a dozen men.

name: Almogavar
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of an Iberian band of mercenaries and raiders bound by a code of honor.

name: Alnoth
description: The son born to Eadric Wilde and his faerie wife, who grew up to be a good and holy man.

name: Alodia
description: The most remote of the three Nubian kingdoms on the southern reaches of the Nile, where Kassala is located.

name: Altar
description: A laboratory Feature: an ornamental place of ritual worship such as a raised dais, providing Technique and Vim Specializations.

name: Amabel the Learned
description: A brilliant Natural Magician scholar at Schola Pythagoranis, nearly as powerful as the magi and treated as a member of the Order though she never joined.

name: Amaury de Bene
description: An unrepentant heretic and Paris master who taught a pantheistic philosophy with a substantial following; posthumously exhumed, excommunicated, and his bones cast into unhallowed ground.

name: Ambrus
description: A Bonisagus archmage who led the complex negotiations for the founding of three covenants in the Slavic lands in the late 10th century.

name: Ambush on the Deserted Road
description: A PeIm 20 transparency spell that destroys the species a group emits in one direction, making a traveling party invisible from the direction of those they wish to ambush.

name: Amorphous
description: A Major or Minor Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting a character take on any non-specific human form due to demon-touched flesh.

name: An Enemy Awash in the Pure Sigil of the Magus
description: A CrIm 15 spell that washes a target's eyes with concentrated visible species based on the caster's sigil, blinding them for two minutes.

name: Anal Fistula
description: A Minor Melancholic Disease from excessive retention of melancholy on the fundament, requiring surgical removal of the fistula.

name: Ananke
description: The Greek goddess of inevitability whose bound wrists were depicted in House Criamon's older symbol; she was never worshipped because she could not grant favors.

name: Anatol
description: A magos formerly of House Jerbiton who created the spell A Father's Concern to check on his six estranged daughters.

name: Anchored to the (Land)
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character suffers loneliness and a -3 penalty when traveling through any environment other than a particular favored one.

name: Andreas
description: A magus of House Bonisagus who devised The Resolute Mind of the Tireless Researcher to combat his constant lapses of concentration.

name: Andresina
description: A ruined and abandoned Roman city southwest of Toul with a great temple to Apollo and a Magic aura of 2, a possible covenant site.

name: Andrilikes
description: A theurgist magus of the Novgorod Tribunal who wrote a Hermetic ritual for summoning the lesser Daimon Pukis to his sanctum.

name: Angelic Movement
description: A common automaton power (base effect 40, Creo Auram with Rego requisite) letting an automaton with a flight-capable form fly at the magus's direction.

name: Anglesey
description: The island site of an ancient druidic shrine that the Díedne incorporated as the Nameless Covenant in 817.

name: Animae
description: Temporary faeries created by Animae Magic from inanimate objects or summoned from Arcadia; they are intelligent, have Might-appropriate powers, and bargain for their aid.

name: Animae Magic
description: A Major Arcadian Mystery (Virtue) that lets a maga transform inanimate objects into living faeries called animae or summon them, using new Creo/Muto spell guidelines.

name: Animal Companion
description: A Minor Story Flaw: the character is accompanied by a loyal, intelligent but mundane animal with whom they share a very close relationship.

name: Animal Ken (Ability)
description: The Supernatural Ability to communicate with animals, conferred by the Animal Ken Virtue at score 1.

name: Anizy-le-Château
description: A town of 300 dominating fourteen smaller towns in Laonnoise southwest of Laon in France, long in conflict with its lord the Bishop of Laon over taxation and charters.

name: Anna of Naples
description: A tenth-century Jerbiton Archmage whose decision to take her apprentice and others to Constantinople for immersion accidentally created the first Itinerarium.

name: Annwfn
description: The otherworld realm over which Gwynn ab Nudd reigns as king of the faeries.

name: Antigone of Criamon
description: An example Criamon maga (a follower of the Path of Seeming, skilled in Imaginem) who suffers Twilight incidents and adulterations such as a dragon embodying her violent temper.

name: Antimedes of Tytalus
description: A magus of House Tytalus and member of the Lyceum who seeks to copy rare academic books and re-enter them into academic circles.

name: Antiphon
description: A Sophist quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who proposed that man is better off escaping convention and taught a life of refined intellectual hedonism.

name: Apoplexy
description: A Critical Sanguine Disease caused by a malicious faerie that damages the heart, causing immediate collapse.

name: Apostate
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character has converted from one faith or belief system to another, gaining a bad Reputation of 4 among their previous faith.

name: Appease the Queen of Winter
description: A Muto Aquam ritual spell (MuAq 60) learned by Falke with the volkhvy's aid, propitiating the Queen of Winter to thaw the Baltic Sea; gains a +10 bonus when cast at Arkona.

name: Apples of Hesperides
description: A golden-apple tree grown from a seed said to descend from Hera's wedding tree; it produces six golden apples a year, each containing Creo vis, whose flesh sustains a man and resists illness.

name: Apprentices
description: An Ars Magica supplement providing rules for playing child characters and how their Virtues and Flaws change as they age.

name: Apprenticeship
description: The period during which a future magus is trained by a master until passing the gauntlet; Agricola was taken for apprenticeship late.

name: Aptitude for (Sin)
description: A Minor General Tainted Virtue granting +3 in a narrow circumstance linked to a demon's Obsession, such as picking pockets.

name: Aptness
description: Moral correctness in House Criamon belief; living aptly is thought to slow the universe's fall into chaos and is required for entering the Hypostasis.

name: Aramin
description: An irascible magus, expert in Perdo and Corpus, whose vis source is a rare swamp plant (bitter cane) and who may have authored a plague.

name: Arcadian Path
description: A path mentioned in House Merinita usually leading into the faerie realm of Arcadia and granting the Mystery of Faerie Magic; Serrifuloria discovered a unique variant within Arcadia itself.

name: Arcadian Travel
description: A Minor Arcadian Mystery (Virtue) that lets a maga travel between Faerie and the mortal world via trods and open temporary gateways to Arcadia using charms.

name: Arcane Discovery
description: The process by which magi expand Hermetic magic, accumulating breakthrough points toward Minor, Major, or Hermetic Breakthroughs through experimentation or integration.

name: Archbishop Wichmann of Magdeburg
description: An archbishop who, following a vision of vast urban development, granted charters to many towns in Germany and Poland and used agents called locatores.

name: Archieunuch
description: A Major Social Status Virtue for one of the most important eunuchs in the Byzantine empire, wielding significant influence and authority.

name: Archimaga Tisiphone
description: A renowned beauty and Archimaga able to evoke artistic talent in men, who lives within a regio and wears a red ribbon.

name: Archimagus Apollodarus
description: An Archimagus of the Monkey's Reed covenant whose beloved died in a fire he created, whom Bonisagus magi hope will become High Priest of the forming Temple.

name: Archimagus Theoderic
description: The affable, encouraging Archimagus who governs the Devoted covenant dedicated to reaching the Lunar Sphere.

name: Arelie
description: One of Birna's six apprentices, told to 'Remember,' an eagle from a Prussian tribe; founder of Clan Arelie.

name: Aretaeus the Cappadocian
description: The physician credited with naming diabetes after the Greek word for a siphon, due to its excessive discharge of urine.

name: Argantael
description: A vagabond faerie who assists the clothier Doolin, whispering to him about secret gatherings of wizards from across Mythic Europe.

name: Argonauts
description: Jason's crew aboard the Argo who were saved from the sirens by Orpheus's lyre during the quest for the Golden Fleece.

name: Ariel of Flambeau
description: A young Flambeau magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Aristaeus
description: A god who desired Eurydice and advanced on her, causing her to flee and step on the viper that killed her.

name: Arm of the Infant
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 20) that shrinks a person's arm to half its length and makes it pudgy like an infant's.

name: Ars Goetia
description: A sorcerous tradition dealing with the summoning, binding, commanding, ablating, and punishment of spiritual entities of all realms except the Divine; practiced by Guorna and Tytalus and socially tainted.

name: Arte dei Mercanti
description: Merchant societies formed in Florence in 1182 in imitation of the noble tower societies, which spread to many other cities.

name: Artemis
description: The deity to whom Ophia Sirnaus Isle-Warden's shrine on her Aegean island is dedicated.

name: Arthritis
description: A Minor General Flaw: stiff, painful joints giving -3 to rolls involving repetitive sustained movement, with botches potentially locking up a limb.

name: Artificer
description: An honorary Durenmar title for the magus, traditionally a Verditius, charged with crafting items for the covenant; currently held by Gudrun Tigurina.

name: Artist
description: A covenfolk template for a fey, painter-craftsman in a highly magical environment, with Virtues like Free Expression and Second Sight.

name: Asaron of Flambeau
description: A magus of House Flambeau who believes his mission is to repopulate the world for more to kill; he spends seasons healing, and his sigil is a symbolic flame.

name: Aspect
description: An agent projected onto Earth by a Daimon, functioning as an independent spirit with its own Might pool that is dispelled when exhausted and returns to the parent Daimon.

name: Asses' Ears
description: A Minor Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) that turns the victim's ears into donkey ears, penalizing social interactions by -3.

name: Assistant
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: a Gifted assistant such as a Hermetic apprentice helps in the lab, adding their Intelligence + Magic Theory to General Quality.

name: Astasians
description: Tiny messenger-demons that Imanitos Mendax can use to communicate with his subordinates, easily mistaken for 'airy spirits.'

name: Astrolabe of Jerbiton
description: Possibly the most brilliant magus in the tribunal, a Jerbiton at Schola Pythagoranis devoted to natural philosophy who critiques magic theory's physics.

name: Astrological Inception
description: An experimental-philosophy formula learned via Artes Liberales consisting of an astrological chart designed to answer a specific question about a person, object, or event.

name: Astrology
description: The natural principle that the celestial figure of planets at a thing's creation determines its qualities; employed by magi in ceremonial casting and lab work ordering.

name: Astronomical Device
description: A laboratory Feature: a tool for measuring the heavens such as an astrolabe or armillary sphere, providing Intellego and Vim Specializations.

name: Atavism
description: The acquisition of ancestral characteristics by which a Bjornaer magus learns to adopt the form of a notable animal ancestor (the inner heartbeast).

name: Atlantean Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue from exiled Atlantean magic granting the special Range Water-way, Duration Storm, and Target Body-of-water.

name: Atlanteans
description: A people native to a magic regio; an exiled Atlantean tainted by the surface world cannot return, as detailed in Realms of Power: Magic.

name: Aufhocker
description: A faerie hound variant found in German-speaking areas that acts as a kelpie and clings to foes while goring them, adding to their combat Load.

name: Augustinian Canons
description: Regular canons following the Rule of St. Augustine of Hippo who, unlike monks, are not sequestered from the world and undertake pastoral duties.

name: Aura of Beguiling Appearance
description: A Muto Imaginem spell (MuIm 10) variant of Aura of Ennobled Presence that makes the target appear more friendly and credible, granting +3 to win trust and to Charm-based Defense Totals.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority Pendant
description: A bejeweled golden pendant crafted by Stentorius and worn by his familiar Oswald, imbued with multiple uses of Aura of Rightful Authority and other effects.

name: Aurelius Ambrosius
description: Brother of Uther Pendragon who defeated Vortigern and the Saxons and had Merlin bring the Giant's Dance to Britain; slain by treachery.

name: Ausculator
description: A famous living representative of House Guernicus's earth-magic tradition, leader of the covenant of Hedyosmos in the Theban Tribunal.

name: Auspicious Shape
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is formed into a magically beneficial shape such as a hexagon or pentagram, granting +1 Aesthetics and +1 Vim.

name: Autodictation
description: A Rego Terram 15 spell that lets a magus write by talking, inscribing a metal stylus across prepared wax boards as he speaks.

name: Autumnus
description: A powerful Autumn covenant housed in a single enormous magically warmed building atop a mountain peak, ruled by a council of its four oldest magi and protecting a smaller covenant in another Tribunal.

name: Avalon
description: The legendary isle identified with Glastonbury, burial place of King Arthur.

name: Avebury
description: A village within the largest of many mysterious monuments, a stone circle about a thousand feet across with banks, ditches, inner circles and avenues said to lead somewhere not of this world on particular days.

name: Avenue
description: The process of spiritual awakening, purification, and testing by which a Criamon magus reaches a new station, requiring a Lore score, a trial or investiture, and insight from a story.

name: Averroes
description: A twelfth-century Islamic scholar who refuted al-Ghazali's claims in his book The Incoherence of the Incoherence.

name: Awkward Shape
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the chamber is a difficult shape, long and thin or partitioned (-2 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Axior
description: A martial magus of House Flambeau and founding member of Oculus Septentrionalis who disagreed over its site and founded Terschelling (later Waddenzee) instead; killed in a magical accident.

name: Baden
description: A Swabian town named Aquae by the Romans for its hot springs, whose ruined upper part retains a Magic aura of 2 and is owned by Durenmar, which harvests vis from the springs.

name: Baker
description: A covenfolk template for a returned faerie changeling who bakes faerie-style, with Free Expression and Lesser Purifying Touch.

name: Balastor
description: A feral journeyman of House Criamon at Fengheld who seeks enlightenment by returning to a primal state; his Warped Magic gives him a savage cast, and his philosophy aligns with the Hawthorn Gild.

name: Baldwin I
description: The first Count of Flanders, exiled in 862 for marrying Judith, who fought the magical bear at the site of Brugge.

name: Baldwin IX
description: Count of Flanders crowned the first emperor of the Latin Empire of Constantinople in 1204, who mysteriously disappeared in 1205 during battle against King Ivan of Bulgaria.

name: Balento
description: A ninth-century Verditius magus convinced he was a direct descendant of Vulcan, who focused on fire magic and founded the Confraternity of Balento.

name: Ball of Abysmal Music
description: A Muto Imaginem 20 spell, reputedly Pendule's favorite, that targets a formulaic Ignem spell mid-cast and turns its fire into a harmless burst of color and sound.

name: Balmung
description: Siegfried's sword, with which Kriemhild decapitates Hagen in the Nibelungenlied.

name: Banco
description: Dean of the Goldsmith's Guild of Rome and member of the Savelli family, a skilled maker of wondrous goods who secretly seeks to learn how to make genuine Hermetic magic items.

name: Bard
description: A Free Social Status Virtue for a graduate of a Hibernian bardic school at the rank of Dos, with a Local Reputation among the Irish.

name: Bardney Abbey
description: The abbey to which Saint Oswald's bones were transferred; a heavenly light over the cart at the gates showed the monks they should welcome the foreign king's relics.

name: Basajaun
description: A gigantic red-furred faun variant of the Great Lezi found in the Basque country of Iberia, acting as agricultural faeries; the name also refers to a large wild faun in surrounding folklore.

name: Basel
description: A city on the Upper Rhine, the highest navigable point of the river, where Redcaps make frequent use of the Copper Rooster Inn maintained by House Mercere.

name: Basilicus
description: A Primus of House Ex Miscellanea, a Hermetic Haruspex with prophetic abilities, who seized control before the Schism War and re-instituted the Council of Four.

name: Basilisk
description: A magical lizard whose gaze can kill; Philippus Niger tracked a female basilisk and obtained one of her eggs to hatch his familiar Sordus.

name: Bassianus
description: The rector of Montpellier striving to raise the reputation of its Faculty of Arts against the dominant Faculty of Medicine.

name: Battle Abbey
description: A Benedictine abbey founded by William the Conqueror on the site of the Battle of Hastings, its high altar marking where Harold died.

name: Battle of the False Sun
description: The final battle at Cad Gadu in Wales where Damhan-Allaidh and his allies were finally defeated by Pralix's army.

name: Baumesel
description: A malicious wood-spirit used to frighten children, which attacks lone travelers in the woods.

name: Bautzen
description: The only place in Lusatia with real German influence, site of the 1018 Peace of Bautzen, where the Knights of the Sword maintain a fortification holding slaves before transport to Prague.

name: Bear Clan
description: A clan of Crintera composed of its largest and fiercest warriors, traditionally berserkers who fight with maces; their leader Dietrich can sense shape-changers.

name: Beasts of Virtue
description: Magical animals that resemble fine specimens of mundane creatures but possess hidden or surprising abilities suited to their kind; the most obvious magical creatures.

name: Becoming
description: A Major Arcadian Mystery (Virtue) teaching a maga how to irreversibly transform body, mind, and spirit to become a faerie, as Quendalon was reputed to have done.

name: Bee King
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue from faerie blood letting a character command and understand bees, never be stung, and not age, but die exactly a century after birth.

name: Belas Knap
description: A long barrow with a stone-blocked doorway that is said to open on significant nights, allowing access to a faerie palace from which no one returns.

name: Belin
description: Mercere's last apprentice, renowned for her devotion to the Order and dedication to delivering messages despite having no Gift; held up as an ideal in House Mercere.

name: Belinda
description: A Redcap who has traveled further east than any other and reported a vast magical city ruled by wise old magi at the fringes of the Order.

name: Belinus
description: A legendary king of Britain who, with his brother Brennius, sacked Rome and brought back a hoard of treasure possibly including magical texts.

name: Bells of Speyer
description: The bells of Speyer's cathedral that toll without mortal hand on the occasion of an imperial death; they refused to toll for the excommunicated Henry IV until his absolution.

name: Beltane Fire Festivals
description: Irish fire festivals that dispel minor Hermetic enchantments and curse witches, forcing the Gifted behind the Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Benefactor
description: A sponsor who agrees to buy a single piece of artwork from an artist; gaining one grants 3 Artist Reputation experience points.

name: Beowulf
description: The hero who slew the troll Grendel; Theoderich has been unable to find his remains.

name: Berechiah ben Natronai haNakdan
description: A Jewish scribe and author of Oxford (born 1162), secretly a highly skilled natural magician considering contact with the Order to defend the Jews.

name: Berenger
description: An example fellow alchemist, less skilled than Martin, who learns the cement formula from Martin's Laboratory Text and tractatus.

name: Bern
description: The city of which Dietrich was boy-king after the fall of Rome; conquered by his uncle Ermenrik and later retaken by Dietrich.

name: Bernard of Clairvaux
description: A churchman who condemned the heretical works of Peter Abelard to the flames.

name: Bernice of Thessalonica
description: The maga who was Flavius of Jerbiton's teacher, collected him from the Alps, and negotiated with Trianoma to bring Eastern Empire magi into the Order; she died in 763 before the First Tribunal.

name: Betraying Whispers of the Jealous Mind
description: An InMe 30 spell that lets the caster hear, as muffled repeated whispers, the dominant emotions other people hold concerning him as they come within earshot.

name: Beuthen
description: A Polish town with a lead mine operated by the demon Szarlen in return for services under a demonic arrangement.

name: Bia
description: The Daimon of force, power, and compulsion, daughter of Styx and Pallas, who with her sister Peitho represents forceful inducement.

name: Bielowezca Forest
description: A forest in Poland where Ulf's ancestor Lupercus haunts in the form of an immense wolf Great Beast.

name: Bielowiezca
description: A forest in whose region the example Bjornaer magus Ulf drives out a village of hunters and becomes leader of the largest wolf-packs as part of his Great Beast's trials.

name: Bilera
description: The Prima of House Guernicus, an Archmaga with a neutral stance on the Traditionalist/Transitionalist debate, residing at Magvillus.

name: Bind The Gift
description: A Rego Vim 30 enchanted effect in Philippus Niger's Wizard's Bridle that prevents the casting of any spells of level 25 or below as a constant effect.

name: Binding the Gift
description: A Minor House Mystery (Virtue) taught by Merinita that lets a magus share his Gift's social quality through the familiar cords, moderating the Gift's penalties via the Golden, Silver, Bronze Gifts and the three cords.

name: Binding the Hermetic Codex
description: A Rego Animal 20 ritual variant of Binding the Mundane Codex that incorporates resonant materials into book bindings.

name: Binding the Mundane Codex
description: A Rego Animal 5 spell that binds up to 1,000 prepared bifolds into books and grants readers the +1 quality bonus for sound binding.

name: Bishop's Platter
description: A wondrous silver serving tray made by a silversmith that copies the spell Taste of the Spices and Herbs (Craft Level 13).

name: Bjorn Ironside
description: A deputy of Waddenzee who is the ship's master of the Nebelkönigin.

name: Black Forest Road
description: The only road across the Black Forest, built by the Roman 8th legion under Cornelius Clemens between Strassburg and Augsburg, with magical milestones warding away supernatural denizens.

name: Black Lineage
description: An intelligent lineage of cats descended from House Jerbiton's Founder's familiar that understand human language, often have Second Sight, live around 40 years, and have a parliament that elects a monarch (the King of the Cats).

name: Black Mountains
description: Mountains in south Wales where the covenant Blackthorn is hidden in a warren of caves and where Goliard once subdued an elemental spirit causing rockslides.

name: Black Serpent of the Barrow
description: A serpent dwelling in a barrow on the Mournful Mound that kills the sons of the King of Suffering daily and carries a wish-granting gold stone in its tail; slain by Peredur.

name: Blackberry God
description: A powerful faerie harvest deity worshipped in the Worshipful covenant's regio; the magi side with him as a Faerie Landlord and provide him vast amounts of beer.

name: Blackrose
description: Covenant founded by Blackthorn in 1104 on the North York Moors near Voluntas; recalled in 1107 after persistent mundane troubles.

name: Bladud
description: A legendary king of Britain who founded the city of Bath, encouraged magic, gathered a secret library of magical lore, and died flying.

name: Bladud's Library
description: A secret cave library of magical lore gathered by Bladud, written in a lost language and invaluable to a covenant if found.

name: Blatant Magical Air
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw for characters with a Magical Air or The Gift: a -6 penalty to social actions and being hated and feared by the mundane population.

name: Blautopf Pool
description: A deep-blue round pool at the southern edge of the Swabian Jura, source of the River Blau, with a Faerie aura and home to the water faerie Schöne Lau.

name: Blessed Relief of the Benighted Reins
description: A Rego Corpus 25 spell that magically removes a kidney stone from a patient's body into the caster's hand, requiring an Intelligence + Finesse roll.

name: Blood of Heroes
description: A heroic ancestral trait that runs through some Redcaps' veins, granting them unusual capabilities.

name: Bloody Flux
description: A Serious Phlegmatic Disease (excess of phlegm) caused by cold, wet living conditions, common in towns and armies.

name: Blwchbardd
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

name: Boaz
description: One of two great hollowed stone pillars ("great strength") of Solomon's temple legend that hold treasures of the ancient Hebrews.

name: Boethius
description: A Roman statesman, philosopher, and inventor whose notebooks Milo recovered; his philosophical principles were used to refine Verditius Runes, and a ritual was named after him.

name: Boglin
description: A foul, tentacled, primeval swamp spirit (Magic Might 25, Aquam) of northern Germany that lurks underwater, drags prey to its maw, and yields Animal and Perdo vis.

name: Boii Springs
description: Twelve hot mineral springs in western Bohemia near a Celtic settlement, including a 40-foot geyser; drinking the waters cures digestive disorders and the name derives from the Celtic Boii tribe.

name: Boncompagno
description: The rector of Bologna's Faculty of Arts, a famous rhetorician proposing to erect a dedicated building to house the university's learning.

name: Book of Instruction
description: A text written by Tytalus laying down arbitrary rules and seemingly random punishments for apprentices; the most hated object of a Tytalan apprentice, governing how to treat rather than train him.

name: Books that Scream in Pain
description: An Intellego Animal 25 spell with Herbam requisite that checks every book in a room for a physical or historical property; named for an early Durenmar librarian who made damaged books cry out.

name: Boons
description: Features that make a covenant better, costing points (Major three, Minor one, or Free Choices) in covenant creation.

name: Boosted Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus spend vis to boost Range, Duration, Target, or size of Formulaic spells by a magnitude.

name: Borbygus of Verditius
description: A Verditius magus and Collegium member who secretly imprisons scholars to build a magical collection of 'realia' that serves as a living library on Intellego.

name: Bordeaux
description: A city in the Provençal Tribunal; Castra Solis is located several leagues south of it.

name: Boreas
description: A ninth-century Flambeau magus, descended from Flambeau through Apromor's line, who created the cold-based School of Boreas to appeal to both major lineages of his House.

name: Borrow the Eyes of Another
description: An Intellego Mentem spell letting the caster see through the eyes of a person to whom he has an Arcane Connection.

name: Bound Ghost
description: A Flaw that magically binds a ghost so it cannot leave the covenant, taken by the Ghostly Warden.

name: Bound Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: when the magus dies, all his spells end and any magic items he created cease to function.

name: Bound to (Realm)
description: A Major Supernatural Flaw: the character cannot survive in the mundane world and must live in a supernatural aura of 5 or greater of a chosen realm to stay healthy.

name: Bound to (Role)
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character is physically bonded to a device or place and suffers deprivation if separated from it; includes the effects of Unaging.

name: Boundless
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab interior has unlimited space despite mundane outer limits, of non-Hermetic or faerie origin (+2 Warping).

name: Branwen
description: A woman in her twenties at Cad Gadu, the only covenfolk member trying to reverse its decay by improving defenses and recruiting new magi.

name: Breaking the Shackles of Vulgar Perception
description: A spell of at least 5th magnitude invented by Primus Handri of Merinita that allows the target to perceive the world as the faeries do.

name: Bremen
description: A port city on the north bank of the River Weser whose bishopric was founded in the 8th century by Charlemagne's missionary Willehad.

name: Brethren of the Free Spirit
description: A heretical pantheistic cult emerging at the start of the 13th century from Paris theologians and spreading in Cologne, equating God to primary matter and holding that there is no sin.

name: Brew the Healing Tonic
description: A Rego Herbam 10 spell that combines raw ingredients into a restorative theriac giving +3 to Wound Recovery rolls, provided the caster has the formula.

name: Bricriu mac Carbada
description: An Irish poet/demigod claimed by some Ex Miscellanea as the progenitor of the Nemthengacha line of bitter-tongued sorcerers.

name: Bricstan
description: A man of the Ely estate falsely accused of usury by Robert 'Malarteis', imprisoned in London, and miraculously freed by St. Benedict, St. Etheldreda, and St. Sexburga.

name: Bridge of Frost
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 30) that forms a thick layer of frost firm enough to walk on across the surface of a body of water.

name: Bridle of the Talking Horse
description: A wondrous bridle made by a leather maker that allows a horse's rider to talk to his steed (Craft Level 17).

name: Brilliance of the Eagle's Plumage
description: A CrIg 30 Spectacle-Target spell that blinds anyone looking directly at the caster with brilliant light.

name: Bristol
