description: A well-defended sea port surrounded by the rivers Frome and Avon and a royal castle, governed by a mayor and prospering chiefly on trade with Ireland.

name: Brittle Bones
description: A Major Curse (Rego Corpus effect) making the victim's bones fragile, risking broken bones (treated as Heavy Wounds) during strenuous activity.

name: Brogo the Dwarf
description: A dwarf trouvère from Tournai with the Curse of Venus and Death Prophecy, a wandering composer presented as a starting companion-level character who has visited Hermetic covenants.

name: Broken Vessel
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character's supernatural powers may be temporary, and rolling a zero on Stress Rolls for them costs experience points.

name: Brother Chaplain
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a priest of a crusading order, answerable only to the pope outside the order.

name: Brother Knight
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a knight in a holy crusading order, sworn to obedience, poverty, and chastity.

name: Brother Paul of Bolzano
description: An Augustinian canon, once a petty thief, who died at the hands of diabolists; his severed head weeps tears containing Mentem vis on the anniversary of his conversion.

name: Brother Sergeant
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a non-knightly member of a crusading order under vows of obedience, poverty, and chastity.

name: Brother-Knight
description: A Templar Social Status Virtue for a knight of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon; its effects are included in Templar Commander.

name: Brother-Priest
description: A Templar Status Virtue for a brother-priest of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, replaceable by Templar Administrator.

name: Brother-Sergeant
description: A Templar Status Virtue for a brother-sergeant of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, replaceable by Templar Administrator.

name: Brotherhood of Saint Lazarus
description: An order that, with House Jerbiton, maintains a leprosarium within an Immunity aura where covenfolk live long, healthy lives until they leave.

name: Bruges
description: The greatest manufacturing center of the Flemish industrial region, where merchants may not buy land but may dress richly, noted for luxurious trousers.

name: Brugge
description: A Flemish town and major power in the wool, weaving, and cloth industries, governed by elected officials and linked to the sea by the Zwin channel created by a sea dragon.

name: Brugge Bear
description: A ferocious bear that attacked Baldwin I at the site of Brugge, was magically transformed, joined his retinue, and became the first citizen of Brugge.

name: Brunhilda
description: Henri de Tours' Swedish wife, a magical folk practitioner with the power of divination who can send her spirit in animal shape; not formally a member of the Order.

name: Brunswick
description: A Saxon city beautified by Henry the Lion, centered on a bronze lion statue (the Burglowe) and a fortress-shaped cathedral beside Burg Dankwarderode.

name: Brutus
description: The Trojan founder of Britain who named the island after himself and built New Troy on the Thames after a prophecy from Diana.

name: Bryn-Celli-Ddu
description: A mound on Anglesey with a chambered passage and a carved labyrinth warding stone; the place where Llewellyn, last primus of House Diedne, was last seen, and which Hermetic magi tend to avoid.

name: Brünn
description: A castle and town at the confluence of the Svitava and Svratka rivers, seat of the Premyslid rulers in Moravia; once tormented by the Dragon of Brünn.

name: Builder's Helper
description: A wondrous miniature ladder that expands to 15 feet upon command and can be carried in a builder's pack (Craft Level 15).

name: Burchwen
description: Saint Godric's sister, also a hermit, who according to Godric gave him his shortest hymn after she died.

name: Bureaucrat
description: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a member of the Islamic civil administration, such as a scribe or legal-document writer.

name: Burg Trifels
description: An imperial fortress-palace atop the Sonnenberg at the edge of the Palatinate Forest, favored by Frederick Barbarossa, where Richard the Lionheart was imprisoned in 1193.

name: Burglar
description: A thematic covenfolk template thief with Great Dexterity x2 and high Legerdemain and Stealth, suited to covenants involved in Hermetic politics.

name: Burning Flesh
description: A Major Curse (Rego Corpus effect) covering the victim in itching red splotches, requiring Stamina + Concentration rolls to do anything but scratch.

name: Burning Issue of the Day
description: A ReMe 30 spell that compels a target Group to repeat a piece of information (true or false) to everyone they meet for the spell's duration.

name: Burst of the Sweeping Flames
description: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 25) that causes a fire to explode outward along the ground as if blown, igniting anything in its path for +5 to +15 damage.

name: Buss
description: A small, long, narrow seagoing ship descended from the Viking knarr, carrying around 20 tons and used for coastal trade and fishing.

name: Byzantine Empire
description: The empire against which Sikelgaita of Sicily's husband fought; Norman conquests in Byzantium were lost after the war turned against her family.

name: Cabal
description: A coordinated group of House Tytalus followers who anonymously join to pursue a shared goal of changing society, using esoteric names and identifying symbols.

name: Cabal Legacy
description: A Virtue suggested for Mithraic characters of House Flambeau.

name: Caerwent
description: A place in Britain whose old lord imprisoned his young bride; the hawk-knight, father of Yonec, was killed there for love of the lady.

name: Cailleach
description: An evil faerie hag that plagues the covenant of Circulus Ruber, unable to breach its Aegis of the Hearth and taking out its frustration on travelers.

name: Caithlinn
description: A maga of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant against whom Severus Maximus declared Wizard War in 1004 AD.

name: Caitlin Ex Miscellanea
description: Aindread's filia, a young polite maga who sometimes represents Burnham at tribunal and refuses all negotiations; has mismatched eyes.

name: Call of the Rushing Waters
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 15) that lets the caster locate any natural body of water to which they have an Arcane Connection by hearing it.

name: Call the Dream
description: A Rego Mentem spell letting the caster determine the theme of a sleeping person's dream by touch.

name: Calliclean
description: One of the two ethical viewpoints of House Tytalus's Philosophy of Conflict, represented by clockwise spiral symbolism indicating growth and perception.

name: Calliclean Ethics
description: A branch of Tytalan philosophy named after the Sophist Callicles that champions physis over nomos, holding that the strong should throw off the restraints of custom; symbolized by a clockwise spiral.

name: Callicles
description: An ancient Greek Sophist quoted in the Analects of Tytalus who championed natural justice of the strong over the laws of weaklings; the Calliclean view is named after him.

name: Calling the Council of Trees
description: A Hermetic ritual many magi believe to be of druidical origin, though House Merinita claims it for their Founder.

name: Calling the Council of the Trees
description: A Rego Herbam ritual (Level 45) that compels all magical and potentially mobile trees within a woodland to gather to hold meetings and summon ancient powers; trees remain animated for a month.

name: Calling the Odious Drought
description: A Perdo Aquam Ritual spell (Level 50) with an Auram requisite that causes a drought over the surrounding area, drying streams and rivers.

name: Calming Touch
description: A power of the angel Nasir (3 points, Animal/Mentem) that, by touching the target, calms their fears and reassures them in the face of dangerous terrain.

name: Calorific Stone
description: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent that, when dropped into water, makes the water boil within seconds; a single dose can affect a bathtub of water.

name: Caltis of Tremere
description: A young Tremere magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

name: Calum
description: A lapsed priest among Waddenzee's covenfolk who provides a heretical form of spiritual sustenance to the pirates.

name: Camargue Delta
description: The wild and inhospitable delta where the Rhone ends, home to a ghostly horse that keeps a larder of up to 100 wicked children.

name: Cambrian Mountains
description: The mountain range in Wales where Aneirin's tomb lies and across which his spirit wanders, helping those who further his ideals and punishing those who oppose them.

name: Cambunian Mountains
description: Mountains on the northern border of Thessaly where the Daughters of Erictho dwell in cliffside caves near Faerie regiones.

name: Cardiff
description: The most important town in Wales, in a country with few towns and a largely barter-based economy.

name: Cardinal Robert Caurçon
description: The cardinal who discovered the heresy of David of Dinant in 1215 after reading his book Quaternuli.

name: Careless Sorcerer
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus is slapdash with magical power and must roll two more botch dice than normal when casting spells.

name: Careless with (Ability)
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character is reckless with a particular Ability, treating any rolled zero as a botch when using it.

name: Carles
description: A stone circle of forty-two stones about thirty meters across, surrounded by a bank, containing three round barrows and a rectangle of stones called the Porter's Lodge said to become a guarded house on certain nights.

name: Carouse
description: A General Ability for enjoying oneself without adverse effects, such as consuming alcohol without passing out and gaining friends among the lower classes.

name: Carthusians
description: A strictly cloistered monastic order, the extreme example of monastic insularity.

name: Castile
description: A region of Mythic Europe with distinctive inheritance customs, including an example of a bride continuing to rule her own land except for her dowry, and where a widow may guard her son's lands.

name: Casting Total
description: The total (Stamina + Form + Technique + Aura + stress die) determining whether a spell is cast, used notably when casting from a Casting Tablet.

name: Castratus
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character was castrated before puberty, suffering -3 social rolls in Latin culture; only available to characters born with testicles.

name: Cataplasm of Mandrake
description: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Moderate, a secret of the School of Salerno using mandrake and hyoscyamus; it numbs a body part and reduces Wound and Disease Penalties by 3.

name: Catapult of the Mighty Winds
description: A Cr(Re)Au 30 spell that uses strong winds to hurl an object on an arched trajectory; once airborne the projectile's motion is natural and bypasses Magic Resistance, doing about +10 damage.

name: Cataracts
description: A Minor Curse (Perdo Corpus effect) clouding the victim's eyes white and penalizing vision-based rolls and reading advancement by -3.

name: Cathedral of St. Pierre in Beauvais
description: A new-style Gothic cathedral north of Paris standing over 150 feet tall, cited as an example of soaring cathedral architecture.

name: Cato of Bonisagus
description: A spectral Criamon Primus who was a Bonisagus magus before joining; he believes Criamon magi create the majority of all adulterations.

name: Catulus
description: A Bjornaer apprentice ('cub'), the common property of the sept during the sleeping years of training.

name: Causabon
description: A magus of House Bonisagus whose journal records his sense of the forests' primal power and his hope that the three domus magnae might share their secrets.

name: Cautious with (Ability)
description: A Minor General Virtue letting a character roll two fewer botch dice for a specific Ability.

name: Cautious with Chirurgy
description: A Virtue commonly taken by empirici that reduces botch risk when using the Chirurgy Ability.

name: Cautious with Medicine
description: A Virtue that enhances medical skill, reducing the risk of botches when using the Medicine Ability.

name: Cement (Reagent)
description: A Level 5 alchemical Reagent, a dry powder that when sprinkled over loose earth or sand binds it as solid as granite, covering about three paces to six inches deep.

name: Ceremonial Magic
description: A method of increasing spellcasting power using natural correspondences, props, and prepared spaces, with casting time reduced by prepared spaces and the Mystical Choreography Virtue.

name: Ceres
description: A goddess one of whose priestesses always serves as a hierophant of the Huntress in the Wood.

name: Chamber of Invisibility
description: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 25) that makes a Group of creatures invisible; any affected character who moves or is touched makes everyone visible, and all still cast shadows.

name: Chamber of Summer Breezes
description: A Creo Auram 10 spell with Ignem requisite creating a continual breeze of fresh, dry, warm air to keep a room's humidity and temperature constant, often cast on armarii and book chests.

name: Chancery
description: A branch of the royal court headed by the chancellor Richard de Marsh, responsible for issuing documents under the Great Seal and keeping government records such as the Pipe Rolls.

name: Change Size
description: A Muto Terram effect (MuTe 10) enchanted into Falke's talisman that turns it into a leg-band, triggered by Perceive the Change.

name: Changeling
description: A story-seed faerie who comes regularly to a market for human food to sustain a stolen human child raised by her group living in nearby woodland.

name: Chaos of the Angry Wave
description: A Rego Aquam spell (ReAq 20) known by Felicia.

name: Chaotic
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab or its outfittings are in constant flux or motion (-2 Safety, +1 Warping, +2 Muto or Rego).

name: Chapel That Cannot Sleep
description: A chapel raised on an ancient battlefield where mythic death-roads converge, disturbing the sleeping dead near an unfortunate covenant.

name: Chapter House
description: A small dependent covenant founded at a valuable site far from a covenant's main holding, tending to agitate for independence from its motherhouse.

name: CharacterType (Bjornaer Magus)
description: A magus of House Bjornaer who possesses a heartbeast and belongs to a clan and sept within the ancestor cult.

name: Characteristic
description: The eight inborn attributes (Intelligence, Perception, Strength, Stamina, Presence, Communication, Dexterity, Quickness) defining a character's potential.

name: Charlemagne's Empire
description: The historical Frankish empire whose civilizing forces helped wipe out the Gothic witch-cult tradition.

name: Charlemagne's Loaf
description: A wondrous loaf of bread whose smallest nibble grants the eater incredible courage, giving a +3 on all Bravery rolls (Craft Level 17).

name: Charles Martel
description: The Frankish King who repulsed the Moorish army at the Battle of Tours in 732, the historical event that destroyed Flambeau's family estate.

name: Charm against Putrefaction
description: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 10) that prevents decay of a human corpse or severed body part; used by necromancers to preserve revived corpses.

name: Charter Demon
description: A typical demon with Infernal Might 15 (Mentem) that offers services such as disease relief or merchant bonuses to townsfolk in exchange for tithes or worship under a demonic charter.

name: Chasidim
description: German Jewish mystics who developed a cultural and religious renaissance after the First Crusade, emphasizing asceticism, martyrdom, and lifelong penitence.

name: Chaudepysse
description: A Minor Choleric Disease contracted from unclean women, notoriously difficult to cure, causing painful urination.

name: Chavin of Tytalus
description: A magus of House Tytalus whose spells all promote or advocate war or violence per his sigil; his version of Voice of the Lake makes the lake sound arrogant.

name: Cheating the Reaper
description: A Creo Corpus ritual (Level 30) that resolves a major or lesser aging crisis; each application causes Warping.

name: Cheshire
description: One of the two English palatinates, where the Earl of Chester holds all the authority of the king.

name: Chester
description: A small walled city and capital of the palatine county of Cheshire where the earl of Chester is the highest authority, with a leather trade and a pagan shrine of Minerva carved into nearby rock.

name: Childbed Fever
description: A Major Sanguine Disease afflicting women who have just given birth, caused by the childbed fever demon.

name: Christianity
description: One of the three most important Divine religions in Mythic Europe; many magi are Christians and its relics are most common.

name: Chromatic Flames
description: A Level 4 alchemical Reagent that, when sprinkled over flames or mixed with fuel, causes them to burn a different hue chosen by the alchemist until extinguished.

name: Chrétien of Troyes
description: The most famous trouvère of northern France, whose Arthurian poems concentrate on Arthur and his peers.

name: Church Upbringing
description: A Minor Personality Flaw: the character was schooled and raised by the Church, leaving him less knowledgeable about society and requiring 25 experience points on Church-related Academic Abilities.

name: Church of the Holy Sepulcher
aliases: church of the Holy Sepulcher in Jerusalem
description: A holy site in Jerusalem with an extremely strong Divine aura; casting a spell there incurs the maximum example of botch dice.

name: Cian
description: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

name: Cindrallon
description: A Flambeau apprentice made a full maga after only seven years for single-handedly slaying a renounced magus in a Wizard's March using a spear.

name: Circle of Encompassing Flame
description: A Creo Ignem (CrIg 35) fire spell known by the Flambeau template magus.

name: Circle of Encompassing Flames
description: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 35) that creates a 6-foot-high circle of flames dealing +20 damage to anyone moving through; with a Rego requisite the circle can shrink or grow as the caster concentrates.

name: Circle of Time
description: House Criamon's core belief that time runs forever in identical cycles, an unguarded prison from which they seek to escape with all humanity.

name: Circular Winds of Protection
description: A wind-based spell referenced as a strength level achievable by the Whistle Up the Wind Ability.

name: Circulus Ruber
description: The oldest covenant in the Hibernian Tribunal, plagued by a Cailleach (an evil faerie hag) that cannot breach its Aegis of the Hearth.

name: Cirion
description: A magus of House Tremere who declared Wizard War against Pietro of House Diedne of Oakdell covenant in 1004 AD.

name: Cistercian
description: A monastic tradition that balances its monastic offices with physical or mental labor.

name: City-Watch
description: Patrols in large towns that enforce curfew and interrupt crimes in progress, but with no formal investigative function to solve past crimes.

name: Clan Mysteries
description: Minor-Virtue Mysteries unique to each Bjornaer clan, Initiated by elder clan members to help fulfill duties to their ancestors.

name: Clarion Call of the War Horse
description: A MuMe 15 Sound-Target spell that heartens anyone hearing the caster's battle cry, granting a +3 bonus to their Brave Personality Trait.

name: Clear Breath of the Consummate Liar
description: A Muto Vim (Mentem) 20 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that lets him manipulate a Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie cast on himself to appear truthful or lying as desired.

name: Clear Sight of the Naiad
description: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that lets the caster see as clearly through water as through air for a single moment.

name: Clemens
description: The most senior master of Fengheld of House Tremere, filius of Stentorius, who runs Fengheld's biggest chapter house.

name: Cloak of Black Feathers
description: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 30) with an Animal requisite that transforms the caster into a raven via a cape of raven feathers.

name: Cloak of the Duck's Feathers
description: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 5) that makes water run off an object or creature, protecting it from dampness unless submerged.

name: Closed Mouth of the Nightwalker
description: A PeMe 40 Spectacle-Target spell that makes anyone who sees the caster instantly forget having done so.

name: Closing the Earth's Gate
description: A Perdo Aquam spell (Level 25) that dries a single spring permanently so it never flows again.

name: Clumsy Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus has trouble targeting spells, with aiming rolls of 0 automatically botching and -3 to Finesse rolls.

name: Clutch of Ebony Eggs
description: The Criamon clutch filled with the servants of the Path of Strife, the only clutch with no followers of other paths.

name: Co
description: Reference to Corpus in spell shorthand (ReCo 65) for the Summoning the Champions effect of the Horn of Champions.

name: Coagulation
description: A demonic power allowing demons to manufacture a solid body from ambient unformed matter; in Christian lands demons must abandon coagulated form on Holy Saturday.

name: Coenobium Rhodanien
description: A covenant in the Provençal Tribunal notorious for its involvement in Hermetic politics, preventing the foundation of any covenants it does not control over a large area of the tribunal.

name: Coenwulf
description: A member of the Sept of Orn (Clan Wilkis) trained by Hosvir Goatlegs.

name: Coerce the Spirit of Anger
description: A ReMe 20 spell that compels a spirit of anger to obey the caster through dramatic threats, with effectiveness determined by a Communication + Leadership roll.

name: Coerce the Spirits of the Night
description: A spell that makes a ghost obey the caster as long as it can be coerced with threats such as defiling its grave or banishing it to Hell.

name: Cog
description: The main clinker-built trade ship of the Atlantic, North Sea, and Baltic, usually carrying 20 tons but sometimes 100 to 140 tons.

name: Coils of Entangling Plants
description: A Rego Herbam spell (ReHe 20) known by Ioannes Acer with Mastery in Fast Casting.

name: Colens Arcanorum
description: A House Bonisagus office, held by Andrus, jointly responsible for disseminating the House's knowledge and research.

name: Colloqui Cum
description: A magical power of the Virtuous Hound (Imaginem, 0 points) that lets it speak by creating sounds apparently from its mouth.

name: Command Animals
description: A Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting a character mentally command mundane animals of a species linked to the tainting demon.

name: Commanding Aura
description: A Free Supernatural Virtue granted by the pope or the Divine, giving a Church officer a power like Aura of Rightful Authority plus Magic Resistance and Soak scaled by rank.

name: Commanding the Harnessed Beast
description: A Rego Animal spell (Level 30) that implants a complicated command into an animal, which it carries out to the best of its ability.

name: Common Giant
description: An enormous ugly man-like magical creature (Magic Might 12, Corpus) about 20 feet tall, found throughout the British Isles; unlike many magical creatures, giants eat, drink, breathe, and age.

name: Companion Animal
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw (animals only): the character is the Animal Companion of another character and has little control over his own life.

name: Compassionate
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character helps anyone wounded or in trouble and cannot bear to see suffering in others.

name: Compress of Mallow
description: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Mild, a cool bandage of mallow and cucumber that soothes burns and heals any Light Wound caused by fire over a week.

name: Compulsion (Lies)
description: A Flaw compelling Imanitos Mendax to lie.

name: Compulsive Lying
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character finds it hard to tell the truth and embellishes or invents stories whenever he won't be immediately caught.

name: Concoction of Litharge and Henbane
description: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Strong, a poison combining litharge, henbane, cinnabar and other ingredients that inflicts a Heavy Wound unless the imbiber succeeds at a Stamina roll.

name: Concordia
description: A short-lived covenant (821–823) in the Lake District that attempted to weld Ex Miscellanea traditions together but fell apart from internal tension.

name: Confidence Point
description: A point a character can spend (for example) to walk away from a situation that would otherwise increase a Verditius magus's Hubris score.

name: Confraternity Member
description: A Minor Story Flaw marking membership in one of the smaller cults of magi in House Verditius, granting access to a confraternity's unique Inner Mystery.

name: Confraternity of Balento
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Balento that produces wood-carved devices imbued with fire spells, with members claiming descent from Vulcan.

name: Confraternity of Himinis the Mad
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Himinis the Mad that produces cursed items and trick devices using the Bind Curse Mystery.

name: Confraternity of Irene the Younger
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by the Byzantine princess Irene that creates magical paintings, statues, and mosaics affecting viewers and surroundings.

name: Confraternity of Roland
description: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Roscius that crafts magical swords engraved with an 'R', studying the sword Durendal.

name: Confusion of the Insane Vibrations
description: A Rego Imaginem spell (Level 30) that makes the target see everything vibrate and hear displaced sounds, imposing -3 on Attack and Defense and extra botch dice.

name: Conjuration of Wild Thyme
description: A Creo Herbam 20 Ritual spell that creates ten thousand doses of wild thyme, prepared and dried; a different spell is required for each herb.

name: Conjure the Sturdy Vine
description: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 5) that grows 10 paces of strong, pliable vine suitable for use as rope from wood or fertile soil.

name: Conjuring the House of God
description: A ritual Creo Terram spell (Level 45) that creates an unconsecrated church with vaulted ceilings, towers, and stained glass windows.

name: Conrad of Urach
description: A cardinal legate present in Montpellier preparing to announce the pope's desired statutes that would make the Bishop of Maguelone the university's sole authority.

name: Constanta the Tessellatrix
description: A student of the Jerbiton Primus Andru, extremely active in coordinating her fellow antigones.

name: Constantine V
description: Byzantine Emperor, son of Leo III, against whom the League of Iconophiles was still intriguing at the time of the First Tribunal as monasteries were sacked and icons burned.

name: Contagion
description: A natural principle (pars pro toto) by which substances acquire second qualities through association or contact, underlying Arcane Connections.

name: Continence
description: A Minor Personality Flaw: the character does not engage in sexual activity, due to a vow of celibacy or personal choice.

name: Control Fertility
description: A Supernatural Ability that enhances or withdraws the vegetative spirits in living things, affecting fertility, milk yield, conception, and disease; the defining Virtue of the Scinnfolk.

name: Converse with Plant and Tree
description: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 25) that lets you speak with a plant for one conversation, with detail depending on the plant's type.

name: Convoluted Mind
description: A Minor General Tainted Virtue giving +3 on Infernal Lore rolls about demons and a common-sense-like warning when dealing with them.

name: Copper Rooster Inn
description: An inn at Basel maintained by House Mercere, frequented by Redcaps traveling between the Alps, Rhine, and Normandy Tribunals.

name: Cornelius Clemens
description: The Roman commander of the 8th legion who built the Black Forest Road during the rule of Vespasian, aided by Mercurian priests.

name: Corrguineach
description: An Irish tradition of wizards controlling elemental spirits who were enemies of House Diedne and joined House Flambeau to exterminate them; a Hermetic Sahir variant.

name: Corrupted Abilities
description: A Minor Supernatural Tainted Flaw: one or more Abilities was taught by a demon, giving +3 for selfish use and -3 for selfless use, with use sensed by Divine Powers.

name: Corrupted Arts
description: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: a Hermetic Art was studied from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting Total for sinful use and -3 for selfless use; tainted magic appears unholy.

name: Corrupted Spells
description: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: at least 30 levels of formulaic spells learned from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting and Penetration for sinful use and -3 for selfless use.

name: Corsica
description: The island where Verditius was born; site of his blood feud and capture, and where the Rings of Verditius were possibly lost.

name: Coryza
description: A Minor Phlegmatic Disease caused by a cold, damp environment producing an excess of phlegm in the head.

name: Council of Four
description: The ruling council of House Ex Miscellanea representing different facets of the House's interests, instituted by Pralix and re-instated by later Primi.

name: Council of Members
description: The governing council of a covenant, comprising its probationary and full members, which holds covenant resources in common and decides matters by vote.

name: Council of Tours
description: A Church council whose decree of 1163 forbade the participation of monks in commercial medical practice and non-monastic university education.

name: Countess Jeanne of Flanders
description: The current lord of Brugge, married to Fernando of Portugal and living in Lille, who is without an heir.

name: Court coram rege
description: The highest court of the land, where the king himself sits in judgment wherever he is; only the most important cases reach it and there is no further appeal.

name: Court of Piepowder
description: The court that upholds justice during a fair, named from the French for the dusty feet of itinerant tradesmen; it handles trade-related prosecutions under merchant law.

name: Court of the Alder Prince
description: A faerie court of the seasons, suggested to be sited in the Odenwald, paired with the Willow Maiden's court in the Swabian Forest.

name: Court of the Bees
description: A faerie court with which the young Spring in the Woods covenant has developed good relations.

name: Covenant Charter
description: The written constitution of a covenant defining membership, governance, resources, rights, responsibilities, and censure; a sample based on Arae Flaviae is provided.

name: Covenant of Crisp Winds
description: A constantly mobile covenant living on a flotilla of ships that follows a route around the Mediterranean collecting vis and trade goods.

name: Covenant of the Castle of Fees
description: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, glass is as durable and hard as iron and used as building material and armament.

name: Covenant of the Monkey's Reed
description: A covenant on a floating island whose aura, warping to a pattern, is slowly twisting its people and structures into an ancient Egyptian village.

name: Covenant of the Redbreasted Warriors
description: A fallen covenant whose aura a faerie king is said to hold captive in a wine bottle.

name: Covenant of the Solemn Scholars
description: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, children are able to fly until they lose their virginity.

name: Coventry
description: An English town near which the Redcaps' base, Mercer House, is situated.

name: Covet Device
description: A Personality Trait left in an attuned item that makes its owner crave the device, building up over seasons of ownership.

name: Craft Amulets
description: The Minor Hermetic Virtue of the Karaites tradition.

name: Craft Automata
description: A Major Hermetic Virtue and Ability (initial score 1) granted by the Automata Mystery, allowing a character to construct mechanical men and beasts.

name: Craft Guild Training
description: A Minor General Virtue granting 50 experience points in Craft, Profession, Bargain, or Guild Organization Lore from above-average apprenticeship.

name: Craft: Goldsmith
description: A Craft Ability for goldsmithing whose higher scores represent more precise, time-consuming metalworking methods.

name: Craft: Mason
description: A Craft Ability for masonry; Villard de Honnecourt's sketchbook tractatus can be studied as a quality-7 source for it.

name: Craft: Percamenarius
description: The craft of making parchment; a Perception + Finesse roll substitutes for it to determine the quality of vellum produced by the spell Hide to Parchment.

name: Craft: Poetry
description: A Craft Ability for writing poems, increased by studying other poets' literature and used to determine a poem's Aesthetic Quality.

name: Craft: Potter
description: A Craft Ability governing pottery, used by Maker of Textured Vessels and Maker of Water Vessels to determine vessel shapes and bonuses.

name: Cramped
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: equipment is packed too close together, hampering all but one specialized activity (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -2 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Crateuas
description: The greatest herbalist of antiquity, author of the first pharmacopoeia and herbal, the original Root-Cutter, and ancestor of the Pharmacopoeians.

name: Craving for Travel
description: A Minor General Flaw: the character suffers loneliness and boredom penalties if he does not expose himself to new experiences, getting worse the longer he stays in one place.

name: Creating an Empty Book From a Filled One
description: A Perdo Animal 3 spell that creates a palimpsest from an existing book by flaking away a thin layer from each page.

name: Creation of an Undeserved Reputation
description: A CrMe 20 spell that creates a false memory of a person confessing to an enjoyable evening of intercourse with another, damaging reputation.

name: Creation of the Simile
description: A CrMe 20 spell that creates a new category of thing in the viewer's mind, granting unconscious familiarity with a broad range of its instances.

name: Creeping Oil
description: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 15) that saturates a porous material with flammable oil which, if ignited, causes fire damage.

name: Cremona
description: One of the famed southern schools of medicine with access to the corpus of Arabic medical texts, where many Greek and Roman texts were translated from Arabic.

name: Crest of the Earth Wave
description: A Rego Terram spell that creates a wave in the earth traveling outward, tossing aside those caught in its path for +10 damage.

name: Critias
description: A Sophist and leading member of the Thirty Tyrants of Athens, quoted in the Analects of Tytalus; he held that virtue could be imposed by force and religion was a human invention to control the masses.

name: Cross of Saint Oswald
description: The wooden cross Saint Oswald raised before battle; its splinters and the moss growing on it have healing powers, as in the cure of the monk Bothelm.

name: Crow's Voice
description: A Minor Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) causing the victim to caw throughout speech, penalizing communication rolls and spell casting by -3.

name: Cruel
description: A Minor Flaw making a character cruel, taken by the Familiar Cat as a species Flaw.

name: Crystal Custodian
description: An invested magical item invented by Gudrun Tigurina of Verditius at Durenmar.

name: Cuenca
description: An Iberian town whose fuero of one thousand clauses, granted by Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1190, regulates inheritance, criminal law, and Christian-Jewish relations.

name: Cult of Ancestors
description: House Bjornaer's tradition of revering ancestral spirits and Great Beasts, taught through House Bjornaer Lore alongside the House's Exoteric Mystery.

name: Cult of Hephaestus
description: An ancient Greek Mystery Cult of smiths and artificers founded by the god Hephaestus, ancestral to House Verditius.

name: Cult of Isis
description: A Roman cult once centered on early Florence, with relics found in the Roman Temple of Isis in a magical regio in the city, occupied by a High Priestess and followers.

name: Cult of Vulcan
description: The Roman successor of the Cult of Hephaestus, renamed under the empire, which emphasized destructive fire magic and supplied enchanted items to Caesars and the Cult of Mercury.

name: Cult of the Dead
description: An alleged cult blamed by medieval writers for the rise of the restless dead; its existence, identity, and responsibility are left to the storyguide.

name: Cunning
description: The animal equivalent of Intelligence; Animal spells may affect beasts with Cunning analogous to Mentem affecting human minds.

name: Curse of Slander
description: A Minor General or Supernatural Flaw: unpleasant rumors about the character spread wherever he stays, building a bad Reputation centered on a section of mundane society.

name: Curse of the Evil Humors
description: A MuAu 25 spell that converts clean air into a noxious cloud of foul humors that can cause malaria (a Medium Wound) on a failed Stamina roll.

name: Curse of the Haunted Forest
description: A Muto Herbam ritual (Level 60) with a Perdo requisite that turns a normal small forest into a haunted, conscious, and cruel dangerous place.

name: Curse of the Ravenous Swarm
description: A Creo Animal Ritual spell (Level 50) with a Rego requisite that calls a swarm of locusts or destructive insects to devastate an area's plant life and fields.

name: Curse of the Rotted Wood
description: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a non-living wooden object up to the size of a door to rot and fall apart into dust.

name: Curse of the Unruly Tongue
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 5) that causes the target to stutter and slur words, penalizing communication and spoken spellcasting.

name: Cursed
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab suffers a supernatural curse with appropriate Characteristic penalties.

name: Cursed Guile
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw, the boy-who-cried-wolf curse likely from Infernal influence: three extra botch dice with Guile and rarely being believed even when honest.

name: Cybelle
description: A goddess of the wilderness honored in a True Merinitae Initiation festival held from the 15th to 27th of March, with rites including ritual castration beneath a sacred pine.

name: Cyclic Magic (negative)
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus's magic is attuned to a cycle of nature and is less potent at specific times, giving -3 to Lab Totals and Casting Scores then.

name: Czech
description: One of the three legendary founding brothers of the Slavic peoples; ancestor who led his tribe, the Czechs, to settle in Bohemia, and from whom the Premyslid dynasty descends.

name: Cîteaux
description: The mother house of the Cistercian Order in France where the abbots meet annually in September; founded by Robert of Molesme in 1098.

name: Dagger of Ice
description: A Cr(Re)Aq 10 spell that creates and hurls a foot-long icicle inflicting +5 damage if it penetrates Magic Resistance, then shatters.

name: Dama
description: The Praeco of the Provençal Tribunal, a House Merinita maga born in 993 who fell into Twilight and emerged, and is rumored to lead a Mystery Cult not part of House Merinita.

name: Damhadh-Duidas
description: A Gaelic hedge wizard from the same magical tradition as Damhan-Allaidh who joined Pralix's crusade against the warlock; eponym of the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition.

name: Damietta
description: A city whose fall to the Crusaders the previous year resulted in slaves purchased into Levantine and Theban Tribunal covenants.

name: Damp
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is waterlogged or moist, spoiling parchment and ingredients (+1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Aquam).

name: Dance That Heals
description: A Major Supernatural Virtue from some Sufi traditions granting the ability to dance objects to wholeness, like Path of Walking Backward magi.

name: Dance of the Staves
description: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a long thin non-living wooden object to lash about wildly and strike its holder for +4 damage.

name: Danket
description: Gravis's faerie caricature, a grumpy, stick-thin dwarf with a perpetual scowl contrasting Gravis's sunny disposition.

name: Danu
description: A faerie elemental spirit of the River Danube, formerly worshiped as a goddess by many peoples before the Romans; her presence remains strong at the river's source.

name: Danube
description: A river embodied in ancient times as a faerie goddess whose nymphs guard treasure grottos and gateways to Arcadia.

name: Daria la Gris
description: Co-leader of the Apple Gild and princeps of Triamore, a follower of House Tremere who favors forming the Lotharingian Tribunal; a stern 67-year-old Master.

name: Dark Jerbiton
description: A group associated with the covenant of Oculus Septentrionalis that may be dovetailed with the demonic schemes of Radegast and Gymir.

name: Daughters of Erictho
description: Non-Hermetic Thessalian wizards who did not join the Order, dwelling in the Cambunian Mountains; suspected of diabolism and demon worship.

name: Dauphiné
description: The domain of Lord Guigues, who commissioned a mechanized magpie automaton.

name: Dav'nalleous
description: The foe against whom Pralix waged war; her final battle with him was at the site where Cad Gadu was founded.

name: De Lapii
description: The Branch of Terram in 1220, a Summa on Terram of Level 17 and Quality 14, written by Jeremias filius Guernicus.

name: De Magia Sympathetica
description: A Tractatus on Magic Theory (Quality 11) by Elaine covering Arcane Connections and sympathetic connections.

name: De Ordinis Hermetici
description: An encyclopedia by Quaertus of Bonisagus comprising five Quality 9 tractatus on the Code of Hermes and Order of Hermes Lore (history and geography).

name: De Potestate et Obligatione
description: A Tractatus on Philosophiae (Quality 11) by Elaine discoursing on the responsible and ethical practice of magic, influenced by Saint Augustine's City of God.

name: Dead Language: Gothic
description: An Academic dead-language Ability used in all the rituals of House Bjornaer and essential to members of Clan Ilfetu, with little use outside ritual contexts.

name: Deaf
description: A Major General Flaw: the character cannot hear at all; magi with it roll two extra botch dice when casting spells with a spoken component.

name: Decay Fur and Hide
description: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 10) that destroys an object made of animal fur or hide, including wool and leather.

name: Decaying
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab's equipment, furnishings, and materials are neglected or gone bad (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Decimus
description: A House Tytalus faction member who supports Harpax, the tenth Primus; Decimi wear revolutionary green as their badge.

name: Dedicated Building
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is in its own building shared with no one else, reducing distractions (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Rego).

name: Defective Heating
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has inadequate or missing heating and is too cold in winter (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Defective Lighting
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is poorly lit, dingy and gloomy (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Defenses
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab has a sturdy defense such as a portcullis or battlements (+1 Aesthetics).

name: Deficient Arts
description: A Hermetic Flaw afflicting Sebastian, who learned Hermetic magic despite several Deficient Arts, leading him to fight using his one strong Form, Aquam.

name: Deformed
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: part of the structure has subsided or warped, e.g. a partially collapsed wall (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

name: Deft Art
description: A Virtue, here Deft Art (Herbam), possessed by Ioannes Acer.

name: Degenerative
description: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the equipment and ingredients decay unnaturally quickly (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +2 Perdo).

name: Deheubarth
description: An ancient Welsh principality in the south, centered on the fort of Dinefwr; once nearly unified under Lord Rhys.

name: Deluge of Rushing and Dashing
description: A Creo Aquam spell that causes a stream to flood into a raging torrent, sweeping along and damaging anyone caught nearby.

name: Demeter
description: A powerful nature-oriented Greek deity whose name eumolpids of the Huntress may learn through the Mysteries of Names of Power and Invocation Magic.

name: Demon of Scrofula
description: A demon with Infernal Might that uses the Diseased Possession power to inflict the disease scrofula on a possessed victim.

name: Demon's Visage
description: A Major Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) transforming the victim's head into a demon-like beast shape, penalizing communication, social rolls, and spell casting by -6.

name: Demonic Blood
description: A Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue making a character a half-demon with Infernal Might, Infernal Powers, no need to eat, immunity to Warping, and a drastically shortened lifespan.

name: Demonic Familiar
description: A Minor Story Flaw binding the character to a famulus, a familiar demon possessing an animal, which is not loyal and pursues its own goals.

name: Demonic Might
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue (requires Demonic Blood) increasing a character's Infernal Might by 2 points.

name: Demonic Powers
description: A Minor Supernatural Virtue (requires Demonic Blood) granting an extra 20 levels of Infernal Powers.

name: Depraved
description: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw where the character seeks to undermine religion and avoid the Dominion whenever possible.

name: Depressed
description: A Minor Personality Flaw giving the character a dark outlook on life, seeing little point in acting and taking no pleasure in events.

name: Desiderius of Verditius
description: An old Verditius magus of Voluntas who is a necromancer, smelling of rotting flesh, lately becoming sociable despite poor social skills.

name: Despair of the Quivering Manacles
description: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that makes the target shake vigorously side to side, penalizing physical movement and other rolls.

name: Deteriorating Power
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw that reduces the effectiveness of one of the character's powers over time, linked to age, Might, or Warping Score.

name: Determine the Location of the Absent Volume
description: An Intellego Animal 25 spell (based on The Inexorable Search) that locates a missing book by showing the magus's sigil on a map, with an optional Creo requisite to project the location on a mirror.

name: Deventer
description: A modest-sized city and early missionary-bishopric on the right bank of the Rhine, surrounded by marshland, with a church named after St. Lebuinus and at the center of a struggle against pirates.

name: Devoted Parent/Child
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is extremely attached to a parent or child, suffering anxiety and penalties when separated.

name: Dhimmi
description: A Minor General Flaw marking a non-Muslim living under Muslim rule, who must pay the jizya head tax and abide by social restrictions in return for tolerance and protection.

name: Diabetes
description: A Minor Sanguine, Lifelong Disease from rich food and gluttony, named by Aretaeus after the Greek word for a siphon.

name: Diamond Mines of Solomon
description: A legendary treasure-site the Expedition covenant was founded to discover, following a map used by two prior expeditions that never returned.

name: Diana of Tremere
description: A Tremere maga of Blackthorn who declared a Wizards' War in 873 against William of Jerbiton of Rosalba.

name: Dictionarius
description: A famous 13th-century craft manual by John de Garlande about various trades that adds +4 to a craftsman's Workshop Total.

name: Didyma
description: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal linked to the city of Miletos by the Sacred Way, a mundane road that is also a major route from the faerie realm to the mundane world.

name: Dietrich III
description: The duke of Upper Lorraine who dies in 1220 and is succeeded by Matthew II.

name: Difficult Longevity Ritual
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw making it difficult to create an effective Longevity Ritual for the character, halving the Lab Total of anyone who tries.

name: Dimicatio
description: A dangerous Flambeau tournament event where competitors cast real spells using forceless casting and fast-cast defenses, the first to reach the opponent's Parma winning.

name: Diminutive
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is configured for an especially small magus, causing difficulty for normal-sized users.

name: Dionysus
description: A god originally worshipped alongside Hermes by Orpheus's society but who fell out of favor after Orpheus's death; the Maenads who killed Orpheus were devoted to him.

name: Dirne-Weibl
description: A wood-wife who dresses in a red frock and carries a basket of apples that turn to gold if she is treated courteously; her apples are Creo vis sought by magi.

name: Dirty
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is not kept to basic cleanliness, leaving the owner smelly (-1 Health, -2 Aesthetics, +1 Perdo).

name: Diseased Possession
description: An infernal power, a variety of Possession, by which a demon enters a victim and spends Might to inflict a disease's contagion.

name: Disguise of the Transformed Wizard
description: A Muto Imaginem 15 spell known by Imanitos Mendax.

name: Disguised
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab or its entrance is concealed mundanely, such as by a hidden door (-1 Aesthetics).

name: Disjointed Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw preventing the magus from using prior knowledge of similar spells or enchantment bonuses to aid his magic.

name: Disorganized
description: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is organized haphazardly, though some magi prefer it (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Muto or Experimentation).

name: Disorientating Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw requiring the magus to spend a round recovering his mental faculties after casting a spell.

name: Dispassionate
description: A new Minor Personality Flaw making one unable to express strong emotions; the first Sacrifice on the Arcadian Path.

name: Dispel the Phantom Image
description: A Perdo Imaginem (General) spell that destroys the image from any one Creo Imaginem spell whose level the caster matches or exceeds on a stress die plus spell level.

name: Dissolving the Wall of Shields
description: A PeMe 20 spell that removes the procedural memories letting a group of soldiers fight as a unit, or destroys other simple group skills.

name: Distillation of the Purest Stream
description: A Rego Vim 15 spell (R: Touch, D: Mom, T: Ind) that concentrates the essence of exceptionally pure stream water into a pawn of Aquam vis.

name: Distraction of the Magpie
description: A Muto Mentem spell that alters the target's estimation so shiny objects become highly desirable and distracting.

name: Divination & Augury
description: A supernatural Virtue allowing the performance of auguries; Chnoubis' Augury power functions as this Virtue, granting ten levels of success per Might point.

name: Divination and Augury
description: The Major non-Hermetic Virtue of the Hermetic Haruspexes tradition.

name: Doctor
description: The title held only by graduates of a university faculty of medicine (or those with Clerk and Medicine 3+), the only physicians with formal claim to it.

name: Doge
description: The leader of the city of Venice, who annually casts a vis-bearing engagement ring into the sea to symbolize the city's espousal to and dominance over the waters.

name: Dogrose School
description: A regio covenant claimed by House Bonisagus that draws Gifted children via their possessed toys and teaches them before sending them to masters.

name: Domestic Animal
description: A Free Social Status Virtue (animals only) for an animal that is the property of a covenant or character.

name: Dominican
description: One of the two major new mendicant friar orders of the early thirteenth century, growing rapidly in popularity.

name: Dominicus
description: A magus of House Jerbiton exonerated by the Normandy Tribunal of 898 for using Wizard's War to avenge a slain amicus, establishing legal precedent for avenger pledges.

name: Donning the Mask of Another
description: A Tytalan MuMe 35 Ritual spell that creates a persona from the identity of a donor, granting the caster the donor's memories and personality as a deep cover disguise; it can also steal or transfer a persona.

name: Doolin
description: A guild master clothier living in Paris, a man of inexhaustible energy who makes excellent quality clothing and dreams of monopolizing the formal attire of wizards.

name: Doubt
description: A Major Curse (Rego Mentem effect) filling the victim with doubt, requiring Intelligence rolls before undertaking any activity.

name: Dover Castle
description: Castle whose octagonal three-story archery Bell Tower (built 1189) exemplifies the archery-tower extreme of mural-tower design.

name: Down Tor
description: A group of stones on Dartmoor with a circle around a barrow and a long line of stones said to bind and channel a powerful ghost that can be summoned along the line by those who know the rituals.

name: Dragon Hill
description: A small hill near the White Horse of Uffington with a flat top on which nothing will grow.

name: Dragon of the Sauerland
description: A dragon that must be conquered and its heart eaten as the second Quest of the Path of Energy.

name: Drawing Up the Siege Ladder
description: A Rego Herbam 15 spell originally for hauling siege ladders over castle walls, used by librarians to rearrange wooden furniture and move groups of wooden objects.

name: Dreadful Bane of the Fae
description: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion but working on creatures with Faerie Might.

name: Dream Magic
description: A Virtue gained through Clan Maruhs's Deed of Emulation and spread within the clan by the Sept of Gyöngy.

name: Dream of the Mind That Sits
description: An Intellego Terram spell (with Creo requisite) that lets the caster probe and perfect the memories of a spirit within a natural stone object.

name: Drogo Invigilor
description: A Tremere magus of Fengheld closely associated with the Welfs, investigated by House Guernicus over suspicions he arranged accidents for the emperor's heirs.

name: Druids' Circle
description: A stone circle on a moor overlooking the Irish Sea whose entrance stones are sensitive to oaths and move nearer to swearers; dark tales say druids practiced human sacrifice there.

name: Dunoding
description: A region of Wales near an island where the swynwyr established Pralix's military headquarters, later renamed Cad Gadu.

name: Durendal
description: Roland's magic sword, forged by Wayland Smith with Verditius as apprentice, later stolen by Roscius and studied by the Confraternity of Roland; used in their Initiations.

name: Dust Devil
description: A Minor Supernatural Skinchanger variant letting a character become a Size +1 dust devil whirlwind, focused through a glass amulet of Magic-aura sand.

name: Dutiful Movement
description: A common automaton power (base effect 20) letting the automaton walk and follow its creator around.

name: Dyscrasia
description: The imbalanced state of humors producing a patient's symptoms, which a physician must understand to bring the humors back into balance.

name: Eagle Clan
description: A Crintera clan of the nimblest, keen-eyed grogs who are expert archers, acting as spies, hunters, and an informant network across Europe.

name: Ealwynn
description: A member of the Sept of Orn (Clan Wilkis) trained by Hosvir Goatlegs.

name: Eastern Christendom
description: A cultural society of Mythic Europe centered on the Byzantine empire and Constantinople, defining its own Social Statuses.

name: Eastern Roman Empire
description: The cosmopolitan eastern realm ('Romania') whose Greek-cultured cities produced House Jerbiton's founding members and the League of Iconophiles.

name: Eden
description: The biblical paradise from which man was expelled; noxious plants are said to have acquired harmful qualities after the expulsion.

name: Edgar
description: The newest Redcap of the Stonehenge Tribunal, in his early twenties, good-looking with light brown hair and gray eyes, with no magical items yet.

name: Edifice Boon
description: A covenant Boon that troupes may select instead of paying Build Points for a Great Work.

name: Educated (Bardic)
description: A Minor General Virtue for attending a Hibernian bardic school, granting 50 experience points in storytelling and lore Abilities.

name: Educated (Islamic)
description: A Minor General Virtue for education in a mosque or Qur'an school, granting Academic Abilities and 50 experience points in languages and Islamic studies.

name: Educated (Vernacular)
description: A Minor, General Virtue representing secular instruction given by tutors to scions of merchant houses, granting Academic Abilities and 50 extra experience points for practical business skills.

name: Efnisien
description: A Welsh hero claimed by some as the first of the Nemthengacha, the bitter-tongued Ex Miscellanea tradition.

name: Eginolf
description: A magus of House Flambeau of Rudiaria covenant against whom charges of diabolism were brought (unproven) in 962 AD.

name: Egypt
description: A region of Mythic Europe near the Pyramids and the great Sphinx where magi established a desert laboratory.

name: Einherjar
description: Spiritual warriors awaiting Ragnarok, into whom Valkyries transform the worthy dead chosen from battle.

name: Elbe
description: A river haunted by a Wild Hunt led by Frau Wode and by shadowy boatmen carrying invisible passengers.

name: Elbruz Mountains
description: The mountains where Baghl the earth jinni haunts a dark cave formerly used as a quarry.

name: Eleanor Sworder
description: The woman who has led Nigrasaxa's turb for five years and aspires to be a knight; bears an ugly scar on her left cheek.

name: Eleanor of Aquitaine
description: Overlord of Aquitaine who attended the Second Crusade with a guard of female knights dressed as Amazons; her scandalous behavior led to a Papal Bull barring women from the Third Crusade. An example of inheritance-based female power.

name: Elemental kings
description: Powerful spirits of the Magic realm whose favor Archmage Vinaria of Merinita must win for her archmage challenge.

name: Elemental spirit
description: A spirit that broke free of an ancient binding and caused rockslides in the Black Mountains in revenge on humanity; Goliard restored its binding and took control of it.

name: Elementalist
description: A Virtue common among Hermetic Sahirs reflecting their facility with the elemental Forms.

name: Elementary
description: A Major laboratory Outfittings Flaw: a cut-down lab with extremely limited equipment allowing only one category of lab activity, cheap to maintain (-2 General Quality, -3 Upkeep).

name: Elevated
description: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is at least four floors up or atop a tower, commanding a view (+1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

name: Elsa
description: The young widowed duchess of Brabant rescued by the Knight of the Swan Lohengrin, whom she wedded and lost when she broke her vow not to ask his name.

name: Ely
description: An abbey and bishopric, site of the tomb of St. Etheldreda and a pilgrimage destination; setting of Bricstan's miraculous deliverance.

name: Emotion Theft
description: A Supernatural Ability granted by the Thief of Emotions Virtue, allowing one to steal an emotion from a person and transfer it to another by touch.

name: Emrys
description: A Welsh seer who made a pact with faeries to trade his life for his son Ambrosius's, serving as magical advisor to a faerie court; his spirit could be seen watching over the boy.

name: Enchanted birthing chair
description: An enchanted chair at Voluntas's village that ensures almost all mothers and children survive childbirth, giving Wilton unusually high life expectancy.

name: Enchantment
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab itself has been enchanted as a magic item, granting Virtues, Flaws, or Specialization changes.

name: Enchantment of Detachment
description: A spell that calms and greatly lowers the intensity of the target's current emotions.

name: Enchantment of the Pedestrian Pigeon
description: A MuMe 15 spell that occludes a person's memory of told information until a key phrase unlocks it, used for secure transfer of information between conspirators.

name: Encumbrance
description: A penalty derived from the Load of carried equipment, calculated through Burden and offset by Strength, that subtracts from athletic and spellcasting rolls.

name: Enduring Magic
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue causing the magus's spells to last longer than usual, with the storyguide secretly multiplying durations by a die roll.

name: Engelbert I
description: The current archbishop of Cologne, a tall, fair, and just man holding the status of Archchancellor of Italy, martyred in 1225 if the saga follows real history.

name: Enslave the Mortal Mind
description: A spell that lets the caster completely control the loyalty, emotions, desires, and activities of any person.

name: Enticer of Multitudes
description: A Minor, General, Tainted Virtue giving a corrupt version of Inspirational usable only to manipulate people toward evil acts.

name: Entisimon
description: A Primus of House Flambeau who rallied the House during the Schism War but was disgraced and forced to resign during the Normandy Crisis.

name: Enumerus
description: A renowned Jerbiton magus who wrote a treatise on covenant economics held in the Great Library of Durenmar; he gave his name to the Pound of Enumerus, the unaccountable yearly petty expenditure.

name: Environmental Magic Condition
description: A Major Hermetic Flaw halving all of the character's Casting and Lab Totals in certain common environmental conditions.

name: Environmental Sensitivity
description: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is unusually sensitive to an uncommon environmental feature, suffering a Stamina penalty when exposed.

name: Ephesus
description: A site in the Theban Tribunal holding a statue of Diana that Huntress initiates may anoint with sacred oil during the Eumolpid initiation.

name: Epimetheus
description: Hariste's devoted pupil who contracted leprosy while consoling her after Tytalus's disappearance, thereby founding the leper magi lineage.

name: Erfurt
description: The oldest and largest settlement in Thuringia, an episcopal city under the archbishopric of Mainz, deriving wealth from the export of woad.

name: Erik von Ribe
description: A magus of House Tytalus, filius of Tasgillia, quoted remarking that a magus lacking a disgraced ancestor shows a distinct lack of enterprise.

name: Eristic Moot
description: A public dispute between competing speakers used by House Tytalus to settle differences, announced by Redcap; includes special forms such as the Apprentice's Gauntlet and the contest for Primus.

name: Erysipelas
description: A Minor Choleric Disease of morbid choler from excessive heat and dryness, causing a maddening rash on the extremities.

name: Erythravis
description: An Archmage of House Guernicus who executed Tasgillia for diabolism in 961 AD.

name: Eschenfrau
description: A very evil wood-spirit who must be appeased with a sacrifice on Ash Wednesday by those unfortunate enough to live near one.

name: Espera of Merinita
description: A Merinita maga of Ungulus who offended a faerie lord and devotes herself to survival, never leaving the Aegis and wearing enchanted iron items against faeries.

name: Essential Nature
description: A character's intrinsic, magically defining nature, which can make certain Flaws impossible to remove even with Hermetic magic.

name: Essential Traits
description: Traits possessed by some creatures of the Magic Realm that are part of their essential nature, marked with an asterisk; magic cannot make such creatures act against them.

name: Estrid Danesson
description: A magus Ex Miscellanea (age 36) of Oculus Septentrionalis, a Danish former hedge wizard specializing in sailing and weather magics who gathers vis around the Baltic; cousin and enemy of Eric Ribecus.

name: Eternal Repetition in a Bottomless Pool
description: A Creo Imaginem 35 spell that uses enchanted mirrors to display the text of a book the magus has an arcane connection to, navigable by vocal command.

name: Ethelwald
description: The seneschal and autocrat of Voluntas who plays lord of the manor to the outside world and avoids becoming a knight to escape military service.

name: Ethiopia
description: The location of a cave complex that is the perfect site for the Microcosm ritual on the Path of the Body, discovered in North Africa.

name: Etzel
description: The king of the Huns in the Nibelungenlied, who marries Kriemhild; historically Attila, the dreaded chieftain checked at the Battle of Chalons.

name: Eucrasia
description: The state of perfect balance of the humors that prolongs life and negates bodily suffering, the goal of a medical regimen, represented as a Living Conditions Modifier.

name: Eudokia
description: One of the three regions of the Faerie Realm; the land of tales that teach a lesson.

name: Eule's Wisdom Item
description: A low-level but very high-Penetration Perdo Mentem magic item hidden in the floor of Eule's receiving room that calms minds and removes emotion, used by Gunther to fake her wisdom.

name: Eurydice
description: Orpheus's beloved wife who died of a viper's bite and whom he tried to recover from the Underworld.

name: Eurynome
description: A sea nymph who, with Thetis, rescued and raised Hephaestus after Zeus cast him into the sea.

name: Eustace de Faukenberg
description: The treasurer of England, who heads the Exchequer.

name: Eustace the Monk
description: The leader of the French reinforcement fleet of eighty ships; defeated by Hubert de Burgh's fleet and beheaded against the rail of his own ship.

name: Eustace, Abbot of Flay
description: An abbot sent by the Pope in 1200 to lead a mission against Sunday trading in England, whose preaching and miracles caused many Sunday markets to close or move.

name: Eve
description: The first woman of biblical lore referenced in the Divine setting material.

name: Everstorf Forest
description: A forest north of Schwerin in which the Giant's Grave lies.

name: Evil Destiny
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the Infernal realm has taken an unexplained interest in the character, who must guard against dark forces.

name: Evil Eye
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character bears the uncontrolled potential to harm those around her, adding a botch die to stress rolls made in her presence.

name: Evisceration of Ten Thousand Knives
description: A Perdo Corpus 35 enchanted-item effect in Philippus Niger's talisman, a Group-targeted version of his Evisceration of a Thousand Knives.

name: Evisceration of a Thousand Knives
description: A Perdo Corpus 30 spell invented by Philippus Niger that inflicts an Incapacitating wound on one target.

name: Excessive Heating
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is kept far warmer than necessary with extensive facilities (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +2 Ignem).

name: Excessive Lighting
description: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is lit far more than necessary with hundreds of candles or lamps (+2 Upkeep, +2 Imaginem).

name: Exchange of the Two Minds
description: A ritual spell that switches the minds (but not the souls) of two creatures.

name: Exchequer
description: A branch of the royal court headed by the treasurer Eustace de Faukenberg, responsible for checking and receipting all moneys owed to the crown; staffed by Barons of the Exchequer.

name: Exciting Experimentation
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw causing the character's experiments to have dramatic flair, rolling two dice on experimentation tables with the storyguide choosing the more amusing result.

name: Excommunicate
description: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has been cast out of the Church for crimes against God, gaining a bad reputation and losing access to the sacraments.

name: Exeter
description: The seat of a bishop and the most important town of southwest England, a sea-port on the river Exe with a Norman cathedral dedicated to St. Peter and a wine trade with Gascony.

name: Exiled Atlantean
description: A Minor Supernatural Flaw marking the character as an Atlantean tainted by contact with the surface world and unable to return to her native magic regio.

name: Exposed
description: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the building is partially exposed to the elements, e.g. unroofed or wind-cracked (-1 Safety, +1 Upkeep, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

name: Extensive Stores
description: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: large stores let the lab withstand shortages and store vis and dangerous materials more safely (+2 Safety).

name: Extractor of (Form) Vis
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to extract vis of a chosen Form from a Magic aura whose features exemplify that Form.

name: Eye of the Eons
description: An Intellego Terram spell (InTe 5) known by Tabanus.

name: Eyes of the Eons
description: An Intellego Terram spell that determines the age of any nonliving target to within 10% of its actual age.

name: Eyes of the Flame
description: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 35) that lets the caster see a fire to which they have an Arcane Connection, plus all things the fire illuminates.

name: Fabric Ripper
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting the power to tear any manufactured object made from plant or animal fibers, as a PeAn(He) 25 effect.

name: Fabricor of Verditius
description: A young Verditius magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

name: Facilitate the Stifled (Form) Spell
description: A Muto Vim general spell cast alongside a formulaic spell to remove the casting penalty from reduced or absent gestures and voice; has ten versions, one per Hermetic Form.

name: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave
description: A CrVi ritual spell (R: Touch, D: Until) that binds a supernatural creature as a temporary familiar to the caster until an incorporated condition comes to pass.

name: Faerie Doctor (Virtue)
description: The Free Mythic Companion Virtue defining a character as a faerie doctor, required of all faerie doctors.

name: Faerie Enmity
description: A Flaw cursing the exsules's line, stemming from Quendalon's ancient curse, causing faeries to instinctively hate them.

name: Faerie Familiar
description: A faerie bound as a magus's familiar; at Irencillia magi such as Glesig make their caricatures (e.g., the troll Humnel) into faerie familiars.

name: Faerie Ingredients
description: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: some lab stores are supplied by faeries with beneficial if unpredictable properties, e.g. faerie silver.

name: Faerie Queen of Irencillia
description: A faerie queen used as an example target in the Symbolic Magic ritual, affected at Symbol Range via 'queen,' 'winter,' and 'faerie' charms.

name: Faerie Sight
description: The ability to read glamour, allowing the holder to see magical things and tell what other faeries want simply by looking at them.

name: Faerie Speech
description: A faerie ability to converse in the language of one's audience, speaking any language someone has used to speak to them without needing to Penetrate.

name: Faerie Spider
description: A poisonous faerie spider befriended by Lutisse that protects her treehouse lab, though its cobwebs infest the dwelling.

name: Faerie Tarantula
description: A faerie creature whose bite afflicts victims with tarantism, an excess of yellow bile causing an irresistible urge to dance.

name: Failed Monk
description: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which the character was cast out of a cloistered order, gaining a poor reputation but freedom from monastic vows.

name: Falconer
description: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a character who trains hawks and falcons for a noble patron, granting Profession: Falconer and extra experience points.

name: Falls Like a Cat
description: A Minor, General Virtue protecting a character from injury when falling up to three (or six) times his height.

name: False Window
description: A CrIm 5 miniature spell that traces a door or window frame to create an illusion of something beyond it, requiring a Perception + Finesse roll.

name: Familiar Bond
description: A Hermetic enchantment binding a magus to a familiar; it can be dispelled by Perdo Vim and is automatically re-sustained when a magus enters an Aegis.

name: Fast Caster
description: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue granting +3 to Initiative for casting spells in combat and +3 to fast-casting speed rolls.

name: Fast Runner
description: A heartbeast Quality example that, applied via Theriomorphy, gives the magus the legs of his heartbeast.

name: Fatal Register
description: A Muto Animal 20 spell that changes a book's bookmark ribbon into a venomous serpent (traditionally a cobra), typically vested in a single-use charged object activated when a book is stolen.

name: Fatigue
description: A measure of tiredness with six named levels (Fresh, Winded, Weary, Tired, Dazed, Unconscious), lost through strenuous activity and recovered with rest.

name: Fauho
description: The filius of Midusulf and second primus of House Bjornaer, with a fox heartbeast; the Seat of the Fox is named after him.

name: Faun
description: A common woodland faerie creature; the common lezi is a form of faun, and gigantic fauns are found in the Basque country.

name: Faux Feudalism
description: A Free covenant governance choice modeling hierarchical, feudal-style rule over residents.

name: Feather Messenger
description: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue for a bird-shifter who can separate a feather and telepathically control it as a self-inking quill, associated with the Daughters of Four Fathers.

name: Febris Semitertiana
description: A Major Choleric Disease (Severity 18) from water corrupted by Saturn and Mars, capable of killing thousands in summer.

name: Fedoso
description: The protagonist of Verderis's epic poem The Travels of Fedoso, a young man who travels a strange landscape facing mystical obstacles, believed by some Criamon to be a map of the House's future.

name: Feldberg
description: The highest peak of the Black Forest, the bare-topped seat of the King of the Black Mountain, reached only via the haunted Höllental, with a multi-level regio of Faerie aura 3 to 8.

name: Fettered Magic
description: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making all of the character's spells and activated magic item effects Arcane Connections to him.

name: Fidelus
description: A House Tytalus faction member who is a loyalist of Buliste, the ninth Prima; Fideli wear royal purple as their badge.

name: Findabair Ex Miscellanea
description: A young, stunningly beautiful maga at Cad Gadu who uses magic to preserve her looks and dresses to seduce, while whining about the covenant's decay.

name: Finding Hidden Loot
description: A Minor, General Virtue granting +9 to Awareness rolls when searching a confined space for hidden items.

name: Finesse roll
description: A roll using the Finesse Ability that controls the quality of craft magic and substitutes for mundane Craft rolls when using craft spells or devices.

name: Finz-Weibl
description: A wood-wife who wears a wide-brimmed hat and is very hairy.

name: Fire Damp
description: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent kept in a stoppered flask that releases a heavy gas which dampens the intensity of flames, removing 10 points of fire damage.

name: Fire Elemental
description: An elemental being of fire that can be created from elemental matter via a Creo Ignem ritual and controlled, transformed, or destroyed via Ignem magic by reducing its Might.

name: Fireheart
aliases: The Lost Talisman of the Founder
description: Flambeau's lost talisman, an oval-cut flawless fire opal the size of a walnut into which he invested several fire and mind effects; serves as an Arcane Connection to its creator.

name: First Flautist
description: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

name: First Lyrist
description: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

name: First Singer
description: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, hosting the next competition at her covenant.

name: Fish Out of Water (Terrain)
description: A Minor General Flaw giving the character an affinity for one terrain type and penalties when away from it.

name: Five Fairs of Flanders
description: A fair cycle of Lille, Mesen, Ypres, Torout, and Bruges held between February and November, built on the fine woolen and linen cloth trade.

name: Flabbergast the Impertinent
description: A sample relic power (2 points, Init +3, Mentem) that curses the target into a deep, snoring sleep for the night from which no magic can prematurely wake them.

name: Flamen
description: The title ('priest') for a Mercurian magus, who performs ceremonial duties such as leading ritual magic, reading omens, and officiating Hermetic events.

name: Flames of Sculpted Ice
description: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 35) with an Aquam requisite that turns a fire up to the size of a small house into ice sculptures of leaping flame; the flames return as the ice melts.

name: Flashbacks
description: A Minor General Flaw in which combat or tense situations may trigger hallucinatory flashbacks to past battles, causing panic.

name: Flavia of Jerbiton
description: A Jerbiton maga trained by Jerbiton himself who founded Rosalba in 820 and wrote philosophical tractatus before her mysterious Final Twilight in 890.

name: Flavius Ex Miscellanea
description: A frustrated old magus of Ungulus, trained there in its glory days, who clings to the failing covenant and hopes to rebuild it with young magi after the others pass.

name: Flawless Equipment
